sanskrit: rbhāvaireva manoharaiśca caraṇābjaikaprasādālayamjñānānandagirirmaheśacaraṇābjaikaprasādālayaḥtāṃ namāmi mahādevīṃ bāṇīṃ vāgvibhavapradāmyāmalaṃ śaktisaṃjñañca bhāvacūḍāmaṇiṃ tathākulasāraṃ kuloḍḍīśaṃ kulāmṛtakulārṇavamkālītantrakulānandaṃ kulacakraṃ tathaiva casamayākhya kālītantraṃ phetkārīṃ pheravīṃ tathāsvatantraṃ tantrarājañca jñānamālāṃ tataḥ parammantranirṇayatantrañca yoginīhṛdayaṃ tathāśivaśāsanatantrañca mandaraṃ plāvanīṃ tathānīlatantraṃ matsyasūktaṃ lalitātantrameva cavaṭukasaṃhitāñcaiva tārārṇavaṃ tataḥ paramsamayākhyaṃ tantrasāraṃ tato mantravimarśinīmbhairavākhyaṃ mahātantraṃ siddhasārasvataṃ tataḥchinnātantraṃ vātulañca dakṣiṇāmūrttisaṃhitāmguruṇāñca mataṃ jñātvā sārātsārataraṃ mahatatiyatnena goptavyaṃ mātṛmaithunavat sadāp. 4) na dadyāt paraśiṣyāya vañcakāya tathaiva caprakṛtācārayuktāya gurusevāparāya caśiṣyāya bhaktiyuktāya sādhakāya pradāpayetsa bhakṣyo yoginīvṛndairmṛte ca narakaṃ vrajetpustakaṃ vīkṣya yo mūḍho na labdho guruvaktrataḥtasya karmāṇi sarvāṇi narakāya bhavanti hitasmājjñātvā gurorvaktrāt sādhane yatnamācaretsarvajñaḥ sarvakartā ca sarveśo nirmalodayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nirguṇaḥ saccidānandastadaṃśā jīvasaṃjñakāḥsarvepyupādhisaṃbhinnāste karmabhiranādibhiḥsukṛtairmānavo bhūtvā jñānī cenmokṣamāpnuyātna mānuṣyaṃ vinā'nyatra tattvajñānantu labhyatekadācillabhate janturmānuṣyaṃ puṇyasañcayātyastārayati nātmānaṃ tasmāt pāpataro'tra kaḥna vettātmahitaṃ yastu sa bhavedātmaghātakaḥtasmād dehadhanaṃ rakṣan puṇyakarmāṇi sādhayetjñānino'jñānino vāpi yāvad dehasya rakṣaṇamkarmaṇonmīlite jñāne jñānena śivatāṃ vrajetsarvakarmāṇi santyaktuṃ na śakyaṃ dehadhāriṇāahambhāvamapāsyaivaṃ yaḥ kuryāt sa na lipyatekriyamāṇāni karmāṇi jñānaprāpteranantaramtattvaniṣṭhasya karmāṇi puṇyāpuṇyāṇi saṃkṣayamutpannasahajānandatattvajñānarataḥ sadāvṛthaiva yaiḥ parityaktaṃ karmakāṇḍamapaṇḍitaiḥphalaṃ prāpya yathā vṛkṣaḥ puṣpaṃ tyajati nispṛhaḥaśvamedhaśatenāpi brahmahatyāśatena capṛthivyāṃ yāni karmāṇi jihvopasthanimittataḥāgamotthaṃ vivekotthaṃ dvidhā jñānaṃ pracakṣateadvaitaṃ kecidicchanti dvaitamicchanti cāparedve pade bandhamokṣāya mameti nirmameti cavidyā'vidyādvayoryogāt pakṣadvayamudīritamyanna bandhāya tat karma sā vidyā parikīrttitāyāvattadeva naivāsti tāvadeva hi mokṣaṇam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tāvadeva hi sarvañca yāvattattvaṃ na vindatitattvaniṣṭho bhaveccaiva yadīcchenmokṣamātmanaḥyathāvidhi gurorvaktrādvidyāṃ saṃgṛhya sādhanamanyathā na bhajeditthaṃ karotyāpatparamparāprātarutthāya śirasi sahasradalapaṅkajedhyāyennijaguruṃ dhīro rajatācalasannibhamśuklamālyāmbaradharaṃ varadābhayapāṇikampriyayā savyahastena dhṛtacārukalevaramjñānānandasamāyuktaṃ smarettannāmapūrvakamgandhaṃ bhūmyātmakaṃ dadyād bhāvapuṣpaṃ tataḥ paramnaivedyamamṛtaṃ dadyāt pānīyaṃ varuṇātmakamdarśayitvā yonimudrāṃ gurumantraṃ japettataḥvahniyuktāṃstridhā likhya ādyadīrghatrayānvitānathārādhyapadaṃ caiva sarvamūrdhvapadaṃ tataḥśrīgurunāthaśabdānte sahakṣamalavarānilānpiṇḍīkṛtaṃ likhedādyaṃ caturthañca tato likhettataḥ śrīśambhugurvante punarādyaṃ samālikhetcatvāriṃśanmārgavarṇairmaṇḍito'yaṃ gurormanuḥdakṣakarṇayuto gauro vahnirudreṇa bhūṣitaḥgakāraḥ siddhidaḥ prokto rephaḥ pāpasya hārakaḥgurorvāmakare tattu samarpyātha stutiṃ paṭhetcakṣurunmīlitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥtatpadaṃ darśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥiti yasyājñayā tasmāttasya śrīpādukāsmṛtiḥnamāmīdṛgrūpaṃ paramagururūpaṃ sakaruṇam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yasya śrīpadapaṅkajodbhavasudhā siddhaiḥ sadā pīyateprasādato yasya mayā pralabdhaṃ savāsanājñānavināśabījamso'yaṃ guruḥ śirasi śuklasarojamadhyepravande sānandaṃ tamapi gururūpaṃ sakaruṇamyadi syācceto me niravadhi guroḥpādakamalamdhyāyet kuṇḍalinī śaktiṃ mūlādhāranivāsinīmsuptāhisādṛśākārāṃ sārdhatrivalayānvitāmsamutthāpya mahādevīṃ prāṇamantreṇa sādhakaḥsthāpayitvā ca tasyordhvaṃ dhyāyet kulagurūn kramātkumārānandanāthañca vaśiṣṭhānandanāthakambodhānandamathābhyarcya krameṇānena sādhakaḥparāliṅganasambhinnacūrṇitāśeṣatāmasānvarābhayakarāśeṣakulatattvārthavedinaḥevaṃ kulagurūn natvā'mṛtavṛṣṭiṃ vidhāya catasyāḥ prabhāsamūhaiśca vyāptaṃ dehaṃ vibhāvayetsaccidānandarūpo'hamityātmānaṃ vibhāvayetnamaskuryāt prayatnena kulaṃ kulapatiṃ tathānameruśca piyālaśca sindhuvārakadambakauathavā kulavṛkṣāṃśca kathayāmi susiddhayevilvo vaṭoḍumbaraśca ciñceti daśamī smṛtāna svapet kulavṛkṣādho na copadravamācaretkāmabījaṃ kāmadevaṃ sarvānte janamālikhetdantādikaṃ viśudhyātha svakalpoktaṃ samācarettasya pūjā tu viphalā śaucahīnā yathā kriyāiti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye prathamollāsaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yathāvidhi jalaṃ prāpya ātmānaṃ devatālayamunmajya tata utthāya kuladarbhaṃ vidhārayettatra śāktaiḥ svayaṃ grāhyaṃ na ca vanyāḥ kuśāḥ kuśāḥeṣa eva bhaveddarbho na darbho vanasambhavaḥtasmāddūrvā grahītavyā sarvapuṣpamayī yataḥācāmedātmatattvādyaiḥ praṇavādyaiḥ svadhāntikaiḥmastakāni spṛśen mantrī kuryācchrotrākṣibandhanammūlānte cātmatattvāya vidyātattvāya tatparamsvāhāntamadbhirācāmet pūrvottaramukhaḥ sudhīḥebhiḥ saṅkalpya vīrendraḥ samantraṃ vāriṇi nyasetsañjapya daśadhā mūlaṃ tattoyaṃ mūrdhni saṃkṣipetaṅgulībhirmukhaṃ śrotraṃ nāsāṃ netre ca rodhayantilakaṃ mūlamantreṇa śikhāñca parikalpayetgṛhītvā vāmahaste tu jalaṃ dakṣiṇapāṇinākṣauṇīvaruṇabījañca trivāramabhimantrayetsvamūrdhni ca kṣipettoyaṃ śeṣaṃ dakṣe nidhāya catata uttolya dehasthaṃ pāpaṃ prakṣālya vāmayāprakṣālya hastayugalamācamettadanantaramprakāśaśaktiyuktāya arghyaṃ svāhā tato vadetvibhāvya purato yantraṃ tatra devīṃ gaṇānvitāmtarpayed devatāvaktre vidhivat sādhakottamaḥdvitīyāntāmahaṃ paścāt tarpayāmi namaḥ padamguruṃ saparivārañca āyudhaṃ vāhanaṃ tathādhyātvā sāvaraṇāṃ devīṃ sūryamaṇḍalavāsinīmśivacaitanya tasyānte mayyai svāheti saṃsmaran
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mudrayā hṛdi saṃsthāpya jalādutthāya sādhakaḥmokṣārthī raktavastreṇa bhogārthī śvetavāsasāuccāṭane vyāghracarmaṃ vṛkṣatvak śubhakarmaṇiprakṣālya hastapādau ca pūjāsthānaṃ samāviśetsnānatarpaṇaśūnyasya nādhikāraśca pūjanevinā snānena yā pūjā viphalā siddhihānidāekaliṅge śmaśāne ca śūnyāgāre catuṣpatheujjaṭe nirjane vāpi bhūgṛhe devatālayehaṭṭāgāre nijāgāre paśudṛṣṭivivarjiteniśchidramaṇḍape vāpi kartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ sadāpañcakośāntare yatra na liṅgāntaramīkṣatecatuṣpathaṃ vijānīyāt yatrāste caṇḍikāśilādvāradeśe tato gatvā pūjayeddāradevatāḥsiddhārthākṣatadūrvābhistilamiśraiḥ susādhakaḥye bhūtā vighnakartāraste naśyantu śivājñayākulabhūtaṃ samutsārya yāgabhūmiṃ tato viśetrekhācatuṣṭayaṃ kāryaṃ indravāruṇayogataḥindrāgniyāmyanair-ṛtyapratīcyāṃ pañcavargakamlakṣau kramāt samālikhya sādhakaḥ siddhihetavepūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ ṣoḍaśasvaramālikhetkṣetrādyarṇastu yatrāste śīrṣaṃ tasya viniścitamnirdhano jāyate patsu pārśvayorvyādhireva cakūrmacakraṃ vinā yo hi japahomaṃ samācaretpañcaśuddhivihīnena yatkṛtaṃ na ca tat kṛtampañcaśuddhiṃ vinā pūjā abhicārāya kalpate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mantraśuddhirdevaśuddhiḥ pañcaśuddhiritīritāsāmānyārghyaṃ tataḥ kuryāt prokṣaṇārthaṃ ca sādhakaḥādhāraṃ sthāpayettatra saṃpūjya vahnimaṇḍalamsūryamaṇḍalamuccārya hṛnmantreṇa prapūjayetindumaṇḍalamabhyarcya prakṣiped gandhapuṣpakeagnīśāsuravāyavyamadhye dikṣvaṅgapūjanamastrāntamūlamuccārya ātmānaṃ yāgabhūmiṣupraṇavaṃ bhagavatyeva dharaṇīṃ ṅeyutāṃ vadetbrahāṇaṃ pūjayitvā ca puruṣaṃ vāstusaṃjñakamvitānaṃ dhūpadīpādyaiḥ puṣpamālā'bhiśobhitamvilikhya maṇḍalaṃ bhūmau pūrvavat sādhakāgraṇīḥathāsanaṃ pravakṣyāmi śāktānāṃ sthitikāmyayāviṣṭare vā samāsīnaḥ sādhayet siddhimuttamāmcūḍopanayanairhīnaṃ mṛdumacūḍakaṃ viduḥyo mṛtaḥ pañcame varṣe tameva komalaṃ viduḥtāvat kālaṃ nārakī syād yāvadāhūtasaṃplavamkauśeyaṃ bhogadaṃ raktakambalaṃ siddhidaṃ smṛtamūrṇā duḥkhaharī proktā jñānasiddhirmṛgājinekāṣṭhāsanaṃ na kurvīta yatra daurbhāgyavān bhavetmanoharaṃ mṛdu ślakṣṇamāsanaṃ parikīrtitamsāmānyārghyasya toyena puṭāñjalividhānataḥkūrmo'dhidevatā cātra āsanasthāpanāya capṛthvi tvayā dhṛtā lokā devipadaṃ tato vadetnityaṃ pavitraṃ kuru ca āsanañca samuccaretādhāraśaktiṃ saṃprocya ṅeyutaṃ kamalāsanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āsane saṃviśet paścāt vīrāsanena sādhakaḥkuryādṛjuvapurgrīvaḥ śarīraṃ ṛjuvaccaretkāmākhyādiṅmukhaḥ susthaḥ prāṅmukho vā prapūjayetiti te kathito hyatra āsanavidhiḥ pūjanestasya śrīrnetrapadme vilasati satataṃ vaktra candre ca vāṇīdevatāgurubhaktābhiḥ sañcitaṃ yāgabhūmiṣukarpūrāgurudhūpādivāsitaṃ paṭavāsitamsarvālaṅkārabhūṣābhirbhūṣitaḥ sādhakottamaḥsarvaṃ svadakṣiṇe sthāpya vāme kumbhaṃ niveśayetnaivedyaṃ dakṣiṇe vāme purato vā na pṛṣṭhataḥdīpaṃ dakṣiṇato dadyāt purato vā na vāmataḥnivedayet purobhāge gandhapuṣpādibhūṣaṇamaṅgasaṃspṛṣṭamāghrātaṃ tyajet puṣpaṃ sadā budhaḥraktamarghyaṃ śvetadūrvāṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ kuruṇṭakamsugandhiśvetalauhityakusumairarcayet kuśaiḥpatrairna cārcayed devīṃ vilvapatravivarjitaiḥjavābandhūkamandāraiḥ sindūraiśca mahotpalaiḥnandyāvarttaṃ tilapatraṃ tathā keśarapatrakamnānopahārabalibhirnānāpuṣpaimanoharaiḥkulapuṣpeṇa dhūpena kuladīpena tāṃ sudhīḥna dadyānmālatīpuṣpaṃ tārākālīprapūjakaḥna paryuṣitadoṣo'sti jalajotpalacampakenijadevasya puṣpāṇi pṛthakpātre nidhāpayetnaivedyādīni sarvāṇi tathā jānīhi niścitampūjāphalaṃ na cāpnoti narakaṃ pratipadyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hastaprakṣālanācchaucamācāmastu tadācaretsaṃsthāpya vāmabhāge tu śaktiṃ svāmiparāyaṇāmvinā śaktyā tu yā pūjā viphalā nātra saṃśayaḥyā śaktiḥ sā mahādevī hararūpastu sādhakaḥprāṇaṃ binā yathā dehī spandituṃ naiva śakyatevinā dravyādhivāsena na japenna smaret sadāna pūjāṃ na japaṃ kuryānna dhyānaṃ na ca cintanamsatyametad vijānīyādvākyaṃ śaṅkarabhāṣitamna bhuktvā ca na pītvā ca na smarenna japettadāānandena vinā yastu caṇḍikāṃ paripūjayettasmādādau prakarttavyaṃ samvidāsavayojanamvijayāgrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā dhyānaṃ yaḥ kurute naraḥsamvitprayogasteneha pūjādau sādhakottamaiḥtasyā bhedaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathārthaṃ tantravartmanāvaiśyā pītaprasūnā ca śūdrā kṛṣṇaprasūnikāsamvide brahmasambhūte brahmaputri sadānagheoṃ brahmāṇyai namaḥ svāhā brahmāṇīṃ śodhayeditirājaprajāvaśaṅkari śatru kaṇṭhatriśūliniajñānendhanadīptāgne jñānāgne jñānarūpiṇihrīṁ vaiśyāyai namaḥ svāhā śūdrāṃ saṃśodhayedathatrailokyavijaye mātaḥ samādhiphaladā bhavaoṃ amṛte amṛtodbhave amṛtavarṣiṇi padantataḥtrailokyaṃ me tato brūyādvaśamānaya tatparamhasakṣamalavarayūṁ hasarauñca tataḥ paramanayorekatareṇaiva viśodhya vijayāṃ tataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āvāhanyādimudrāñca dhenuyoniñca darśayetdivyadṛṣṭyā padāghātairvighnāṃśca vinivārayettattvamudrāvidhānena hṛdi devīṃ gaṇānvitāmgṛhītvā vāmahastena paṭhedamuṃ manuṃ tataḥmama jihvāgre sthireti bhava sarvapadaṃ likhetsvīkuryāt sādhakaśreṣṭho mumukṣuḥ prasamīkṣayādugdhaghṛtamadhusurāvarṇānāmanupānakamkramāt saṃsevanīyā ca siddhidā siddhimūlikāyathā yathā na hi bhavet prākaṭyaṃ paśumelakena pituḥ sannidhāne vā na mātuḥ sannidhau tathākulapuṣpaṃ kuladravyaṃ kulapūjāṃ kulaṃ japamkulacakraṃ kuladhyānaṃ sarvathā na prakāśayetprakāśānmantranāśaḥ syāt prakāśāddevahiṃsanampūjākāle tu saṃprāpte yadi ko'pyatra gacchatiprakāśādyadi guptiḥ syāttatprakāśaṃ na dūṣaṇamvaraṃ pūjā na kartavyā na ca vyaktiḥ kadācanatāmbūlapūritamukho dhūpāmodasugandhitaḥastreṇa gandhapuṣpābhyāṃ surabhīkṛtahastakaḥnirmañchanaṃ tridhā kṛtvā astreṇa vāmapāṇināaṅguṣṭhāgre tu tarjanyā saṃyojyādhordhvarekhayādhyātvā guruṃ nyasedvāme dakṣiṇe gaṇapatiṃ tathāpārṣṇighātakarāsphoṭa samudañcitavakrakaiḥprāṇāyāmairvinā yasya japahomārcanādikāḥjapasya purataḥ kāryaṃ prāṇāyāmaṃ samāhitaiḥṛtucandrairvedarasairnetrarāmairyathākramam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gurupādaprasādena mā hiṃsanti ca hiṃsakāḥdevatā yadi vāme vai āgacchati kadācanahūṅkāriṇaiva tāṃ kuryāt svadakṣe sādhakottamaḥtathāpi ca baliṃ dattvā aśaktau manasā'thavāśavādikañjale kṣiptvā gṛhaṃ gacchet yathāsukhamsnātvā tatra manuṃ japtvā ayutaṃ sādhakottamaḥbilvamūle nijakroḍe śavamāropya yatnataḥsahasraṃ tatra japtvā vai sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavethastau ca bhūmisaṃlagnau kampamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥnārasiṃhī bhavenmudrā sarvasiddhipradāyikākuṅkumāgurukastūrīrocanāghanacandanamekatra sādhitaṃ kṛtvā pratyekaṃ sādhayennaraḥbījaṃ pratyekaṃ dravyāṇāṃ militānāñca sādhakaḥasya tilakamātreṇa rājānaṃ vaśamānayettenaiva guṭikāṃ kṛtvā tatra kālīṃ prapūjayetjihvāgre rudhiraṃ gṛhṇa cāmuṇḍe ghoraniḥsvanekāli kāli pracaṇḍogre tato'straṃ kavacaṃ tataḥkūrcayugmaṃ tu nīlāyāḥ kathitaṃ mantramuttamamcandrakhaṇḍasamīyuktaṃ tato nīlapadaṃ tataḥsantapteyaṃ mahāvidyā kathitā suradurlabhātena nīlapatākeyaṃ saṃyojyā nīlasādhanebhṛguṃ sargānvitaṃ paścāddīrghaṃ kavacamuddharetmama śatrupadasyānte tato bhakṣapadaṃ vadetrājyaṃ me dehi sambhāṣya bhṛguṃ sargānvitaṃ vadetekacatvāriṃśadarṇo manuḥ prokto dhruvādikaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yā sā vidyā mahātārā sā karāleti kīrttitānamaḥ svāheti mantro'yaṃ daśākṣara udīritaḥebhirāmantritaṃ caiva mūlenaiva sahasrakammahāṣṭamīnavamyostu saṃyoge purataḥ sthitaḥkabandhaṃ muṇḍapuñjañca dīpādibhiralaṃkṛtamtāmbūlapūravaktrañca añjanāñcitalocanamatha pūrvodite sthāne catuṣpathe viśeṣataḥsaptamāṣṭamamāsīyaṃ garbhajaṃ yadi vā śavamānīya sthāpayedādau nyāsajālaṃ samācaretabhyarcya cā'sanaṃ dattvā rakṣāmātmani kārayettato japtvā sarvamantra sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavetśavasthāpanamantro'yaṃ śavāsanamanuṃ tataḥkarakāñcīṃ samādāya muṇḍamālāvibhūṣitaḥśmaśāne ca sakṛjjaptvā sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavettatra sakṛjjapitvā tu devatāmelanaṃ bhavettadbhasmatilakaṃ kṛtvā svayaṃ vīreśvaro bhavetdigvāsā vimalo bhasmabhūṣaṇo muktakeśakaḥtadā tasya mahāsiddhirjāyate śatajāpataḥtatrā'pyānīya sampūjya gajāntakasahasrakammahāśavāḥ praśastāḥ syuḥ pradhānaśavasādhanesarveṣāṃ jīvahīnānāṃ jantūnāṃ nīlasādhaneevaṃ nīlakramaṃ caiva kathitañca śubhāvahamkuje vā śanivāre vā naramuṇḍaṃ samāhitaḥniḥkṣipya bhūmau hastārdhamānataḥ kānanāntareekākī prajapenmantraṃ sa bhavet kalpapādapaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: taddināttaddinaṃ yāvattāvadaṣṭottaraṃ śatamathavā vijane'raṇye'sthiśayyāsano naraḥaṣṭamyāñca caturdaśyāṃ pakṣayorubhayorapitāvajjaptvā nirātaṅkaḥ sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavetnadyāṃ samudragāminyāṃ nābhimāvasthite'mbhasigrāsādvimuktiparyantaṃ japaṃ kuryādananyadhīḥtadante mahatīṃ pūjāṃ kuryād brāhmaṇabhojanamsūryagrahaṇakālāddhi nānyaḥ kālaḥ praśasyateśaratkāle caturthyādi navamyantaṃ viśeṣataḥjapedekākī vijane kevalaṃ timirālayesa bhavet sarvasiddhīśo nātra kāryā vicāraṇāpraviśya mantrī vidhivattāḥ samabhyarcya yatnataḥkevalaṃ kāmabhāvena japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatammahāsiddhirbhavet sadyo latādarśanapūjanātprapūjya tatra saṃskāraṃ kṛtvā tasyai nivedayettāṃ visṛjya namaskṛtya svayaṃ japtvā susaṃyataḥathavā gurumānīya devabhāvena pūjayettatsutaṃ tatsutāṃ caiva patnīṃ caiva viśeṣataḥsahasrāre guroḥ pādapadmaṃ dhyātvā prapūjya cagurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādyathāvibhavavistaraiḥguruṃ vilaṅghya śāstre'sminnā'dhikārī suro'pi caguruvaktraṃ vinā caiva siddhi hāniḥ prajāyateanyathā pretarājasya bhavanaṃ yāti niścitamiti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye caturdaśollāsaḥhomādikaṃ hi viphalaṃ kumārīpūjanaṃ vinā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yathā yathā devatāyā pūjanaṃ vā yathāguroḥyathāśaktyā hi vitaret kumāryai yadyadīpsitampuṣpaṃ kumāryai yaddattaṃ tanmerusadṛśaṃ matamalpamapyathavā mantrahīnaṃ bahuguṇaṃ bhavetkumārīvandanādeva kumārīsadṛśo bhavetkumārī yoginī sākṣāt kumārī sarvadevatāsukumārī mahādevī tridhā mūrttirvyavasthitāyatra kāle na kiñcit syād devāsuramahoragāḥādyasṛṣṭeśca yā śaktiḥ pratyakṣā sā tu tattridhābhūrbhuvomūrttirūpā sā ekā pūjyā kumārikānityakrameṇa deveśi pūjayedvidhipūrvakampūjitāḥ pratigṛhyante nirgacchantyavamānitāḥbhūtavetālagandharvā ḍākinīyakṣarākṣasāḥpṛthivyādīni sarvāṇi brahmāṇḍaṃ sacarācaramte tuṣṭāḥ sarvatuṣṭāśca yastu kanyāṃ prapūjayetghnanti vighnān pūjitāstāstathā śatruṃ mahotkaṭamgrahā yakṣāḥ kṣayaṃ yānti bhūtavetālapannagāḥmahābhayāni durbhikṣamutpātāni sahasraśaḥkumārī pūjanādeva na tasya prabhavanti cacatuṣkaṃ divyavetālaṃ bhavet kumārikārcanātdvitīyavatsarādūrdhvaṃ yāvat syādaṣṭamābdikamathavā ṣoḍaśābdāntaṃ yāvat puṣpaṃ na jāyatebālapriyañca naivedyaṃ balābhāvaviceṣṭitamekavarṣā bhavet sandhyā dvivarṣā ca sarasvatīsubhagā pañcavarṣā ca ṣaḍvarṣā ca umā bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: navabhiḥ kālasaṅkarṣā daśabhiścāparājitātrayodaśe mahālakṣmīrdvisaptā pīṭhanāyikāevaṃ krameṇa pūjyā tu yāvat puṣpaṃ na vidyatemahāparvasu sarveṣu viśeṣaśca pavitrakepiṅgalāṃ pūjayedyastu ṣoḍaśaiścaiva bhaktimānpūjayet kulavidyāñca caikāṃ bālakabhairavīmvāṇī māyā tathā lakṣmīrmāyā kūrcadvayantataḥekādaśasvareṇā'ḍhyo bhṛguvindvinda saṃyutaḥevaṃ dvābhyāṃ tribhiścaiva saptadhā navadhā punaḥvāgbhavena jalaṃ deyaṃ māyayā pādaśaucakamśaktibījena puṣpāṇi dhūpaṃ ṣaṣṭhena dāpayetśrīṃbījena śriyo lābho hrīṃbījenā'risaṅkṣayaḥnyāsādikaṃ prakurvīta ādau svīyakrameṇa tuaiṃ klīṃ śrīṃ klauṃ hsauḥ kulakumārike hṛdayāya namaḥaiṃ klīṃ saiṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭaiṃ siddhi jayāya pūrvavaktrāya namaḥkraṃ kālike dakṣiṇavaktrāya namaḥaṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpi ekāṃ kanyāṃ prapūjayetbhaktibhāvena sampūjya tasyai sarvaṃ nivedayetbālāmalaṅkṛtāṃ paśyan cintayet sveṣṭadevatāmpradakṣiṇatrayaṃ kuryādādimadhye śubhaṃ bhavetpaścācca dakṣiṇā deyā rajatasvarṇamauktikaiḥkumārīpūjane caiva jātimātraṃ na cintayetnānādoṣodbhavā vāpi guṇalāvaṇyasaṃyutāḥyathāyathā tatpriyakṛt sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatkṣaṇāllabhate mokṣaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥte tuṣṭāḥ sarvatuṣṭāśca yastu kanyāṃ prapūjayetgohatyāṃ strīvadhaṃ caiva sarvapāpaṃ praṇaśyatiye tu ye tu puna sarve kanyādānaṃ prakalpayetrudraloke vasennityaṃ trinetro bhagavān hariḥkumārīkalpamākhyātaṃ athavā'nyatamañcaretpūrvavadvidhivadvīro nava bālakamānayetgandhapuṣpākṣatākalpairyathāvibhavavistaraiḥsvakāryaphalasiddhyarthaṃ vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥnavarātrakṛtāṃ pūjāṃ mahādevyai samarpayetevaṃ navakumārīṇāmarcanaṃ prativatsarammano'bhilaṣitaṃ prāpya nivasettavasannidhaupūjayedvidhivadbhaktyā nava rātriṣu mantraviticchāṃ jñānāṃ kriyāṃ durgāṃ vaṭukañca gaṇeśvaramprauḍhollāsena saṃyuktāḥ santuṣṭā yadi cet tadāevaṃ yaḥ pūjayed devīṃ prativarṣaṃ yativrataḥtisro vā pañca vā sapta pūjayed devatādhiyāathavā'nyaprakāreṇa kathyate mithunārcanamgaurīśivo ramāviṣṇū vāṇīsarasijāsanaubhadrakālīvīrabhadrau bhairavībhairavāvapitritārādinamo'ntena tattannāmnā vidhānataḥgandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjya tattvādyaiḥ paritoṣayetevaṃ kṛte na sandehastuṣṭā mithunadevatāḥprativarṣaṃ tu yaḥ kuryād bhaktyā ca mithunārcanambhṛguvāre yajedyatnāt kāntāmārūḍhayauvanām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kulākulāṣṭamāṃ caivā āmantrayā'hūyapuṣpiṇīmātmānaṃ gandhapuṣpādyairalaṃkuryāt susādhakaḥkṛtvā kramārcanaṃ dhūpadīpañca kuladīpakammāṃsādibhakṣyabhojyādyaistoṣayed bhaktibhāvataḥyauvanollāsasahitaḥ svayaṃ taddhyānatatparaḥjapādikaṃ samāpyātha tayā saha niśāṃ nayetpūjayedvidhinā caiva tasya puṇyaṃ na gaṇyateathānyaṃ sampravakṣyāmi samayācāramuttamammānavaḥ kulaśāstrāṇāṃ kulacaryānusāriṇāmparanindāsahiṣṇuḥ syādupakārarataḥ sadācatuṣpathe kalāśūnye yadi daivādgatirbhavetgṛdhraṃ vīkṣya mahākālīṃ namaskuryādalakṣitamkuraraṃ droṇakākaṃ tu kṛṣṇamārjārameva cakṛśodari mahācaṇḍe muktakeśi balipriyeśmaśāne ca śivāṃ dṛṣṭvā pradakṣiṇamanuvrajanghoradaṃṣṭre kaṭhorākṣi kiṭiśabdaninādiniraktavastrāṃ raktapuṣpāṃ vilokya tripurāmbikāmbandhūkapuṣpasaṅkāśe tripure bhayanāśinikṛṣṇavastraṃ tathā puṣpaṃ rājānaṃ rājaputrakammahiṣaṃ kuladevañca dṛṣṭvā mahiṣamardinīmjaya devi jagaddhātri tripurādye tridaivatemadyabhāṇḍaṃ samālokya matsyaṃ māṃsaṃ varastriyamghoravighnavināśāya kulācārasamṛddhayeraktadhārāsamākīrṇavadane tvāṃ namāmyahameteṣāṃ darśane caiva yadi naivaṃ prakurvate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: eteṣāṃ māraṇoccāṭahiṃsanaṃ vā bhayādibhiḥpradhānāṃśasamudbhūtā ete kulajanāḥ priyelabdhasiddhisamāyogāt ḍākinīhiṃsanaṃ yadibaṭukānāṃ bhairavāṇāṃ tasya siddhirna jāyateyaṃ dṛṣṭvā yuvatī nārī kalākuśalasaṃyutāutkṣipya bhujamūlasya vāsasaṃ kṣipyate yadikaṇḍūyabhāvavyājena śithilīkṛtavāsasāskhalat pādayugāt pādaṃ patitā punarutthitāityādibhāvabhāvitāṃ dṛṣṭvā sādhakasattamaḥtatra sthitvā punaḥ kṣobhaṃ kuryāt kāma vāparaḥvidagdhāṃ vā mahābhraṣṭāṃ kutsitāṃ vāpi hīnajāmsambhogena vinopekṣāṃ na kuryācca kadācanakruddhā bhagavatī tasya śāpaṃ dadyāt sudāruṇamniṣkṛtirnāsti tasyaiva yāvadācandratārakammahādevyai vinā dattvā na bhoktavyaṃ kadācananamaskuryāt prayatnena caṇḍikāṃ sādhakottamaḥyadā kuryāttadā natvā devīṃ yātrāṃ samācarettatra devyai nivedyaiva karttavyañca prapūjanamvane vā durgamevāpi yadi gacchati sādhakaḥtarpaṇādau prakurvīta tṛpyatāṃ brahmabhairavatṛpyatāṃ bhairavī mātā pitā bhairava tṛpyatāmjyotiṣṭomāśvamedhādau yatra yaṃ yaṃ prapūjayetstriyo dṛṣṭvā tathaikatra yuvatyatimanoharāḥdadyāttattatpriyaṃ dravyaṃ manasā cintya caṇḍikāmkanyāyā bhāṣaṇe śrīmattripurāyāḥ prapūjanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ vadet pradāne tu kanyakāyāḥ prapūjaneatrā'śakto bhavedyastu tasyārthaṃ likhyate stavaḥśrīrmālinī ca siddhā'mbā mahātripurasundarīsampradāyāḥ kulaṃ kaulā rahasyātirahasyagāḥbhagamālā nityaklinnā bheruṇḍā vahnivāsinīnityā nīlapatākā ca vijayā sarvamaṅgalāpūrṇākhyā ca tathā jñeyā kāmeśī modinī tathāsarveśvarī tathā kaulī vāgīśī sarvakāminīsvapnāvatī śūlinī ca mātaṅgī surasundarīprāṇavidyā tathaikākṣī caikapādā mahāṅkuśātrikhaṇḍā triśirā śaurī gaurī vindhyanivāsinīkālī kuṇḍamayī kuṇḍarūpiṇī bandhurūpiṇīkṣobhiṇī nādinī bhadrā lalitā bahurūpikātroṭeśvarī mahāvidyāḥ kathitāstava bhairavamanuścandraḥ kuberaśca manmathastadanantaramkrodhabhaṭṭārakaścaiva pañcamī ca prakīrttitāaurvo vahniryamaścaiva nair-ṛto varuṇastathāaniroddho bharadvājo dakṣiṇāmūrttireva cadhātrī śeṣaḥ pramattaśca unmattaḥ kulabhairavaḥprahlādaḥ śukadevaśca rāmo rāvaṇa eva cabṛhaspatiryaduśreṣṭho dattātreyo yudhiṣṭhiraḥduryodhanastathā kuntī sītā ca rukmiṇī tathāpuṣpadanto mahābuddho bāṇaḥ kālaśca mandaraḥnārado bhīṣmakarṇau ca meruścāruṇa eva camahāvidyāprasādena svasvakarma samanvitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prātaḥkāle śucirbhūtvā yaḥ paṭhet prayatātmanāaśucirvā nirālambo sālambo vā kulāntikecakrasaṅketakaṃ caiva gurusaṅketakaṃ tathāsamayācārasaṅketamakṛtvā yo'tra varttateevaṃ stotraṃ paṭhitvā tu saṅketamānayed dhruvamatha vaiśākhamāsasya śuklapratipadīśvarimanojñe rahasi sthāne pūrvābhimukhamāsthitaḥkṛtvā puroditān nyāsān devatābhāvamāsthitaḥarghyaṃ nivedya taccheṣaṃ śaktyā saha pibettataḥdhyāyaṃstanmaṇḍale devīmaṣṭottarasahasrakamevaṃ śuklapratipadaṃ samārabhya dine dineamāvasyādine dhīraḥ pūjayed bhaktakaulikānevaṃ yo māsamātrantu kuryāt sūryodayārcanamyatkiñcidudite sūrye maṇḍale sveṣṭadevatāmṣoḍaśairupacāraistu cakrapūjāpuraḥsarammadhyāhne pūjayedvāpi sāyāhne vāpi pūjayetkāṅkṣitāṃ labhate siddhiṃ devavadvicaredbhuvisnātvā śuklāmbaradharaḥ sāyaṃ sandhyāmupāsya cayauvanollāsasahitaścandrasthāṃ devatāṃ smarancandrāstodayaparyantaṃ japenmantramananyadhīḥpaurṇamāsyāṃ yathāśaktyā pūjayecchaktikaulikānsarvapāpaviśuddhātmā sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥśuklapakṣārcanaṃ yadvattadvat pakṣe sitetareiha bhuktvā'khilān bhogān devavat priyadarśanaḥatha kārttikamāsasya śuklapratipadi dhruvam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāmā ca madhyamā caiva tathā dakṣiṇanāḍibhiḥprāṇāyāmaḥ sa vijñeyastarjanīmadhyame vināuccārayaṃstu praṇavaṃ vāmenaikena mantravitprāṇāyāmo bhavatyevaṃ pūrako dehapūrakaḥsampūrṇakumbhavattiṣṭhet prāṇāyāma sa kumbhakaḥniśvāsayogayuktastu vāyuṃ vāhyena recayetjānupradakṣiṇīkṛtya na drutaṃ na vilambitamtato dvādaśamātrābhiḥ pūrakaḥ kriyate budhaiḥtasmād dviguṇamātrābhiḥ kriyate kumbhakastathāliṅgaṃ kāryaṃ hṛdisthaṃ tu caitanyaṃ sarvasākṣiṇamtenaiva saṃpuṭīkṛtya mastakopari vinyasetnābhimaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ vāyumaṇḍalamadhyagamagnimaṇḍalasaṃsthena raṃbījenāgnirūpiṇābhrūmadhyasthaṃ hṛdisthaṃ vā dhyāyedvaruṇamaṇḍalamtatrasthena vakāreṇa plāvayenmadhurūpiṇāpraṇavena dvidhākṛtya tatra caitanyarūpiṇāamṛtaplāvitaḥ piṇḍaḥ sa martyo dhautakalmaṣaḥprāṇāyāmañca kathitaṃ bhūtaśuddhiṃ tathāparamprāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā bhūtaśuddhiṃ tataścarettāvattadviphalaṃ sarvaṃ prakāśenāpyanuṣṭhitamnyāsajālaṃ vṛthā tasya pūjā sā viphalā bhavetmūlādhārāttataḥ prāṇaṃ brahmamārgeṇa tāntrikaḥsaṃhārakramayogena pañcatattvaṃ samuddharetanena vidhinā mantrī bhūtaśuddhiṃ samācaretsvadehe devatājīvaṃ vinyasettadanantaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prasupte jīvaloke tu muditātmā mahāniśiājyenānāmikāṅguṣṭhe varttiṃ prajvālya sādhakaḥmadhusampūrṇakalase kāṃsyapātre manoharedīpe sāvaraṇāṃ devīṃ dhyātvā vidhivadarcayetaṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu japenmantramananyadhīḥamāvasyādine śaktyā pūjayet śaktikaulikānsarvakāmasamṛddhātmā sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥaṣṭāṣṭakārcanaṃ kuryācchaktaścedekavāsaredvātriṃśaddivaseṣveva catuḥṣaṣṭidineṣu vākramajñaścet svayaṃ kuryādvittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥmaṅgalādyaiśca nipuṇairaṣṭabhiḥ śaktibhistathāakṣobhyādicatuḥṣaṣṭimithunāni samarcayetkramalopaṃ na kurvīta sveṣṭakāyārthasiddhayebhakṣyabhojyādibhirnānāpadārthaiḥ ṣaḍrasānvitaiḥprauḍhāntollāsaparyantaṃ kuryāt śrīcakrapūjanambrahmaviṣṇumaheśādi devatābhiḥ sa pūjyateyadarcanāccatuḥṣaṣṭi yoginīgaṇasaṃstutaḥpunarāvṛttirahito nivasecchivasannidhaukulapūjāṃ vinā cakre nādhikāraḥ kathañcanakulapūjāṃ suniyataṃ yaḥ karoti sa kaulikaḥnīco'pi vā sakṛd bhaktyā kārayed yaḥ kulārcanamtasmāt sarvaprayatnena sarvāvasthāsu sarvadāvedaśāstroktamārgeṇa kulapūjāṃ karoti yaḥidaṃ satyamidaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥiti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye pañcadaśollāsaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: adīkṣitakulo yo hi sādhanaṃ samupācaretadīkṣitakulāsaṅgāt siddhihāniḥ prajāyatesa kulīnaḥ kathaṃ caiva pūjayet parameśvarīmyatkule kuladīkṣā tu na syāt pāpī sa eva hiparayoṣā yadi syācca svayaṃ tasyā gururbhavetkulabhaktaṃ guruṃ prārthya dīkṣayet kuladīkṣayāgaṇeśo gāṇapatyaśca gaṇadīkṣāprabhuryataḥkulīnaḥ sarvamantrāṇāmadhikārī bhavet sadādīkṣāyāṃ kulapūjāyāṃ śiṣyatve yadi vā gurauadhastāt dṛṣṭipātena tasya vidyā'pyadhomukhīpārśvāvalokanenaiva vyādhidāridryapīḍitāetādṛśaṃ kulaṃ caiva yadi kuryāt kathañcanaetādṛśa kulasyāgre prayogaḥ phalado na hiparānandarasāghūrṇahṛdayā lolalocanātāmbūlapūritamukhī sindūrāñjanasaṃyutādevīvāhaṃ devadeva upadeśaṃ samācaraityuktvā sarvaśṛṅgāraveśāḍhyaḥ sthiramānasaḥtadgātre deyamantrasya nyāsajālaṃ pravinyasetśakticakraṃ tridhā'veṣṭya tatra kāmakalāṃ likhettatra devīṃ samāvāhya dhyātvā tāṃ tu prapūjayetmūlavidyāṃ tridhā'vṛttyā kathayet vāmakarṇakemātṛpitṛkṛtaṃ nāma varjayitvā vadettataḥsakulājñāṃ samādāya lajjālasyavivarjitāityanujñāṃ gurorlabdhvā praṇameddaṇḍavad bhuvihṛtpādāmbhoruhacchāyāṃ dehi mūrdhni yaśodhana
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvasvaṃ gurave dadyāttadardhaṃ vā dayāyujestutvā natvā yathāśaktyā svakalpoktaṃ samācaretpūjārhā ca yadā devī tadā mātā na saṃśayaḥtatkṛtvā tena pāpena ubhau narakagāminauna karttavyaṃ na karttavyaṃ na ca vākyaṃ kadācanasāṅgāvaraṇapūjādau yadā na kṣaraye kulamtarpayitvā kulaṃ dhyātvā japenmantraṃ nirākulaḥna nyāso yoṣitāñcāpi na dhyānaṃ na ca pūjanamsarvavidyāprayogaṃ tu tataḥ kuryāt susādhakaḥyatprāpya kuladevena labhyate vāñchitaṃ mahatamṛtaṃ varṣate sā tu tridinaṃ pṛthivītalepūrṇameva bhavettasya saphalaṃ ca manorathamānīya pramadāṃ divyāṃ pramattāṃ yauvanānvitāmsarvadānandahṛdayāṃ ghṛṇālajjāvivarjitāmsvakāntāṃ parakāntāṃ vā saṃsthāpya tūlikoparitasyāstu madanāgāre pūjayet parameśvarīmśivahīnā yadā śaktiḥ sarvādau varṣate hi yattaddravyaprāptimātreṇa kiṃ na sidhyati bhūtalesvecchā ṛtumatī śaktiḥ sākṣāddevī maheśvarīvastrālaṅkārapuṣpaiśca śaktiñca paripūjayetkulapuṣpaṃ tadeva syāt sarvasiddhipradāyakamkuṇḍodbhavaṃ siddhipradaṃ prakārāntaramucyatesvakalpoktaṃ samācarya sādhako jitamānasaḥpūjayedakṣataiḥ śuddhaiḥ tasyā madanamandiramśuddhamantrauṣadhenaiva mathayenmadanālayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gṛhṇīyāttat prayatnena dravyaṃ kuṇḍodbhavaṃ śubhameteṣāṃ dravyamadhye tu svayambhūkusumaṃ mahatlabdhvā tatparamaṃ dravyaṃ lākṣārasasamanvitamraktena candanenāpi vaṭīṃ kṛtvā sugopayetlikhitvā pūjayedbhaktyā yāṃ tithiṃ prāpya sādhakaḥprabuddhāstatprayogena yāvat sā punarāgatātithikrameṇa sā devī paurṇamāsyāṃ phalapradākṣīṇāti pūrṇatāṃ yāti yāvat sā tithirāgatāevaṃ yathā prabuddhā sā naiva tādṛk kadācanayoginyaśca mahānāgā rākṣasādānavāśca yeetenākṣatayogān madhumatīsiddhimālabhetatha vakṣye ca śāktānāṃ kāmyapūjanamuttamamvidhivallikhite yantre kulācāreṇa rātrikejanmāntarakṛtāḥ sarve nāśamāyānti niścitamjavāpuṣpaiścakrarājaṃ pūjayenmāsamātrakambrahmahatyādi pāpāṃśca pūrvajanmakṛtānapiketakītaruṇaiḥ patraiḥ pūrvavat pūjayecchivāmsaubhāgyamatulaṃ tasya jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥpūrvavat parameśāni sarvapāpaṃ vināśayetmāsamātreṇa hantyeva pātakān pūrvajanmajānśvetapadmairmahādevīṃ pūjayed bhaktibhāvataḥmāsamātreṇa sakalān mokṣastasya kare sthitaḥtrailokyaṃ vaśagaṃ tasya sarvapāpaṃ praṇāśayetpūrvavat parameśānīṃ māsamātraṃ na saṃśayaḥmallikāmālatījātīkundaiśca śatapatrakaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kulācārakrameṇaiva pātakān śatajanmajānmuktistasya kare satyaṃ vācāṃpatisamo bhuvipūrvakrameṇa sampūjya māsamātraṃ prayatnadhīḥcampakaiḥ pāṭalairdevīṃ bakulairnāgakeśaraiḥsaubhāgyamaṇḍalaṃ tasya māsamātreṇa niścitamśamīdūrvāṅkurāśvatthapallavairathavā'rkajaiḥathātaḥ sarvavidyānāṃ likhyate siddhikāraṇamcatuṣpathe vā nadyāṃ vā vaṭamūle triśūlakesindūreṇa likhenmantraṃ vipulaṃ sādhyadarbhitamtarpayitvā tadantaḥsthaḥ prajapenniśicārataḥatha rātrau puṇyagehe udyāne vā surālayetataḥ pūrvoktarūpeṇa kulakṣobhaṃ samācaretpuṣpāṇi racayedvīro māṇikyaghaṭitāni canānāpuṣpaiḥ sugandhaiśca karpūrakṣodacarcitaiḥdāsabhūtāḥ bhavantyeva mahārogāṃśca nāśayetmuktāratnarañjitāni svarṇapuṣpāṇi sādhakaiḥekaviṃśatirātreṇa rājaputrī vaśībhavetpravālaghaṭitaiḥ svarṇapuṣpaistu bahubhiryajetpuṣpaiśca vividhaiścaiva saptāhācca suniścitamtathā marakatakṣiptasvarṇapuṣpaiśca pūjayetvidhivat tasya varadā bhairavī bhavati sthiramkusumairarcayeccakraṃ trisaptāhāt suniścitamsuvarṇaracitaiḥ puṣpairvajrakeśaravarjitaiḥdevā daityāvaśāṃstasya jāyante nātra saṃśayaḥekaviṃśatirātreṇa tathā nīlaiśca nīrajaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gomedaghaṭitaiḥ puṣpaiḥ svarṇapuṣpairyajed budhaḥsaptāhād vairiṇo vaśyā ghātasteṣu prajāyatesvarṇaratnamayaiḥ puṣpairpunarnavaiḥ prapūjyatekravyādayastadvaśyā hi bhavantyeva na saṃśayaḥsacampakādibhirdhīrastrailokyaṃ stambhayet kṣaṇātnirmālyabhūtaiḥ kusumairarcitaiḥ parameśvarīmtadā devāśca munayaḥ pannagā rākṣasādayaḥjanmakoṭibhavaṃ pāpaṃ nāśayennātra saṃśayaḥtadāśvamedhadaśakaphalaṃ bhavati sarvadāpūrvoditasvapuṣpaiśca pūjā kāryā susādhakaiḥtatra tatraiva dātavyaṃ yaddātavyaṃ sukhecchayākevalaṃ yonipuṣpaistu trailokyaṃ stambhayedbhṛśamnāśayenmohayet sarvānsamudravalayāṃ dharāmśuklāmbaradharo dhīraḥ śuklagandhādibhūṣitaḥśuklago brahmacārī tu śuklāsanaparigrahaḥpiṣṭakaṃ pāyasaṃ dugdhaṃ annaṃ bahuvidhaṃ tathākṛtasaṅkalpavīrendraḥ sādhayedvāgbhavākṣaramkūrparadhavalāṃ śubhrapuṣpābharaṇabhūṣitāmmuktāphalasamudbhūtajapamālālasatkarāmevaṃ dhyātvā prapūjyaiva vāgīśīṃ sādhakottamaḥtasmājjotirmayīṃ dhyāyet jihvāgre'mṛtarūpiṇīmtataśca naṣṭahṛdayo grāmyo mūrkho'tipātakījaḍo mūrkho'tidurmedhā gataprajño vinaṣṭadhīḥsatpaṇḍitaghaṭāṭopajetā'pratihataprabhaḥkumāratarasphāra vṛttālaṅkārapūrvakaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vedavedāṅgavedāntasiddhāntajñānapāragaḥpurāṇarasavādādigāruḍānekamantravitvicitracitrakarmādiśilpānekavicakṣaṇaḥnānāśāstrādiśikṣādivettābhuvanaviśrutaḥatha kāmakalāsaktaḥ sādhako raktamandireraktavastrāvṛtaḥ samyaṅmadhye kāmakalātmanānānopahārabalibhiḥ kuṅkumādibhirarcayetbandhūkakusumākārakāntibhūṣaṇabhūṣitāmyathoktasaṃkhyaṃ sañjapya kāmarājaṃ susādhakaḥrājāno vaśamāyānti pannagā rākṣasāḥ surāḥmanaścintitayoṣittu dāsīvadvaśagābhavetvidyādharī kinnarī vā yakṣī nāgāṅganā'thavājvalanmadanaduṣprekṣyadahanottaptamānasāniveditātmasarvasvā vaśagā tasya jāyatecintitā yoṣitāṃ yonau kṣobhayati ca tatkṣaṇātsammohonmādanāropacittakarṣakarī tathādhāraṇāsamprayogeṇa karoti vaśagaṃ jagatraktavarṇāṃ striyaṃ dhyātvā tadīyamahasā tataḥdhyāyan sammohayennārīṃ madanottaptamānasāmetatkāmakalādhyānāt pañcakāma ivāparaḥyantraṃ vidadhyāt kāmastu manmathāntargato bhavetmakaradhvajasañjñantu sarvametat susādhakaḥtrailokyamohano nāma prayogo'yaṃ pradarśitaḥsṛṣṭisaṃhāraparyantāṃ śarīre cintayet parāmhemaprabhābhāsamānāṃ vidyullatāsamaprabhām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jñānamudrāñca dadhatīṃ sākṣādamṛtarūpiṇīmpūrvasaṃkhyaṃ japedbījaṃ nānāvighnaṃ vināśayetvainateyasamo mantrī viṣabhāraṃ vināśayetbhūtapretapiśācāṃśca nāśayennātra saṃśayaḥduṣṭavyādhigrahāṃścaiva ḍākinīrūpikā gaṇāḥathavā yena vidyeyaṃ paripūrṇā vicintyatepadmarāgamaṇisvacchā cintanāt sādhakasya catannāmasmaraṇānmantrī yoginīnāṃ bhavet priyaḥputravān dhanavān dhīro mantraṃ dhyātvā na saṃśayaḥprayacchati mahādevī khecarīsiddhimuttamāmcakrametat samāsādya sthitāstā nātra saṃśayaḥkṣobhayet svargabhūrloka pātālatalavāsinaḥvāgbhavāt vākpatitvañca kāmāt kāmasamo bhavetsarvasiddhirbhavatyeva kūṭatrayasya jāpataḥiti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye ṣoḍaśollāsaḥyasya vijñānamātreṇa kṣipraṃ vidyā prasīdatitatra yaśca bhramāvartto'pāna ityucyate budhaiḥgacchantī brahmarandhre'pi praviśantī svaketanetena mantraśikhā jātā sarvamantrapradīpikāśikhāhīnāstathā mantrā na sidhyanti kadācanavinā'nena na sidhyanti kalpakoṭiśatairapipunaḥ pralīyate tasyāṃ kālāgnyādiśivāntikātasyāstu bandhamātreṇa tannāsti yanna sādhayetnāsau sidhyati mantraśca satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ punaḥdagdhāḥ santrāsitā hīnā malināstu tiraskṛtāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vṛddhā bālāstathā srastāḥ prauḍhā yauvanagarvitāḥaṃśakena vihīnāśca khaṇḍaśaḥ śatadhā kṛtāḥsiddhimokṣapradāḥ sarve sādhakena niyojitāḥtattat sidhyatyanāyāsād yonimudrānibandhanāttato'dhikārī tantre'smin bhavet sādhakasattamaḥnā'sau lipyati pāpena yonimudrānibandhanātkṛtvā pāpasahasrāṇi asaṃkhyātāni sarvadāduṣṭamantrāśca sidhyanti mantrāścānye tu kiṃ punaḥsthānadhyānaviniryuktāḥ susiddhā api vairiṇaḥsakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ sūkṣmaṃ tathā sakalaniṣkalamsakalaṃ brahmabandhasthaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ viddhi niṣkalambindusthitaṃ kalābhinnaṃ kalātītaṃ tadūrdhvataḥeṣu sthānaṅgatā mantrāḥ sthānasthāḥ parikīrttitāḥdhyānasthāścaiva te mantrā vijñeyāḥ sādhakena vāyasya yatra dṛḍhā bhaktirjāyate satataṃ yadiathātaḥ sarvavidyānāṃ likhyate siddhikāraṇamcatuṣpathe vā nadyāṃ vā vaṭamūle triśūlakesindūreṇa likhed yantraṃ vipulaṃ sādhyadarbhitamtarpayitvā tadantaḥsthaṃ prajapenniśicārataḥrātrau puṇyagṛhe caiva udyāne vā surālayetataḥ pūrvoktarūpeṇa kulakṣobhaṃ samācaretpīṭhānāṃ paramaṃ pīṭhaṃ kāmarūpaṃ mahāphalamvihāya sarvapīṭhāni tasya dehe vasecchivāyatra koṭigaṇaiḥ sārdhamādyā vasati mardinīyato devyaśca devāśca munayaścaiva bhāvajāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvividhaṃ caiva tatpīṭhaṃ guptaṃ vyaktaṃ sadā paśauvyaktaṃ sarvatra deveśa labhyate kulasundaraiḥathavā'nyaprakāreṇa kathyate sādhanaṃ mahatupacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhistāṃ sampūjya vidhānataḥmantraṃ vilikhya yathoktaṃ pūjayet kulavartmanāmahābhāgāṃ tato mūladevīmāvaraṇaiḥ sahatatra pīṭhe yoganidrāṃ pūjayitvā tato yajetkāmarūpaṃ tato gatvā tatra kātyāyanīṃ yajettato jālandhare gatvā pūrṇeśīṃ prathamaṃ yajettataḥ pūrṇagiriṃ gatvā yajeccaṇḍīṃ samāhitaḥsindūrabindupīṭhe ca kāmākhyāṃ prathamaṃ yajetevaṃ pīṭheśvarīṃ japtvā pūjayediṣṭadevatāmsaṃkhyāpūrvaṃ tataḥ pṛcchenmahādevī kulottamamtataḥ praṇamya deveśīṃ vṛṇuyādvaramuttamamakṣobhitaḥ kulācāraparicaryāparo bhavettataḥ prasannā bhavati saiva kulavarapriyātato dhyātvā nyasedādau mātṛkāntarasañjñakamakārādikṣakārāntamekaikakramayogataḥmūrddhādicaraṇāntañca tasmānmūrddhāvasānakamdhyāyet kālīṃ mahādaityayuddharāgamahonmukhīmvāme śaṅkhaṃ tathā carma dhanustarjanameva capitāmbaradharāṃ devīṃ pīnonnatakucadvayāmevaṃ dhyātvā mahādevīṃ mānasairupacārakaiḥtataḥ so'haṃ vibhāvyātha puṣpaṃ niḥkṣipya mastakekṛtvā ca pūrvavadvīraḥ sadāśivaṃ yajettataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jīvanyāse manuḥ prokto jīvanyāseṣu yojayetkramāt prāṇā iha prāṇāstathā jīva iha sthitaḥvāṅmanonayanaśrotraghrāṇaprāṇapadānyathaathavā pāśabījañca lajjā cāṅkuśameva cajīvanyāsamanuḥ prokto jīvanyāseṣu yojayetṣaḍaṅgānāñca mudrāñca sthānañca mantramucyatehṛdi maste śikhāyāñca kavace locanāstrakeṛṣiśchandaśca saṃyuktaṃ devatābījaśaktikamśirovadanahṛdguhyapādasarvāṅgake nyasetpañcāśadakṣaranyāse yadviśeṣastaducyatetarjanīmadhyamānāmā vṛddhānāmā ca netrayoḥmadhyāstisro gaṇḍayośca madhyamāmoṣṭhayornyasetmukhe'nāmāṃ madhyamāñca haste pāde ca pārśvayoḥtāḥ sāṅguṣṭhā nābhideśe sarvāḥ kukṣau ca vinyasethatpūrvaṃ hastapat kukṣimukheṣu talameva caajñātvā vinyasedyastu nyāsaḥ syāttasya niṣphalaḥomādyantyo namo'nto vā sabindurbinduvarjitaḥathavā kevalaṃ sargabinduyuktāṃ kalānvitāmśaktipūrvāṃ śriyā yuktāṃ sudhāsyāṃ vā tanau nyasetajapā paramātmā ca dviṭhaprapañcayāgakaḥyasya yatra rucirgacchettadrūpāttattanau ca tāmspṛṣṭvā vānāmayā vāpi manasā vā nyasedbudhaḥprāṇāyāmādibhirnyāsaiḥ ātmaśuddhiśca jāyateiti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye dvitīyollāsaḥantaryāgavidhiṃ kṛtvā bahiryāgaṃ samācaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yantramadhye samāvāhya mūlena parikalpitāmsampūjya ca mahādevīṃ pūjayettadanantaramśāktaṃ japtvā ca gurvādīn nāradañca tato yajetdurgā ca prathamā jñeyā dvitīyā varavarṇinīkṛttikā pañcamī proktā ṣaṣṭhī caivābhayapradāāyudhāni dalāgreṣu yādibhiḥ kramato yajettadastrāṇi bahirjaptvā tarpayittvā vidhānataḥtarpayitvā mahādevīṃ mantrajāpaṃ samācaretkulācārasya saṃsiddhyai bhuktimuktisusiddhayeaṣṭākṣarī samākhyātā vidyā mahiṣamardinīna kasmaicit pravaktavyā kathitā siddhikāriṇītadāṣṭavargā dātavyā saphalaṃ tasya sādhanamvadhūbījādikāṃ vāpi kavacādyāṃ japettadāvāgbhavādyāṃ japet tāṃ tu devīṃ vākyaviśuddhayeetatpūrvasthitā devī surasiddhividhāyinīgurūṇāṃ kulanāthānāṃ māyāpāśavimocinīaṣṭalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ hunettataḥyathāśakti japaṃ kṛtvā samāpyātha stutiṃ paṭhetbhaktebhyo varade devi mahiṣaghni namo'stutekarālavadane śyāme namaste surasundariraktamāṃsasamākīrṇavadane tvāṃ namāmyahamvisarjanaṃ vidhāyātha prayogañca tataścaretathātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi dūtīyajanamuttamamyasmāt kṣipraṃ bhavet siddhirnānyathā janmakoṭibhiḥkiṃ japanyāsavidhinā dhyānapūjādivistaraiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gandharvarūpavān bhūtvā yonau sampūjya sādhakaḥtrikoṇeṣu trayo devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥtatra vidyāṃ jagaddhātrīṃ kulāmṛtaiḥ kulakramāttatra yatra kriyate pūjā japaṃ vā tarpaṇaṃ punaḥyuvatīyonimāsthāya sarvasiddhirbhavedyataḥsarvālaṅkārasaṃyukto raktavastravibhūṣitaḥsvakalpoktaṃ prakurvīta nyāsādikaṃ susādhakaḥarghyapātre pratiṣṭhānaṃ kāryaṃ hetujalena capuṣpānyakāryamadhye ca uparyupari pūjayetādhāraśaktiṃ kūrmañca tathānantavarāhakamkeśarāṇi ca sampūjya karṇikāyāṃ yajettataḥapūrvān pūjayedetān sādhakaḥ siddhihetavepūjayitvā tataścaiva gururūpān samarcayetsadanuṣṭhānaniratāṃ sāttvikībhaktisaṃyutāmcāturyaudāryadākṣiṇyakaruṇādiguṇānvitāmmanogṛhītaviśvāsāṃ yadvā saṅketamāgatāmviliptāṃ raktavastreṇa raktagandhavibhūṣitāmsudhūpairdhūpitāṃ tanvīṃ dūtīkarmaṇi yojayettasya gātre svakalpoktaṃ nyāsajālaṃ vidhāya cajaptvā ca hūnikāmadhye prasūnaiśca sugandhibhiḥsamākīrṇe suparyaṅke pūjayet kulanāyikāmbaṭukaṃ gaṇapaṃ durgāṃ kṣetrapālaṃ tathaiva catrikoṇe pūjayenmūrdhni kāmeśīṃ tasya madhyagetrikoṇe pūjayitvā tu vasantaṃ madanaṃ tathādakṣapādādimūrdhāntaṃ vāmamūrdhādikaṃ tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śraddhā prītīratiścaiva dūtiḥ kāntirmanoramāmohinī dīpanī caiva śoṣaṇī caiva śaṅkarīṣoḍaśasvarasaṃyuktā etāḥ kāmakalā yajetṛddhiḥ saumyā marīciśca tathā caivāṃśumālinītathā tuṣṭāmṛte caiva kalāḥ somasya ṣoḍaśatasyāstu madanāgāre pūjayed bhagamālinīmathodari bhagānte ca bhagamāle bhagāvahesarvabhagavaśaṅkari bhagarūpe tataḥ parambhagāni me hyānayānte varade'tha samālikhetkledaya drāvayā'moghe bhagavicce tataḥ paramsattvān bhageśvari brūyāt vāgbhavaṃ blūṃ jamādikamsarvāṇi bhagāni me vaśamānaya coddharetbhagamālāñca nityāñca ṅeyutāṃ manumuddharetsarvānandamaye madhye cakrarājaṃ samarcayettatrāpyāvāhanaṃ nāsti jīvanyāsaṃ tathaiva catārañca bhuvaneśānīṃ tripurāyāstrayaṃ tataḥanena manunā mantrī svaliṅge pūjayecchivamnivṛttiñca pratiṣṭhāṃ ca vidyāṃ śāntiṃ tataḥ paramsamagravidyāmuccārya tattrikoṇe prapūjayetsarvasaṅkṣobhaṇīṃ mudrāṃ baddhvā yoniṃ vicālayettarjanyau daṇḍavat kṛtvā madhyamoparyanāmikekṣobhayedathavā mantrī gajahastākhyamudrayāniḥkṣipedaṅgulīḥ sarvā gajatuṇḍākṛtiryathāuccaredbhagamālāñca drāviṇībījamuccaranrajomayaṃ rajaḥ sākṣāt saṃvideva na saṃśayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śivaśaktisamāyogo yoga eva na saṃśayaḥāliṅganañca kastūrī karpūraṃ cumbanaṃ bhavetlīlādikaṃ dhūpadīpaṃ kucamardaṃ śivārcanamkuladravyeṇa saṃśodhya śivaśaktimayo bhavetkuṇḍe triguṇasampanne śrībindunilaye pareviviktuḥ kutsanaparo jāyate gurutalpagaḥtarpayitvā mahādevīṃ śaktaye dakṣiṇāṃ dadettrividhaṃ tripurāyāśca kathitaṃ pūjanaṃ mahattadā suvistaraiḥ stavaiḥ sarvāṇi pariśodhayetaśvamedhādiyajñādau vājihatyā kathaṃ bhavetpaiṣṭībhavaṃ dhānyabhavaṃ tathā cakravinirmitammādakaṃ dharmasañchedāt varjyamāhurmanīṣiṇiḥbrahmahatyāsurāpānasvarṇasteyādipātakānvicārayet sadā sarvaṃ sattarkeṇa susādhakaḥmīnaṃ na bhuñjate hanta vidhavā tat kathaṃ payaḥjalaṃ jalacaraṃ viddhi ghaṭapūrṇaṃ samānayetanāmiṣaṃ nāsti kiñcit sarvaṃ kṣīrādikaṃ tathāsarvabhūteṣu vijñānaṃ tathā jñeyaṃ susādhakaiḥtatkāṣṭhaṃ dahyate tena tathā brahmamayaṃ jagatyajñayuktasya nānyasya anyathā pātakaṃ bhavetdharmādharmaparijñānāt saṃskārācca pavitratāvicārayenmantravittu bhrāntireva na saṃśayaḥkathaṃ taddūṣaṇaṃ yena prāpyate paramaṃ padambindustu paramaṃ dravyaṃ kāyo'yaṃ śivarūpakaḥpṛthivyāpastato vāyurākāśaṃ candrasūryakau
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pitṛtastrīṇi jāyante majjāsthisnāyureva caṣāṭkauṣikamidaṃ proktaṃ śarīraṃ paramarṣibhiḥśarīraṃ yadi śuddhaṃ syāttadā tatra na dūṣaṇamtataḥ pavitraṃ dehasya kāraṇaṃ kena dūṣyatesavikalpo yadi bhavet pāpabhāgjāyate naraḥnānājīvamayaṃ tattu purīṣaṃ kena dūṣyatetenodakena yajjātaṃ mūtraṃ kena ca dūṣitammale mūtre ca yo doṣo bhrāntireva na saṃśayaḥtato vicārya matimān sādhakastarkaśodhitaḥpūjyapūjakabhedaśca mithyaiva paramārthataḥsarvaṃ brahmamayaṃ viddhi sattarkeṇa sasādhakaḥtarpayitvā mahādevīṃ śaktyā yaddakṣiṇāṃ dadetvakṣye'haṃ sarvaśāktānāṃ dūtīyajanamuttamamsaṃsthāpya tatra śaktiñca pūrvavadapi pūjayetpūjayecca tatastasyāṃ pañca kāmān samāhitaḥkāma bījañca kandarpa manmathañca tataḥ parampraṇavādinamo'ntañca krameṇa gandhapuṣpakaiḥvaṭukaṃ bhairavaṃ caiva durgāñca kṣetrapālakammahāpretāsanaṃ madhye bālāmeva prapūjayetdurgāṃ bhruvostathā lakṣmīṃ rasanāyāṃ sarasvatīmmukhe sudhānidhiṃ pṛṣṭhe glūṃ bījānantaroditampūjyāḥ kāmakalāstasyāḥ nāyikā'ṅgeṣu sarvaśaḥbhūtiḥ kāntirmanojñā ca vimalā modinī tathādīpanī śoṣaṇī caiva vaśaṅkarī tathā punaḥtataścandrakalāḥ pūjyā āśiraścaraṇāvadhi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṛddhiśca saumyā marīcirbahumāyā tataḥ paramtuṣṭistathā'mṛtā caiva pūjyāścandrakalā imāḥbhagamālāmanuṃ procya pūjayettadanantaramjaṃ blūñcaiva tataḥ klinne sarvāṇīti tato vadetstrīṃ sphrīṃ kledinī bījaṃ klīṃ klīṃ ca tataḥ parampūjayitvā tataścakraṃ nijadevīṃ tato yajetdhūpairdīpaiśca naivedyairvividhaiḥ kulasādhakaḥarcayed gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ svaśivaṃ tadanantaramnamaḥ śabdaṃ tataḥ paścāt śivāyeti tato vadetnivṛttiñca pratiṣṭhāṃ ca vidyāṃ ca tadanantaramsamagravidyāmuccārya trikoṇaṃ caiva pūjayetvajreśvarīkālike ca tathā dikkaravāsinīmtadanujñāṃ tato labdhvā bhuktvā tāmbūlamuttamamprajapet kṣobharahitaścāṣṭottarasahasrakamjapānte tajjapaṃ devyai samarpya tadanantaramgalaccandradravaṃ tasmād gṛhītvā tarpayecchivāmvisarjanaṃ vidhāyātha śaktiñca paritoṣayetevaṃ yajanamātreṇa mantrasiddhirna saṃśayaḥsamprāpya divasaṃ pūrvadevīñca vidhivadbhagetasya lakṣmīrmahāvidyā bhavecca bhuvi durlabhāāmantrya vidhivadyoniṃ tatraiva yoginīṃ yajetṣaṭsahasraṃ divārātrau japtvā mantramananyadhīḥathātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi prakārāntaramuttamambhagādyairbhagamāmantrya bhage bhagavatīṃ tataḥdvilakṣeṇa mahāvāgmī trilakṣeṇa mahākaviḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāksiddhiśca bhavettasya pañcalakṣapramāṇataḥsaptalakṣeṇa vīrendro jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥvidhivacchaktimāsādya sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥrātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥjāyate mantrasiddhistu nātra kāryā vicāraṇāathavā viṣuve caiva māsāntapakṣayorapiśmaśāne vā yathāśaktyā gurorvā śivasannidhaulikhanañca prakurvīta kuṅkumāgurucandanaiḥsampūjya vidhivad bhaktyā sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥlakṣamekaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ vā daśabhirhomamācaretparitoṣya guruṃ paścānmantrasiddhiśca jāyatelakṣmīstasya sadā gehe vāṇī vaktre suniścitamathavānyaprakāreṇa dūtīyajanamuttamamvastrālaṅkaraṇaṃ caiva dattvā tasyai yathocitampadmaṃ bhūmau samālikhya ṣaṭkoṇāntargataṃ likhettatastāṃ gandhapuṣpādyairnānopahāravistaraiḥtasyā gātre nyasenmantraṃ pañcabāṇān krameṇa tudīkṣayitvā tanmūlena devībuddhyā yajettataḥyonau kāmeśvarīṃ caiva nābhau vajreśvarīṃ tataḥyoniṃ sadā'kṣatāṃ kṛtvā japedvidyāṃ tataḥ parāmśaktimānīya vidhivat pūjayedyonimaṇḍalebhaginīṃ bhagajihvāñca bhagāsyāṃ bhagamālinīmbhagastanīṃ bhagāṅgīñca bhagasthāṃ bhagasarpiṇīmvāgbhavaṃ kāmabījañca kamalābījameva capūjayitvā tataḥ paścānmūlamantraṃ japettataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvaśāstrārthavettā ca sarvagaḥ sarvavit prabhuḥyoṣitāṃ yonimāsthāya sarvasiddhirna saṃśayaḥitthaṃ pūjāvidhiṃ kṛtvā sarvasiddhiyuto bhavetaiśvaryamatulaṃ prāpya vaśīkuryājjagattrayamrākṣasairmanujairnityaṃ pūjyo bhavati sādhakaḥante ca ramate devyā sākṣāt smaraharopamaḥsarvapāpavinirmukto ramet kalpāyutaṃ bhuviatulāṃ śriyamāpnoti sa gacchetpārvatīpadambhojayedyuvatīṃ yastu sa bhavet pṛthivīpatiḥsa bhavet sādhakaśreṣṭho mātṝṇāñca bhavet priyaḥtadā tadā prapūjyeta devīṃ dhyātvā yathāvidhietattu sarvabhūtānāṃ tantrāṇāṃ gopitaṃ bhuvinirvikalpastu mantrajño bhaved vai sādhakaḥ sadādīkṣitasyā'dhikāro'tra nānyasyaiva kadācanaamṛtatrayasaṃyogāt duṣṭamantro'pi sidhyatitryamṛtena puṭīkṛtya yo mantraṃ bhajate'cirātpañcahrasvā sandhivarṇā vyomerāgnijalandharāpañca vargākṣarāṇi syurvāntaṃ śvetendubhiḥ sahapuraścaryādibhirmantro yadi siddho bhavenna hidrāvaṇaṃ bodhanaṃ vaśyaṃ pīḍanaṃ poṣaśoṣaṇamvāruṇenaiva bījena grathanaṃ kārayenmanumuṣīrarocanākhyābhirmantraṃ saṃgrathitaṃ likhetpūjanājjapanādarcanād drāvitaḥ siddhido manuḥsārasvatena bīje sampuṭīkṛtya taṃ japetāraktacandanaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ haridrā madanaṃ śilā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dhāryaṃ kaṇṭhe na cet siddhiḥ pīḍanaṃ tasya kārayetdhyāyettu devatāṃ tadvattadadhottararūpiṇīmtathā bhūtena mantreṇa homaṃ kāryaṃ dine dinebālāyāstritayaṃ bījamādyante tasya yojayetpoṣito'yaṃ bhavet siddho na cet kurvīta śoṣaṇameṣā vidyā gale dhāryā likhitā śavabhasmanāāgneyena tu bījena mantrasyaikaikamakṣarambrahmavṛkṣasya tailena mantramālikhya dhārayetevaṃ krameṇa kurvīta puraścaraṇamuttamammantrasiddhirbhavedyena puraścaryādibhirvinākṣapayati duradṛṣṭaṃ vādirāḍ jāyate saḥmadhumatirapi heyaḥ kiṃpunaḥ siddhisaṅghāḥmanupuṭitapaṭīyān sādhayet śāntacetāḥracita yuvativeśastaddhiyā dhyāyate saḥsvayamapi racitāṅgaḥ kṣobhakṛdyoginīnāmmanupuṭitavimṛgyaṃ yojayettadbahiryaḥstava caraṇatalāntardhūlijālairviśālaiḥtadanu kaṭhinabījaṃ lokadhātrīṃ tadantaḥśivabhṛgumadapṛthvīśaktiyuktaṃ susiddhaṃ hariharacaturāsyasvasvabhūtiprasūtambhuvanabhayavināśaḥ kṣobhiṇīṃ yojayitvāsmaraharaharirūpī kāmarūpaḥ kuberaḥbhajati yadi gurūṇāṃ varṇamūlaṃ vimṛgyamtadupari mṛgacihnaṃ dvandvametat bhavānyāḥtava samanaya yuktaṃ bījamanyad bhavānyāḥbhajati janani yuṣmatpādapadmotthabhaktyā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: likhitamapi svabuddhyā prāpya kasmādakasmāttadapi yadi vidadhyāddigyutaṃ dantavarṇamtrijagati kimihāste kleśalabhyaṃ kathañcitvipina bhuvi ca madhye kautukān māṃ manuṣyaḥiti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye saptadaśollāsaḥakasmāt saṃlabhed gandhaṃ dhūpasya kusumasya vāsvapne vṛṣaṃ gajāśvaṃ vā yadvā'rohati sādhakaḥsvapne vā jāyate yoṣidvṛndaiḥ sammilanaṃ niśirājñāṃ tathā'ṅganānāñca darśanaṃ nṛtyagītayoḥrathaṃ vā taraṇiṃ vāpi svapneṣvārohayettu yaḥdhvajañca pratimāṃ caiva rājānaṃ rudhiraṃ tathāmadirālokanaṃ māṃsaṃ striyaṃ vā cāruhāsinīmlabhedvā bhakṣayedvā'pi sparśayedvā kadācanacaragoruṇitamvāyā vakṣojamukhapaṅkajamteṣāṃ prasādaḥ snehañca vātsalyaṃ priyadarśanamyadi bhāgyavaśāccaiva kuladṛṣṭistu jāyateakālapanasaṃ caiva bhakṣaṇaṃ darśanaṃ tathāparamānnabhakṣaṇañca śoṇitañca viśeṣataḥsādhakaṃ dravyarūpañca devatāṃ vā prapaśyatisiddhidravyaṃ śavaṃ caiva vasanābharaṇādikamsiddhaḥ so'pi bhavet satyaṃ saṃśayo nāsti niścitampīṭhādigamanaṃ tatra devatādarśanaṃ tathābālakaṃ bhikṣukaṃ caiva phalādīnāṃ tu lolupammanasā bhāvite kārye śaṅkhādidhvanirutsavaḥajñātajanasamvādo naṣṭadravyodayaṃ tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bahiryāgaphalaṃ nāsti vināntaryajanaṃ kadāśivaśaktisamāyogāt sudhāvṛṣṭiṃ vidhāya camūlādhāre samānīya so'haṃ sañcintayettataḥyadvāntaryajanaṃ vakṣye sādhakasya susiddhayeratnadvīpaṃ tu tanmadhye suvarṇabālukāmayamtatra kalpadrumaṃ dhyāyet pañcāśadakṣarātmakamudyadādityasaṅkāśaṃ vyāptaṃ brahmāṇḍamaṇḍalamcaturdvārasamāyuktaṃ hemaprākāraśobhitammandavāyusamākrāntaṃ gandhadhūpairalaṅkṛtamsuvarṇasūtraracitaṃ cintayecchatramuttamampādyapātratrayaṃ kuryādarghyapātratrayaṃ tathāekaṃ tu bhogapātraṃ tu sādhakaḥ ṣoḍaśe dalepīṭhapūjāṃ tataḥ kuryāt svakalpoktavidhāntaḥsravantamamṛtaṃ nityaṃ divyāṅgakamalāntaresvasvarūpāṃ samāvāhya parivāragaṇaiḥ sahaāsanaṃ svāgataṃ pṛṣṭvā kuśalaṃ tadanantaramsahasradalabhṛṅgārāllambikānālavicyutamsvarṇapātre jalaṃ kṛtvā dadyādācamanaṃ mukhecaturviṃśatitattvena gandhaṃ dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥsaptāṣṭabhāvapuṣpaiśca saṃpūjya dhūpadīpakamtarpayecca tridhā devīṃ yathoktavidhinā tataḥpūjayitvā prayatnena snānīyaṃ dāpayedyathātatra devīṃ samānīya nānāgandhasamanvitamdattvā devyai prayatnena snānīyaṃ dāpayettataḥnānātīrthajalenaiva snāpayet paradevatām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṣudrasya mahatī pūjā sukṛtī ca kṛtastutiḥmantralābhastathā svapne gurūṇāṃ duhitustathāasugandhiḥ sugandhiśca śraddhā puṣpodbhavastathāiti vijñāya vīrendraḥ prayogañca samācaretkṛṣṇavarṇabhaṭaṃ svapne prahārastena melanamrājyakṣobhavahnivāyujantubhirvadhadarśanamanyamantrārcane śraddhā svadevārcananindanamgaṇeśaṃ vaṭukaṃ paścāt kṣetreśaṃ yoginīstathākumāraṃ baṭukaṃ bhadraṃ lakṣmīṃ sucārunāyakampūjayitvā vidhānena baliṃ paścānnivedayetathātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi kāmyaprayogamuttamampūjayitvā mahārātrau tridinaṃ prajapenmanumvetālapādukāsiddhiṃ khaṅgasiddhintathaiva cakulāgāraṃ puṣpitāyā dṛṣṭvā yo japate naraḥkevalaṃ guptabhāvena sa tu vidyānidhirbhavetvaśamāyānti te sarve sādhakasya na cānyathāprajapya cā'yutaṃ prājñaḥ etadeva phalaṃ labhetprajaped yo bhavet sadyo vidyāyāvallabhaḥ svayamgadyapadyamayī vāṇī sabhāyāṃ tasya jāyatetannāmnā sudhiyaḥ sarve praṇamanti mudānvitāḥathavā dhanakāmastu mahadaiśvaryakāmukaḥaṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā kulamāmantrya tattvavitathavā hastamāropya sthiradhīḥ pūtamānasaḥpṛthvīmṛtumatīṃ vīkṣya sahasraṃ yadi nityaśaḥmahācīnakrame devīṃ dhyātvā devīṃ prapūjayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sa bhavet kuladevaśca kuladrumagataḥ śuciḥtatsudhādhārasāreṇa tarpayenmātṛkānanecāmaraṃ ravivimbañca tilapuṣpaṃ sarovarammukhaprasādaṃ suvacaḥ sulocanaṃ suhāsyakamlabhate ca yathāsaṃkhyaṃ sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥtasyāpi ṣoḍaśāṃśena phalaṃ nārhanita te śavāḥlatārateṣu japtavyaṃ mahāpātakamuktayelatābhāve samutsārya svaśukraṃ sādhakottamaḥiti cīnakrameṇaiva tārā śīghraphalapradāmahācīnakrameṇaiva kālikā phaladāyiṇītāsāntu samatā jñeyā guptasādhanasādhanetāsāṃ tu samatā jñeyā guptasādhanasādhanemahācīnakrameṇaiva chinnamastā tu siddhidāyathā kālī tathā tārā yathā bālā tathonmukhīyathā'sau tripurā bālā tathā tripurabhairavīanyā yā yā mahāvidyā tathā bhavati niścitametatyantrañca mantrañca putrebhyo'pi na darśayetathātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi kāmyasādhanamuttamamāmantrayettataḥ paścāt pañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyayātadambupānato mantrī vāgmī drutaṃ kavirbhavetkāmyakarttā mahāvāgmī bhavet śrutidharā naraḥsarvajñatāṃ labhedvīro nātra kāryā vicāraṇāpradīpakalikākāraṃ jihvāyāṃ mūlamantrakamtrimāsādūrdhvato mantrī pūrvavat phalamāpnuyātprātareva hi japtavyamaṣṭottarasahasrakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: balidānādikaṃ sarvaṃ vidhāya pūrvavad budhaḥjapedayutasaṅkhyaṃ tu sarvakāmārthasiddhayesahasraṃ devīmabhyarcya śmaśāne sādhakottamaḥsvagātrarudhirāktaiśca bilvapatraiḥ sahasraśaḥśmaśānaśayano vīraḥ śavāsanagataḥ śuciḥkavirvāgmī dhanī dakṣaḥ sarvayoṣitpriyaḥ sukhīkṣudraviṭcuarabhūtāni devīṃ dhyātvā vināśayetaṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā sādhako labhate śriyamśmaśāne'bhyarcya devīntu sarvasiddhiṃ tu vindatisukhī syānnātra sandeho mahākālavaco yathāraktacandanadigdhāṅgīṃ raktapuṣpairalaṃkṛtāmmantraṃ proccārayettatra ne ga ve ge śa liṃ pra bhapūjayitvā tatra devīṃ yo vai dhyāyecca devatāmaṣṭamyāñca caturdaśyāṃ pūjayitvā yathāvidhicandanañcā'rkakusumaṃ tathā śvetāparājitāmaṣṭottaraśataṃ jāpyaṃ yāvajjīvanasaṃkhyayāprātaḥ snānarato mantrīṃ nityamaṣṭottaraṃ śatamanena vidhinā mantrī grahakṣudraripūn jayetsvakalpoktaṃ vidhāyā'tha sādhako vijitendriyaḥvivāde japakāle vā yatkiñcit kulasādhanerātrau prapūjayed gehe sthitvā padātmikāṃ parāmehi mātarjagaddhātri sañcāre caraṇākuleevaṃ nimantrayitvā tu saptavārān susaṃyataḥtato vīkṣeccakrarājaṃ sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥsādhakābhimukhaṃ cihnaṃ ubhayoryadi caikataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viparītaphalaṃ dadyādviparīte suniścitamviparītaphalaṃ tattu viparītañca niścitamathātaḥ pādukāmantraṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥsarvabhūte mahāśaktiḥ pādāgre yā sthitā yataḥādyantarahitā devī pādukādisvarūpiṇīsvatantreyaṃ mahāvidyā na prakāśyā kadācanasṛṣṭikrameṇa deveśīmahāsṛṣṭipravarttinībrahmaviṣṇusvarūpā sā mahādevasvarūpiṇīante kṣetreṇa siddhiḥ syāccheṣe gandharvayonayaḥpādukā paramā vidyā saptākṣarasamanvitākathiteyaṃ mahāvidyā yatnād gopyā sadaiva hietattantrañca mantrañca prayogañca tathā paramanyathā pretarājasya bhavanaṃ yāti niścitamiti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye aṣṭādaśollāsaḥśāntivaśyastambhanāni vidveṣoccāṭane tataḥrogakṛtyā grahādīnāṃ nirāsaḥ śāntirīritāpravṛttirodhaḥ sarveṣāṃ stambhanaṃ tadudāhṛtamsadvidyāsiddhikālādīn jñātvā karmāṇi sādhayetrātrāveva prayogādau śivāyai ca susiddhayeuccāṭane smṛto vāyurbhūyo'gnirmāraṇe mataḥpītā bhūmiḥ pañcabhūta rūpametadudīritamtrikoṇaṃ svastikopetaṃ vahnerardhendusaṃyutamtattadbhūtasamābhāni maṇḍalāni vidurbudhāḥśabdasparśarūparasagandhā bhūtaguṇāḥ smṛtāḥtiryak saṃspṛśi mārutasya paritaḥ spṛṣṭe marudvartmanaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rvāyoḥ śāntikanirviṣīkaraṇayorvyomno hi taścodayaḥyantraṃ kuryāt rocanayā guṇḍikayā haridrayāśītāṃśusalilakṣauṇīvyomavāyuhavirbhujāmvaśyādau lekhanī dūrvā ākarṣe śikhipucchikāratirvāṇī ramā jyeṣṭhā durgā kālī yathākramātathātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi ṣaṭkarmakāla nirṇayambudhejyaravisaṃyuktā śāntikarmaṇi pūjitānavamī pauṣṭike śastā aṣṭamī navamī tathāākarṣaṇe tvamāvasyā navamī pratipattathākṛṣṇā caturdaśī tadvadaṣṭamī mandavārakāḥcaturdaśyaṣṭamī kṛṣṇā tvamāvāsyā tathaiva cabudhacandradinopetā pañcamī daśamī tathāśubhagrahodaye kuryāt śubhāni ca śubhodayeīśaścandrendranir-ṛtivāyvagnīnāṃ diśo matāḥṛtavaḥ syurvasantādyā ahorātraṃ dine dinehemantaḥ śāntike prokto vasanto vaśyakarmaṇiprāvṛḍuccāṭane jñeyaḥ śaranmāraṇa karmaṇivaśye ca stambhane śastā gajacarmaṇi dveṣakemahiṣāśvayorvā carmaṇi sādhayet sādhakottamaḥvajraṃ bhadrakamityāhurāsanāni manīṣiṇaḥūrvorupari vīrendraḥ kṛtvā pādatale ubhepūjājapavidhānena aṅguṣṭhaṃ dhāraṇañcaretṛjukāyaḥ sukhāsīnaḥ svastikaṃ tat pracakṣateetadvā svastikaṃ proktaṃ savye nyasyetaraṃ karamniveśya bhūmau saṃsthāpya romasthaḥ kukkuṭāsanaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pārśvapādau ca pāṇibhyāṃ dṛḍhaṃ baddhvā suniścalaḥūrvoḥ pādau kramānnyasya jānvoḥ pratyammukhāṅgulaumuṣalāśanikhaḍgādyāḥ śāntikādiṣu karmasutalāntamilitāṅguṣṭhau kṛtvaiṣā padmamudrikāsaṃyojyāṅguṣṭhakāgrābhyāṃ tarjanyagre kṣipettataḥanyonyābhimukhau hastau kṛtvā ca grathitāṅgulaugadāmudreyamākhyātā vidvadbhiḥ parikīrttitākuryānmuṣalamudreyaṃ sarvavighnavināśinīkaniṣṭhāṃ madhyamāṃ caiva jyeṣṭhāṅguṣṭhena ca kramātkaniṣṭhānāmikāṃ baddhvā sāṅguṣṭhenaiva saṃyutāsitaraktapītamiśrā kṛṣṇadhūmrā prakīrttitāḥyadvarṇadevatā yatra tadvarṇañcopahāraṇammantreṇāntaritān kuryānmāraṇāni yathāvidhiyogaḥ pallava ityete vinyāsāḥ ṣaṭsu karmasugrathanaṃ tadvijānīyāt praśastaṃ śāntikarmaṇividarbha eva vijñeyo mantribhirvaśyakarmaṇieṣa syāt stambhane śasta ityukto mantravedibhiḥvidveṣasya vidhāne tu praśasto nyāsa uttamaḥante nāmno bhavenmantraḥ pallavo māraṇe smṛtaḥśāntikarmaṇi miśraṃ vā japenmantrasya siddhayemantratulyāṅgamaṇibhirjapedākṛṣṭakarmaṇiakṣamālāṃ samālokya vidveṣoccāṭane japetkṛtvā'kṣamālāṃ japtavyaṃ śatrumāraṇamicchatāanāmikāmadhyabhāge mālāṃ saṃsthāpya sādhakaḥtarjanyāṅguṣṭhayogena vidveṣoccāṭayorjapet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mātṛkayā'thavā kuryād yathātantravidhānataḥathavānyaprakāreṇa kathyate sādhanaṃ mahattatpārśve sādhyamālikhya tāḍayed divyadṛṣṭibhiḥgorocanādibhirdravyaiḥ svīyacandraṃ samālikhetjvalantīṃ nāmasahitāṃ kāmabījavidarbhitāmadṛṣṭapūrvā sā śaktiḥ drutamāyāti durlabhāāyāti sādhakaṃ samyak mantramūḍhā satī śubhāudyatsūryasahasrābhamātmānamaruṇaṃ tathāanena kramayogena yuvā kandarparūpavānsarvaraktopacārastu mudrānihitavigrahaḥsa bhaveddāsavat satyaṃ dhaneśo vāpi vākpatiḥadṛṣṭā vā satī vāpi yogamudrādharā'pi vānāginīmapsarāṃ vāpi gandharvīṃ vā surāṅganāmmadanodbhavasantāpāṃ sphurajjaghanasustanīmmahākāmakalādhyānāt sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥrocanābhāgamekaṃ tu bhāgamekaṃ tu kuṅkumamekatra tilakaṃ kuryāt trilokavaśakārakamrājānaṃ nagaraṃ grāmaṃ yatkiṃcidanyaducyateyonipuṣpairliṅgapuṣpairmiśrīkṛtya ca sādhakaḥrahasyasthānake mantrī likhedrocanayā bhuvipratimāṃ sundarīṃ ramyāṃ vilikhya sumanoharāmyasyā nāma mahāvidyāmaṅkuśāntarvidarbhitambindunādakalākrāntamaṅkuśaṃ parikīrttitamsvarāntaṃ pṛthivīsaṃsthaṃ ratibindusamanvitamnīladāḍimbapuṣpābhaṃ cintayeddehasandhiṣu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mudrāṃ tu kṣobhiṇīṃ baddhvā mantramaṣṭaśataṃ japettato'pyadhikasarvāṅgīṃ kāmabāṇaiḥ supīḍitāmevamākarṣayennārīṃ yojanānāṃ śatairapiaṣṭamīrātrimārabhya caturdaśyāṃ samāpayettāmbūlapūritamukho muktakeśo jitendriyaḥgandhacandanapuṣpaistu digvāsāḥ kulabhūṣaṇaḥsā samāyāti kāmārttā yatra devaḥ sa pūjakaḥvāmabhāge samāsīnaṃ raktavastravibhūṣitamsarvaśṛṅgāraveśāḍhyaṃ sphuraccakitalocanamlalāṭe mantramālikhya sādhyanāmavidarbhitamtāmbūlapūritamukhaḥ kulaṃ tadabhisaṃhitamyannāmnā likhitaṃ yantraṃ tāñca nayati tatkṣaṇātdvīpāntarasahasreṣu rakṣitāṃ nigaḍādibhiḥnitambavimbaviddhvastasphurajjaghanamaṇḍalāmkavāṭalohasannaddhapūrikāvivarāntareevamākṛṣṭisiddhiścet sādhakaḥ kauliko bhavetrātrau vīravaro vāpi divyo vā sādhakottamaḥvilikhya mālinīṃ devīmāraktavasanojjvalāmmaṇinā sādhyanāmānaṃ vilikhya tasya madhyataḥkāmarājena saṃyuktāṃ devaṃ dhyātvā susādhakaḥyannāmnā dīyate caiva sā vaśyaṃ pratipadyateyoginyo'psarasaścāpi ke pare narakiṅkarāḥiti cet jñāyate lokaistadā bhraṣṭo bhaviṣyatianayākṛṣṭikarmajña iti cet pratipadyateyadi svapnāvatīṃ vidyāṃ sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: japtvā vighnaṃ kadāciddhi pathi tasya na vidyateniḥsaṅgena sadā kuryāt kulākṛṣṭiṃ viśeṣataḥjalamadhye ca durmārge ārāme vā śmaśānakeaṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu yo japtvā gacchati dhruvamathavā sa sarvakāryeṣu japtvā cāṣṭasahasrakamna ca vighnaṃ tatastatra tatra tatra japāntaramathavā mātṛkāṃ sarvāṃ likhitvā cakrabāhyataḥsādhyanāmānvitaṃ kṛtvā dhārayedvāmabāhukeathavā mātṛkāyuktāṃ svasañjñāṃ cakramaṇḍitāmanena vidhinā vāpi rocanāgurucandanaiḥsthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ vāpi sakalaṃ jalamaṇḍalamkāmarājena bījena mahākāmakalātmanābalirasyā likhedevaṃ veṣṭayenmātṛkākṣaraiḥśikhāyāmathavā vastre śarīre yatra kutra vāsammohayati rājānaṃ vājinaṃ duṣṭakuñjaramcakravajrāṇi vetālaṃ durdamaṃ rākṣasaṃ tathāyena vīreṇa tatsarvaṃ sa kuryāddāsavadvaśamcatuḥsamudraparyantāṃ jvalantīṃ cintayettataḥdṛṣṭyā'karṣayate lokaṃ dṛṣṭyaiva kurute vaśamdṛṣṭyā karṣati vāgīśaṃ dṛṣṭyā sarvavilocanametat prapūjanaṃ rātrau cakraṃ sindūramiśritammadhye dikṣu vidikṣvevaṃ yadā devīṃ prapūjayetbhūrjapatre vilikhyaiva rocanāgurukuṅkumaiḥsvanāmadarbhitaṃ kṛtvā yadi bhūmau nidhāpayetdhārayedvāmahastena kaṇṭhe vā bhujamūlake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rocanā kuṅkumāktañca lākṣālaktakasaṃyutamkastūrīdravasaṃyuktaṃ ekīkṛtya tataḥ paramtasya vyāghragajavyādhiripusarpaviṣādikambhayaṃ na vidyate kutra paramañcābhicārakamna śakto hiṃsituṃ tasya romaikamapi sarvathāadhastānnāmasaṃyuktāṃ rocanākuṅkumānvitāmtāmbūladhūpamudakaṃ patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ dadhikastūrīṃ ghusṛṇaṃ cailāṃ lavaṅgaṃ jātipatrakamaṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā yasmai kasmai prayacchatistriyaśca sakalā vaśyā dāsībhūtā bhavanti hipītadravyeṇa saṃlikhya dhārayedindradiggatamsahasravadanaścāpi mūko bhavati niścitamdakṣiṇābhimukho vahnau dagdhvā mārayate'cirātkṛtvā śarāvamadhyasthaṃ vidviṣṭaṃ sarvajantuṣunīlakarpaṭake samyak nīlasūtreṇa veṣṭayetdugdhalākṣārocanābhirmahānīlarasena caanenaiva vidhānena jalamadhye viniḥkṣipetetanmadhyagatāṃ pṛthvīṃ nāgarīṃ vā surāṅganāmlikhitvā pītavarṇena svīyacakraṃ yadā'rcayetsindūreṇa likheccakraṃ pūjayeduttarāmukhaḥcakraṃ gairikayā'likhya pūjayet paścimāmukhaḥdakṣiṇābhimukho bhūtvā nityaṃ cakraṃ yadā'rcayetcakraṃ vahnimukho bhūtvā rātrau sampūjayet sudhīḥrocanāliptitaṃ cakraṃ dugdhamadhye vaśaṅkaramtailasthaṃ cakrarājaṃ tu vidveṣaṇakaraṃ param
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nayane tejasastattvaṃ proñchayettena vai tanumvidhivadvandanaṃ kṛtvā keśasaṃskāramācaretpaṭṭagucchaṃ keśapāśe nānāratnasamākulamnāgendradantaracitaṃ śaṅkhaṃ dadyānmanoharampādāṅgurīyakaṃ dadyānnānāratnopaśobhitamśiroratnaṃ pradadyācca mukuṭaṃ ratnanirmitamnayane kajjalaṃ dadyānnāsāgre gajamauktikamānandahāratritayaṃ aṅgurīyakaratnakamkāñcanāñcitakañcūlīmalaktaṃ radanacchademaṇḍapeṣu samānīya ratnanirmitadolayāgandhādikaṃ tato dattvā bhāvapuṣpaiḥ prapūjayetamohakamadambhañca adveṣākṣobhakau tathāahiṃsā paramaṃ puṣpaṃ puṣpamindriyanigrahamiti pañcadaśairbhāvapuṣpaiḥ saṃpūjayecchivāmaparāñca kadambañca pārijātādikaṃ tathāsumekhalāṃ padmamālāṃ puṣpaṃ nānāvidhaṃ tathākuṇḍagolodbhavañcaiva dhūpaṃ dadyāt samīraṇammūlādhāre varttirūpaṃ cidagniḥ syāt pradīpakamanāhatadhvanimayīṃ ghaṇṭāmetāṃ nivedayetsūryañca darpaṇañcandramaṇḍalaṃ chatramuttamamsupakvañcarukañcaiva ghṛtāktaṃ paramānnakamdadyāccheṣārghyaṃtoyena punarācamanīyakamrajaḥsattvaguṇāḍhyañca karpūracūrṇāmiśritamtarpayitvā punardevīṃ pūjayeccāṅgadevatāḥvidhivat pūjanaṃ kṛtvā tarpayettadanantaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekāyutaṃ japaṃ kuryāt prayogeṣu ca sādhakaḥtasmin homaṃ prakurvīta saṃskṛte havyavāhanecūrṇitaṃ juhuyānmantrī saptāhādvaśayejjanānvaśayet sakalān devān gandharvān kiṃ suparṇakānyasya nāmnā sa vaśyaḥ syādanenaiva na saṃśayaḥjalaṃ pañcāśataṃ dadyādvaśaṃ nayati vāñchitamkūrcalajjādvayaṃ cānte ādyābījaṃ tathaiva canāgayajñopavītāñca candrārdhadhṛtamastakāmaṣṭottaraśatāmantrya pūrvadravyeṇa sādhakaḥśatābhimantritaṃ kṛtvā rocanātilakena tuādye caikaṃ tu bījānāṃ tathaivānte ca ekakamsvāhāntaṃ mantramuccārya bhavedākarṣaṇaṃ mahatmahākālāgra āsīnāṃ dhyātvā cākarṣaṇañcaretākarṣayati mantrajñaḥ kimanyat bhuvi yoṣitaḥpiṅgākṣīṃ kṛṣṇavarṇāñca kartrīkharparadhāriṇīmante ca ṭhadvayaṃ dattvā prajapenmanumuttamamuccāṭayati piṅgākṣī saṃdrāvayati kekarāvikṣobhayati saṃkṣubdhā sampātayati sannatāyaṃ yaṃ bhāvaṃ jano dhyāyet tatra tatra smaredapiuccāṭanādi sarvatra maithunānte samācaretulūkakākapakṣaiśca homācchatrūn vināśayetpūrvoktena vidhānena citākāṣṭhahutāśanevidveṣaṇavidhānena anyonyakalahānvitamsahasreṇa pramāṇena kuryāddhomaṃ yathāvidhikṛṣṇavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya badhnīyāt raktatantubhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saptāhābhyantare tasya dhruvamuccāṭanaṃ bhavetyannāmnā dīyate tacca so'cirānmṛtyumarhatisahasraṃ parisañjapya niśāyāṃ ravivāsarekṣetre tu śasyahāniḥ syājjavahānisturaṅgamedveṣyadveṣakayornāmni tayordveṣo mahān bhavetputtalīḥ pañca kurvīta sāṅgopāṅgāḥ śubhāḥ samāḥcakrihastamṛdā'nyā syādanyāmadhumayī tathāprokṣayecca tathā kṣīradadhyājyamadhubhiḥ kramātkurvīta puttalīṃ saumyāṃ sarvāvayavaśobhitāmraktavastradharāṃ śuddhāṃ puttalīṃ dāruṇā kṛtāmmṛṇmayīṃ pratimāṃ pādadeśe nyasyettathātmanaḥlavaṇena kṛtāṃ paścāt pratimāṃ saṃspṛśan japetagnimādāya sandīpya sādhyanakṣatradārubhiḥkuśītarājidūrvābhirdattvā'rghyaṃ praṇamet sudhīḥtvarānandana śatrughna niśāyāṃ havyavāhanajātavedo mahādeva taptajāmbūnadaprabhaoṃ durge sarvaviparyāsi grastaṃ yuktaṃ tvayā jagattamomayi mahādevi mahādevasya suvrateoṃ durge durge durgāsi durgasaṃrodhanākulebhadrakāli bhavābhītibhadrasiddhipradāyiniprāṇāsiśaktirudrādyairutkramyotkṛtya cānayasādhyaṃ saṃhṛtya nirvartyaṃ puttalīṃ sādhakottamaḥprathamo dakṣapādaśca tatkarastadanantarammadhyādūrdhvaṃ pañcamaḥ syādardhoṃ'śaḥ ṣaṣṭha īritaḥsapta sapta vibhāgo vā prayogeṣu yathāvidhi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yajamāno dhanairdhānyaiḥ prīṇayed gurumātmanaḥkiṃ punarmanujān bhūpān sadyo'pyasya vimohitāḥniveśayad yathāpūrvaṃ sādhakendro yathāvidhivarāhapārāvataviṭ tiladrumaiśca rāmaṭhaiḥsnuhikṣīreṇa sampiṣṭaiḥ pūrvoktalavaṇānvitaiḥjapapūjādikaṃ kuryāt prāguktavartmanā sudhīḥdurgāṃ vā bhadrakālīṃ vā samārādhya yathāvidhivāmaṃ pādaṃ samāruhya dakṣiṇaṃ dhruvamānasaḥkṛṣṇāṣṭamīṃ samārabhya yāvat kṛṣṇacaturdaśīdvisaptāhaprayogeṇa mārayet ripumātmanaḥsmṛtvā śūladharāṃ devīṃ devāṃśca tatkṣaṇājjayetkulālamṛttikāyāṃ tu pratimāyāṃ hṛdi nyasetvidhāyāgniṃ japenmantramaṣṭottarasaharakamabhyarcya ca tataḥ paścāt tīkṣṇatailena mantravitteṣu sampātayed bhūyaḥ spṛṣṭvā tānyayutaṃ japetprāpnuyānnaṣṭasañjñāyāṃ palāyanaparāyaṇaḥniḥkṣipet śatrusenāyāṃ gūḍhaṃ rātrisamāgameparasparavirodhena gacchedvigataceṣṭayāsādhyapādarajoyukto homāduccāṭayet ripūnśaptāṃ pratiṣṭhitaprāṇāṃ chedayedaṅgaśaḥ puraḥkṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ śmaśāne havyavāhaneunmattasamidhāṃ homānmattāḥ syuḥ śatravaḥ kṣaṇātjuhuyānniśi kāntāre śatru kālātithirbhavetviṣaliptaviliptāṅgīmabhyukṣya nikṣipejjaletarjanītriśikhaṃ dorbhyāṃ dhārayantīṃ bhayaṅkarīm
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mārayedavivādena ripūn bandhusamanvitāndhyātvā mantraṃ japenmantrī pūrvavannāśayedarīnsṛjantīṃ bāṇanivahān dhārayantīṃ ca tarjanīmripuñca parasenāñca śīghramuccāṭayed dhruvamsādhyanāmāṅkitaṃ kṛtvā śatrusadṛśaputtalīmekāyutaṃ japaṃ kṛtvā trirātrānmāraṇaṃ bhavetmahājvālā bhavettasya taptatāmraśalākayākuṇḍalinyā mukhe kṣiptvā vairiṇaṃ sādhakottamaḥprātareva vibhāvyātha japedayutasaṃkhyakambhūrjapatre svarṇapatre nimbapatre vilikhya cavahnipatre riporvidyāṃ likhitvā patrake'malesahasrajanmabhirjaptvā vidyā na hi phalapradāvahnibījaṃ puṭaṃ kṛtvā dṛṣṭyā dagdhvā vicintya capadmapatre yasya mantraṃ puṭīkṛtya ca dīpanaiḥvāṅmāyākamalābījaṃ dīpanaṃ parikīrtitamjale ca nikṣipenmantraṃ punarnava itīritaḥkārayedakṣavṛkṣeṇā'pyedāyudha pañcakampañcagavyeṣu nikṣipya tāni spṛṣṭvā japenmanumavaṭeṣu ca pūrṇeṣu pañcagavyena sādhakaḥnivasettasya madhyādi pūjāṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhibaliñca vikirettatra teṣāṃ mantrī yathākramātdīnāṃśca kṛpaṇādīṃśca toṣayed bhojanādibhiḥyatreyaṃ vihitā rakṣā deśe vā nagare'pi vāagnyutpātādayo doṣā bhūtapretādi saṃyutāḥnekṣantāṃ tāṃ diśaṃ bhītyā tarjitā devatājñayā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: goptavyañca prayatnena nānyathā narakaṃ vrajetdhyāyet kālīṃ karālāsyāṃ sudaṃṣṭrāṃ bhīmalocanāmvīrāsanasamāsīnāṃ mahākāloparisthitāmmuṇḍamālāgaladraktacarcitāṃ pīvarastanīmvāme khaḍgamuṇḍakhaṇḍadhāriṇīṃ dakṣiṇe kareśakuntapakṣisaṃyuktāṃ bālacandravibhūṣitāmcaṇḍahāsacaṇḍanādacaṇḍasphoṭaiśca bhairavaiḥsevitāśeṣasiddhaughasevitaiḥ sevitāṃ sadāiti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye ekonaviṃśollāsaḥbhaumavāre niśīthe ca catuṣpathagato naraḥsvakalpokta vidhānena sampūjya nijadevatāmaṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu japtvā stutvā ca sādhakaḥatha vakṣye ca vetāla siddhiṃ sarvottamottamāmbhaumavāre madhyarātrau gatvā kulayugānvitaḥsahasraṃ homayedvīrastatraiva pitṛkānanekṛtvā durgāṣṭamīrātrau śmaśāne niḥkṣipettataḥśavāsanagato vīro japedaṣṭasahasrakamspheṃ spheṃ daṇḍa mahābhāga yoginīhṛdayapriyaevamāmantrya vetālaṃ yatra yatra prapūjyategaccha gaccha mahābhāge pāduke varavarṇinievamāmantrya pādukāṃ dadyāt pādatale tataḥatha vakṣye khaḍgasiddhiṃ sādhakānāṃ hitāya cakṛtvā tatra mūlamantraṃ likhitvā prajapenmanumtat sahasraṃ tato hutvā mahāśavakalevarekulāṣṭamyāmardharātre citāmadhye samāhitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: madhuratrayasaṃyuktaṃ bilvapatreṇa saṃyutambalyante sā mahāmāyā devī mahiṣamardinīgṛdhravadatiśabdena khaḍgamuttolya dhārayetkāṃ īṃ ūṃ kuru kalyāṇi vipakṣādapi vistaramchittvā chitvā punaśchittvā gato'pyākṛṣyate punaḥkulamīnaṃ kuladravyaṃ kulamadyaṃ kuleśvaraṃvidhivat pūjanaṃ kṛtvā sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥbhūmau phūtkāramātreṇa vivaraṃ tatra jāyatetatraiva gamanaṃ tasya bhūtalāntaḥ prasarpiṇaḥkāyasaṅkocamāsādya gacchatyavikalo naraḥyādikṣāntaṃ caturbhāge sindūrarajasā likhetpūjayet rātrisamaye kulācārakrameṇa tuevaṃ ṣaṇmāsayogena siddho bhavati sādhakaḥvaradābhayadhāriṇyaḥ pradhānatanavaḥ striyaḥañjaliñcārghyavat kṛtvā paramīkaraṇaṃ bhavethṛdayaṃ madhyamānāmā tarjanībhiḥ smṛtaṃ śiraḥdaśabhiḥ kavacaṃ proktaṃ tisṛbhirnetramīritamdiśastenaiva badhnīyāt choṭikābhiḥ samantataḥsmaraṇāt kālikā devī sarvabandhavimocinībrahmāṇī devagandharvasevitā śivagehinīsādhakasya kṣaṇaṃ dhyānāt pratyakṣā suravanditāśatakoṭimukhenāpi pañcabhiśca kathaṃ priyeādau mātā tathā guptā māgurītyabhidhīyatemama prabhutvamāpannā mama mātā yaśasvinīityuktvā śaṅkaro mohāt mūrcchitaḥ punarudgataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jāto'sau śaṅkaro devyāḥ pādapadmaṃ samāśritaḥkevalaṃ dhyānayogena sarvasiddhimupālabhetprayogaprabhavā devī prasanna bhaktavatsalāsahasraṃ parijapyaitat sandhyāyāṃ ravivāsaresahasraṃ parijapyeta vipulāṃ kavitāṃ labhetraktapuṣpaśatenāpi maṇḍite kujavāsaresampūjya rājasammānaṃ kujavāre niśārdhakeravau vāre trayodaśyāṃ haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥputradātā niśābhāge dharapatnīsāhayavāndīrghamāyurvaśakaraṃ putraṃ saṃlabhate'cirātśatamaṣṭottaraṃ mantraṃ dhārayettilakaṃ yadiparanārīratā ye vā japanti paścimāmukhāḥcatuṣpathe sahasrārdhaṃ muktakeśo digambaraḥacalāṃ kamalāṃ labdhvā sukhaṃ prāpnoti bhūtalejapettu kālikādhyānādaṣṭādhikaśataṃ niśimatsyāśī nityamāṃsāśi rātrau paścimadiṅmukhaḥsatyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ tacchaturyamavallabhaḥaṣṭau dināni labhyeta kanyāṃ śīlaguṇānvitāmsahasrārdhapramāṇena dhanadena samo bhavetcatuṣpathe mahārogānmukto rogī bhaved dhruvamtasya dāridryasaṃnyāsaṃ karoti japamastakeviśālayā rājamānā triṃśallocanamālayākhaḍgabāṇagadāśūlaśaṅkhacakrabhuśuṇḍibhṛtmadhukaiṭabhayoryuddhe yaiṣā sā tāmasī śivāraktamadhyā raktadehā nīlajaṅghorujānukā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṣṭādaśabhujā pūjyā sā sahasrabhujā raṇeakṣamālāṃ tu muṣalaṃ bāṇāsiṃ kuliśaṃ gadāmśaktidaṇḍacarmapāśaṃ pānapātraṃ kamaṇḍalumsmartavyā stutikālādau mahiṣāsuramardinīevaṃ dhyātvā naro nityaṃ labhetepsitamātmanaḥsākṣāt sarasvatī proktā śumbhāsuranibarhiṇīśaṅkhaghaṇṭālāṅgalañca kārmukañca tathā parampunastārañca vārāhī caṇḍīmantraḥ samīritaḥiti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye viṃśollāsaḥcaturthāśramiṇāṃ madhye avadhūtāśramo mahānyadi na syāttadā caiva śṛṇu yat kathayāmi tetadājñayā vimuktaḥ syāttāṃ sampūjya kulāntarenirdvandvo nirahaṅkāraḥ śuddhanāḍījitendriyaḥbaddhapadmāsano yogī yogaṃ yuñjīta yatnataḥaṅguṣṭhau tu nibadhnīyāddhastābhyāṃ vyutkrameṇa tugudāttu dvyaṅgulādūrdhvamadhomeḍhrāttu dvyaṅgulamkandamasti śarīre'smin puṇyāpuṇyavivarjitaḥjīvastu mūlacakre'smin adhaḥprāṇaścaratyasautatra nāḍyaḥ samutpannāḥ sahasrāṇāṃ dvisaptatiḥiḍā ca piṅgalā caiva vāmadakṣiṇataḥ sthitepṛṣṭhamadhyagatā sā tu saha mūrdhni vyavasthitāmuktimārge sadā guptā meḍhramūrdhni vyavasthitāpañcavarṇojjvalā devī pañcabhūtanivāsinīpūrayitvā tu vicinnā citrā sā granthirūpiṇītasyā madhye brahmanāḍī mṛṇālatanturūpiṇī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gudameḍrāntare granthi suṣumnā sandhiruttamāsuvarṇābhaṃ vādisāntaṃ hemavarṇaṃ suśobhanamtaruṇāruṇasaṅkāśāṃ śūlakhaṭvāṅgakau tataḥdugdhābhāṃ saṃsthitāṃ dhyāyet ḍākinīṃ locanatrayāmapānākhyaṃ hi kandarpaṃ ādhāre ca trikoṇakebandhūkapuṣpasaṅkāśaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabhamtasyordhve kuṇḍalī śaktiraṣṭadhā kuṇḍalākṛtiḥadhovaktrasthitādevī ūrdhvapucchā'tiśobhanāsā ca vidyullatākārā mṛṇālatantusannibhābrahmadvāramukhaṃ nityaṃ mukhenāvṛtya tiṣṭhatimukhena śvāsaṃ praviṣṭā brahmarandhraṃ mukhaṃ tadānānyaḥ panthā dvitīyo'sti śarīre paramasya caadhovaktrāṇi padmāni mūlādīni yathākramātcaturaṅgulavistāraṃ kandamūlaṃ khagāṇḍavatevaṃ dhyātvā ca vīrendraḥ sthiracittaḥ sthirendriyaḥnava dvārāṇi saṃyamya kukṣimāpūrya vāyunāvāyunā bhidya tadvaktraṃ ūrdhvavaktraṃ tu kārayetullāsojjvalakārasya śikhā yāti samujjvalāūrdhvaṃ bhittvā tu liṅgaṃ vai itaraṃ puṣkaraṃ tataḥnṝṇāmete ṣaḍguṇāḥ sambhavantipaṭutvamārogyamadīnatā casvādhiṣṭhānaṃ mahāpadmaṃ liṅgamūle rasacchadamsindūraprasphuradvarṇairbādilāntaiśca maṇḍitamdadhānāṃ śyāmavarṇāñca rākiṇīṃ tritayānvitāmvicintya sthiracittena adhiṣṭhānaṃ prabhedayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: suciraṃ jīvati vītamṛtyubhītiḥdṛḍharuddho ghanatāñca śītaraśmiḥpadmamadhye sthitaṃ śuddhaṃ vidyutābhaṃ trikoṇakamraktavarṇaṃ caturvaktraṃ dadhatañca trilocanambrahmasattvākṣamoṅkāraṃ sthitaṃ nābheradhaḥ sadāvidyutpuñjasphuradvarṇairḍādiphāntaiśca maṇḍitammānasaṃ saṃvibhāvyātha bhedayettadanantaramhāniścākhiladuḥkharogaśamanaṃ kālasya vā vañcanamdrutasvarṇaprabhāvarṇaiḥ kādiṭhāntaiśca maṇḍitamabhayaṃ ḍamaruṃ śūlaṃ pāśañca karapaṅkajaiḥtatraivāṅguṣṭhamātmānaṃ pradīpakalikopamamśuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ vāṇīlakṣmīvibhūṣitampītāmbaradharaṃ śāntaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitamprabhedayettataḥ paścāt sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥrdūrādeva ca darśanañca khagatiḥ syādyoginīmelanamtadante vyomabījañca śuklaṃ haimagajasthitamākāśasahitaṃ padmaṃ śākinīṃ paricintayetpāśāṅkuśau pustakañca jñānamudrāñca dhāriṇīmardhanārīśvaraṃ devaṃ nānāmaṇivibhūṣitamdhyātvaivaṃ cakrarājaṃ tu bhedayet sādhakottamaḥkṣitau ciraṃ jīvati vītamṛtyuḥstadīyaṃ sāmarthyaṃ śamayitumalaṃ nāpi gaṇapaḥvidyutkoṭiprabhaṃ cakraṃ bhruvorūrdhve manonmanīyonimadhye sthitaṃ liṅgamitaraṃ taruṇāruṇambindusthāṃ hākinīṃ śukramedomajjāsvarūpiṇīm
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: puṣpaśayyāñca saṃskuryāttatra devīṃ sureśvarīmgītairnānāvidhairdevīṃ toṣayet sādhakottamaḥmanasyaikyaṃ vibhāvyātha sādhakaḥ siddhibhāg bhavetraktapadmasahasrāṇi manasā yaḥ prayacchatisthitvā devīpure śrīmān tato rājā kṣitau bhavetyo naro bhaktisaṃyuktaḥ sa dīrghāyuḥ sukhībhavetdevīgṛhe vaset so'pi narakāṇi na paśyatiso'pi lokān vijityāśu śivaloke mahīyategurudhyānaṃ prakurvīta yathāpūrvaṃ viśāladhīḥbindutīrthe'thavā snāyāt punarjanma na vidyatekiṃ tasya gāṅgairapi puṣkarairvāśivaśaktyoḥ samāyogo yasminkāle pravartatecandrārkānalasaṃghaṭṭādgalitaṃ yat parāmṛtamtarpaṇaṃ kathitaṃ divyamarghyasādhanamucyatekalāsāreṇa saṃpūrya tarpayettena khecarīmhakṣau kodaṇḍamadhye nyasatu vimaladhīrnyāsasampattisiddhauṣaḍaṅgamatha kuryāttu yena devīmayo bhavetkriyate tat paratvena hṛnmantreṇa tataḥ paramkriyate viṣayāhāraḥ śiromantreṇa deśikaiḥkriyate nijadehasya śikhāmantreṇa deśikaiḥsarvato mantravarṇena kriyate tasya saṃvṛtiḥhṛdayādimayaṃ tejaḥ syādetannetrasaṃjñitamavidyājātamantraṃ tat paraṃ dhāma samīritamśaktidvayapuṭāntaḥsthahalakṣatrayasaṃsthitamatha śṛṅgāṭamadhyasthaśaktidvayapuṭīkṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: cāpaṃ mudrāṃ dadhānāñca śuklāṃ netratrayānvitāmoṅkārajyotiṣaṃ kalpapradīpābhaṃ jaganmayamtataḥ saṅkṣobhaṇadvāre dhyāyet padmaṃ suśobhanamtatra bindunilaye ca dūrato darśanaśravaṇayoḥ samarthatāgamanañca pure pareṣāṃ punarutthānamapyaho mṛtasyamuḍuśreṇīṃ viṣṇorapi padamuḍūnāmapi patimbhavatyeva na sandeho'pyatha syāt sādhakasya camakārabindurūpeṇa tadūrdhve candramaṇḍalamcetasā samprapaśyanti nādānte vṛṣabhadhvajamvyāghrāmbaraṃ tu tanmadhye adhomukhaṃ saśaktikamprasannavadanaṃ śāntaṃ sarpayajñopavītinamnānyat paśyanti tatraiva antaraṃ vṛṣabhadhvajamtatra saṃsthaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā taddhyānamīśvaraṃ viduḥśaṅkhinīnālaṃ saṃsthāpyavyāptiśūnyaṃ vibharti yaḥcandanodyānamadhyasthaṃ vedikāṃ tu tadantaresravantamamṛtaṃ nityaṃ devyaṅge kamalāntaresphuradraśmijālaḥ sudhāṃśuḥ samāstesurairapyagamyaṃ sugopyaṃ suyatnātsaudhīṃ dhārāṃ vimuñcannabhimata phalado yogināṃ yogagamyaḥkartuṃ hartuṃ syācca śaktiḥ samagrāvādhaściraṃ jīvati mṛtyumuktaḥsūkṣmatvāt sadṛśī nirantaragalatpīyūṣadhārādharāsūkṣmatvāt sadṛśī trilokajananī yā dvādaśārkaprabhānityānandapadasthaloruvigaladdhārā nirālambanākeciddhaṃsapadaṃ nirañjanapadaṃ kecinnirālambanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
