sanskrit: dhyāyeccaitanyarūpāmabhimataphalasamprāptaye śaktimādyāmhākinyādyāḥ samastāḥ kamalajapadagāṃ tarpayet kuṇḍalīṃ tāmiḍā ca piṅgalā caiva suṣumnānilayaṃ vrajetcandramārgeṇa vāyuñca pibettañca śanaiḥ śanaiḥsūryamārge pibedvāyuṃ candramārgeṇa recayetdhyātvā tacca padaṃ tu sādhakavaraiḥ dūrīkṛtaścāntakaḥjarāmaraṇaduḥkhādyairmucyate bhavasāgarātpunaḥ pralīyate yasyāṃ kālāgnyādiśivāntakamtasyāstu bandhamātreṇa tannāsti yanna sādhayetnāsau tatphalapātrañca satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥdagdhāḥ santrāsitā hīnā malināśca tiraskṛtāḥvṛddhā bālāstathā prauḍhāstathā yauvanagarvitāḥaṃśakena vihīnāśca khaṇḍaśaḥ śatadhā kṛtāḥsiddhimokṣapradāḥ sarve sādhakena niyojitāḥtattat sidhyatyasandeho yonimudrānibandhanāttato'dhikārī bhavati tantre'smin sādhakottamaḥnāsau lipyati pāpena yonimudrānibandhanātayāsājjāyate siddhirabhyāsānmokṣamāpnuyātmantrāṇāṃ siddhirabhyāsādabhyāsādvāyusādhanametadbhedaṃ vijānāti sa yāti paramaṃ padamdineśāṅgulimānena tadardhañcopavāsataḥata ūrdhvaṃ vahedvāyustriguṇaṃ yadi daivatamśarīrasamatāṃ nītvā nyūnaṃ vā sādhakottamaḥyojayitvā tato jīvaṃ kuṇḍalyā sahitaṃ sudhīḥpīyate khādyate yattu tatsarvaṃ kuṇḍalīmukhe
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhikṣā kāryā na ca svārthaṃ kuṇḍalyāḥ prakṛteḥ punaḥavadhūtāśrame sthitvā bhairavānandatatparaḥtantramantrārcanaṃ sarvaṃ mayi jātaṃ na cānyathāraktamālyāmbaradharo hetuyuktaḥ sadā bhavetyena kenāpi veśena yena kenā'pyalakṣitaḥunmattamukajaḍavat virale lokamadhyagenānāveśadharo yogī vicarettu mahītalesarvabhakṣo yathā vahnistathā yogī sadā śuciḥkṣīyate na ca pāpena badhyate na ca janmanātathā jñānaparo yogī krīḍannindriyapannagaiḥgandhaṃ puṣpañca tāmbulaṃ naivedyaṃ yatra yadbhavetātmanyeva samāyojya devīrūpakuleśvaraḥpūrṇo'haṃ bhairavaścāhaṃ nityānando'hamavyayaḥsarvaśāstrābhiyukto'haṃ sarvamantrārthapāsyāḥānandarūpavān bhūtvā sarveṣāṃ priyakārakacirājjātadhūto dvitīyo maheśaḥvirakto'vadhūto dvitīyo maheśaḥkaulo dharmaḥ paramagahano yogināmapyagamyaḥiti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye ekaviṃśollāsaḥ samāptaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kiraṇasthaṃ tadagrasthaṃ candrabhāskaramadhyagamnirālambe pade śūnye yatteja upajāyateatha pūjāṃ pravakṣyāmi yathātantrānusārataḥnyāsastanmayatābuddhiḥ so'haṃbhāvena pūjayetatha vakṣye japaṃ tatra padmasthavarṇamālayāgrathitā kuṇḍalīśaktiḥ kalānte merusaṃsthitiḥanulomavilomābhyāṃ yathāśakti japañcaretstutibhiḥ sakalaṃ tatra samarpaṇaṃ punaḥ punaḥātmānamaparicchinnaṃ jñātavyaṃ sādhakottamaiḥetadrūpantu cit kuṇḍaṃ caturasraṃ vibhāvayetardhamātrāyonirūpaṃ brahmānandamayaṃ bhavetsamvidagnau huneddhavyaṃ sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥakṣarāṇi hutānyatra niḥśabdaṃ brahma jāyatedharmādharmau sādhakendro havistvena prakalpayetnābhimaṇḍalacaitanyarupāgnau manasā śrucāvahnijāyāntamantreṇa dadyācca prathamāhutimsuṣumnāvartmanā nityamakṣavṛttīrjuhomyamahamprakāśākāśahastābhyāmavalambyonmanīśrucāvahnijāyāntamantreṇa tṛtīyāmāhutiñcaretviśvaṃ juhomi vasudhādiśi vāvasānampūrṇāhutimaye vahnau pūrṇahomaṃ juhomyahamityantaryajanaṃ kṛtvā sākṣādbrahmamayo bhavetmahāntaryajanaṃ vakṣye brahmayajñasvarūpakammanasā ca mano dṛṣṭvā yathā sindhugatā nadīyajñakarttā mahāyogī sarvamantraṃ japet punaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: karmayajño manoyajñaḥ prāṇayajño hutāśanaḥbrahmārpaṇaṃ brahmahavirbrahmāgnau brahmaṇā hutambrahmavat sarvamārgeṣu sarvakarma samabhyaseteṣāmanyatamaṃ kṛtvā yantrarājaṃ samālikhetgaṇḍakītīrapāṣāṇe tathaiva rucipīṭhakeyadvā suvarṇarūpyādau tāmre vā darpaṇe tathāgomayena ca saṃlipte bhūpradeśe manorameśuddhe same bhūrjapatre athavānye tāmrapaṭṭakeratne vā kulaśaktau vā yantraṃ kuryāt susādhakaḥsvayambhu kusumaṃ kuṇḍagolotthaṃ rocanāguruṃeṣa gandhaḥ samākhyātaḥ sarvadā caṇḍikāpriyaḥsvayambhukusumenaiva kuṇḍagolena vā punaḥcandanāgurucandreṇa sindūrarajasāpi vākuṇḍagolodbhavairdravyaiḥ svayambhukusumena casuvarṇaratna lekhanyā sarvakāryārthasiddhayecandrasūryātapaṃ yā vā athavā bilvakaṇṭakaiḥeṣāmekatamaṃ labdhā svīyayantraṃ samuddharettat phalaṃ labhate vīraḥ kṛtveṣṭacakradarśanamna jñātvā suṣamāṃ rekhāṃ nālikhya suṣamaṃ mukhaṃatha vakṣye ca śāktānāṃ sāmānyaṃ yantramūttamamkaravīre raktaśukle droṇe vā yantrarājakepaśorālokanaṃ na syāttathā kuryāt prayatnataḥdevyaṅgakṣatirevātra kriyate pāpabuddhināuttarāśā tadā sāpi pūrvāśaiva na saṃśayaḥpaścimāśāmukho mantrī yathācakraṃ samuddharet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāyukoṇaṃ tadāgneyamīśānaṃ rākṣasaṃ bhavetpūrvāśaiva tadā sā dik rakṣaḥkoṇantu vahnikampūrvāśāpi tadā jñeyā pūrvāśaiva na saṃśayaḥyadāśābhimukho mantrī pūjayeccaṇḍikāṃ śubhāmdevīpaścāt pratīcī syāt prācī tu caṇḍikāpuraḥpūjyapūjakayorantaḥ pūrvāśaiva nigadyatesīsake kāṃśyapātre vā raṅge vā sādhakottamaḥsthāpitaṃ yadi lobhena mohenājñānato'pi vāpuṣpaṃ tatra vinikṣipya gandhacandanasaṃyutamātmābhedena saṃbhāvya puṣpaṃ dadyāt svamūrddhaniiti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye tṛtīyollāsaḥbālāṃ vā tripurāṃ devīṃ savyāṃ vāpyatha bhairavīmdākṣiṇyādvāmabhāvādvā sarvathā siddhimāpnuyātyathā tathā prakāreṇa vāmadakṣiṇato yajetucchiṣṭabhairavīñcaiva tārāṃ tripurasundarīmetāstu vāmabhāvena pūjyā dakṣiṇatāṃ vināvāmāt sarvasamṛddhiḥ syāddevyāḥ priyataro bhavetbrahmāpi ca bhavedvāmo viṣṇuścaiva sadāśivaḥsā tu dakṣiṇavāmābhyāṃ pūjanīyā prayatnataḥmatsyamāṃsāsavābhogī lolupaḥ strīṣu sarvadābhairavo'pi bhavedvāmastathānye devatādayaḥanyāśca caṇḍikādevyā bālikāmūrtayaḥ smṛtāḥvāgbhavī ca sarasvatyā bālikāmūrtirīritāpūjako'pi bhavedvāmastathaiva satataṃ guruḥmahābhairavarūpeṇa tathā ca ratisaṅgame
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi pañcatattvavinirṇayampañcāmāttu paraṃ nāsti śāktānāṃ sukhamokṣayoḥkevalenādyayogena sādhako bhairavo bhavetkevalena tṛtīyena mahābhairavatāṃ vrajetpareṇa paratāṃ yāti śivatulyaḥ sa sādhakaḥyasya bhavedyadā nityaṃ pañcatattvasya sambhavaḥpañcamena vinā devīṃ pañcamīṃ pūjayettu yaḥanyamūrtestu durgāyāḥ pañcamena vinā sadātadvihīnasya yā pūjā japaṃ vā tarpaṇaṃ punaḥcaṇḍikāṃ pūjayedyastu vinā pañcamakārakaiḥmakārapañcakaṃ caiva devatāprītikārakammadyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā matsyaṃ mudrā maithunameva cavinā pañcopacāraṃ hi devīpūjāṃ karoti yaḥvinā māṃsena madyena nā se naṃ śca vi lī va pumpramādādyadi lupyeta devatāśāpamāpnuyāttṛptyarthaṃ sarvadevānāṃ tattvajñānodbhavāya camadyasya lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye sādhakānāṃ hitāya catretāyāṃ pūjitā devī ghṛtena sarvajātibhiḥpūjanīyā kalau devī kevalairāsavaiśca taiḥtattu nānāvidhaṃ dravyaṃ kathyate tantravartmanāsarvotkṛṣṭantu vijñeyaṃ dravyamannena sambhavamrasaṃ vṛkṣalatājātamaikṣavaṃ daśavidhaṃ smṛtammadhūtthaṃ sīdhu mādhvīkaṃ maireyaṃ nārikelajamdvādaśantu surāmadyaṃ sarveṣāmuttamottamamsarvasiddhikarī paiṣṭī gauḍī bhogapradāyiṇī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nārikelodbhavā śrīdā aikṣavaṃ sukhavarddhanamanyā yā vihitā sadā śubhakarī mokṣapradāḥ saptikāḥtarpaṇaṃ parameśānyāḥ sarvakāmaphalapradamyāvanna kurute mantrī tāvaddevārcanaṃ kutaḥsvapriyeṇa hataṃ māṃsaṃ rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajetkṛte'pi siddhihāniḥ syāt kruddhā bhavati caṇḍikāvāmabhāge ca ṣaṭkoṇaṃ tanmadhye brahmarandhrakamsāmānyārghyajalenaiva prokṣayenmaṇḍalaṃ tataḥtatra saṃpūjayedvahnimaṇḍalaṃ tadanantaramtāmraṃ bhūmimayaṃvāpi yadvā lauhavivarjitamkāṃsyaṃ śāntikarañcaiva mṛṇmayaṃ puṣṭidaṃ tathākalasānāṃ pramāṇaṃ tu mukhamaṣṭāṅgulaṃ bhavetādhāre sthāpayitvā tu pūjayet sūryamaṇḍalambhūṣayedraktapuṣpeṇa raktamālyena sādhakaḥsomamaṇḍalamabhyarcya amṛtaṃ paribhāvya capraṇamedbhaktibhāvena mudrābhiḥ pañcasaṃjñakaiḥsakalāṅgulibhiḥ samyaṅmudreyaṃ caturasrikāanyonyābhimukhau hastau puṭākāreṇa kārayetetasyā eva mudrāyāḥ kaniṣṭhāmūladeśakemadhyame sarale kṛtvā tarjanyupari saṃsthitesarvā ekatra saṃyojya aṅguṣṭhaparipīḍitāhrāṃ namaścaturasraṃ syāt hrīṃ namaḥ saṃvṛtastathāsaḥ namo yonimudrā syāt pañcamudrāḥ prakīrtitāḥpraṇavaṃ varuṇaṃ sendu vāmadevañca ṅeyutamviṣaṃ kūrcaṃ tataḥ paśupataye tadanantaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anenādau prapūjyaiva pathikasya baliṃ haretsindūrakuṅkumābhyāñca sarvapathikadevatāḥsahetuṃ sāmiṣānnañca nidhāya manumuddharetbhyo hṛnmanuṃ samuccārya anenotsṛjya sādhakaḥtataḥ kṣiptvā bahiḥsthāne mūlamantraṃ samuccaranmāyāṃ lakṣmīṃ paśudvandvaṃ sendu dīrghadvayānvitamdravyasya harayugmañca dviṭhāntaṃ prajapenmanumastreṇa tāḍanaṃ kuryādvarmaṇābhyukṣaṇaṃ tataḥmūlena gandhamādāya bahannāsāpuṭe tridhāhsauḥ sahauḥ namonatena pūjayet kumbhamadhyakesudhādevyai dhīmahīti tanno'rdhanārīśvareti camāyāvahniyutaṃ kāmaṃ ratibindusamanvitamvāhini candrataḥ prānte sūryāgnibhakṣiṇītyapitridhā ca prajapenmantraṃ brahmaśāpaṃ vimocayetbrahmaśāpapadasyānte vimocitāñca ṅeyutāmmāyāṃ lakṣmīṃ ka(ma)daṃ senduṃ ṣaḍdīrghasvaravahnimatamṛtaṃ srāvayadvandvaṃ dviṭhāntaṃ manumuttamamviṣaṃ binduyutaṃ vāntaṃ dīrghaṣaṭkasamanvitamsudhādevyai hṛdantañca daśadhā sañjapenmanummāyāṃ kāmeśvarīṃ vācaṃ amṛte amṛtodbhavesrāvayadvitayaṃ śaktibījaṃ bhārgavamuddharetsiddhisāmarthyamābhāṣya dahayugmaṃ mahāpadaṃastrāya phaṭ dviṭhāntañca uddhṛtya daśadhā japetsurāṇāmamṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ baladevena dhīmatādattātrayeṇa muninā śukreṇa ca mahātmanā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāratrayantu saṃjapya paṭhedanyatamaṃ manumṣaḍdīrghasvarasambhinnaṃ nādabinduvibhūṣitamsurāśukraśāpaṃ procya mocayadvitayaṃ tataḥdaśadhā parisañjapya śāpatrayaṃ vimocayetmāyāṃ lakṣmīṃ tato vācaṃ amṛte amṛtodbhavedviṭhāntañca samuccārya uccaret kubjikāntataḥhasakhaphreñca hasarīṃ bhagavati tato vadetsahakhaphreṃ yugaṃ procya sanoreva tato vadetvicco'pi hasakhānnñca hasakhableñca hasarīṃtiraskāriṇīṃ tato dhyāyet paśupāśa vināśinīmkhaḍgāyudhā bhagavatī paripātu bhaktānmāyāṃ lakṣmīṃ samuddhṛtya namo bhagavatīti camanaścakṣustiraskariṇīṃ kurudvandvañca ṭhadvayamvāṇīṃ glaiṃ tiraskariṇi sakaleti janeti cajanānte ca manaścakṣuḥ śrotrajihvāpadantataḥṭhadvayañca sargayutaṃ dviṭhānto'yaṃ mahāmanuḥhaṃsapīṭhe mantramaye svaguruṃ śivarūpiṇaṃathavānyaprakāreṇa dravyaśuddhiṃ samācaretnṛsadvarasadvyomasadabjā gojā ṛtajā adrijā ṛtaṃ bṛhatkulakuṇḍalini amṛtaṃ kuru kuru svāhāsadvasurantarīkṣeti saddhotā vedisatyathaṛtaṃ bṛhadityarddhañca asyā ṛca udāhṛtamvāk ca tṛptodbhavasyānte siddhodbhava tataḥ paramamṛtāyāmṛtaṃ proktvā nāthāya padato'mṛtapibadvandvaṃ kulaṃ proktvā kuṇḍalini tato vadet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvayaṃ nirjharayugmañca vāgbhavaṃ bhuvaneśvarīmdviṭhāntaṃ manumuccārya pāyayitvā ca kuṇḍalīmtasmāt sudhāṃ samutpādya pūrayet pātramuttamamkālikāyā viśeṣañca vakṣye'haṃ tantravartmanākacodbhavāṃ brahmahatyāṃ tena te nāśayāmyahamamābījamaye devi śukraśāpādvimucyatāmtena satyena te devi brahmahatyāṃ vyapohatupradadyāt kālikāyai ca tato naivedyabhugbhaveteṣāmekatamaṃ kṛtvā dhyāyedānandabhairavamaṣṭādaśabhujaṃ devaṃ pañcavaktraṃ trilocanamvṛṣārūḍhaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitampāśāṅkaśadharaṃ devaṃ gadāmuṣaladhāriṇamkheṭakamuṇḍahastañca varadābhayavigrahamtasyotsaṅge surāṃ devīṃ candrakoṭyayutaprabhāmbhujāṣṭadaśasaṃyuktāṃ sarvāyudhakarodyatāmathavānyaprakāreṇa surādevīñca cintayetśiraścandrādvigalantīṃ dhyāyettāṃ paradevatāmānandabhairavaṃ devamānandabhairavīṃ tathāṣaṣṭhasvarānvitaṃ vāyuṃ bindunādavibhūṣitamtataḥ pūrvavaduddhṛtya viparītamukhaṃ dvayamṅeyutāṃ netramantrañca kathito manusattamaḥmūlañcopari saṃjapya amṛtaṃ paribhāvayetāvāhanīṃ darśayitvā sthāpanīṃ tadanantaramavaguṇṭhanamudrāñca vidhāya sādhakottamaḥdigbandhanaṃ prakurvīta choṭikābhiranantaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dhenumudrāmṛtīkṛtya dravyaśuddhiṃ samācaretdravyasnānaṃ tataḥ kuryāddakṣe kṛtvā ca cullakamvāmanāsāṅguṣṭhayogāt pūjādravyeṣu nikṣipethastābhyāṃ mārjayeddehaṃ mūlamantraṃ samuccaranata-eva nāma tasya sureti bhuvanatrayetadgandhāghrāṇamātreṇa śatakratuphalaṃ labhettathā tatpānataḥ sākṣāllabhet muktiṃ caturvidhāmtatsvāde ca kriyāśaktiḥ cetaḥ śodhanasādhanāiti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye caturthollāsaḥmāṃsañca trividhaṃ proktaṃ jalabhūcarakhecarammahāmāṃsāṣṭakaṃ proktaṃ devatāprītikārakametanmāṃsāṣṭakaṃ proktaṃ caṇḍikāprītikārakamvarāhavyāghrabhallūkaśaśakāḥ kūrmakukkuṭaumanuṣyo gavayaścaiva śallakī ca viśeṣataḥvihitā balayaḥ proktāścaṇḍikāprītikārakāḥeṣāmekatamaṃ labdhvā tarpaṇārthaṃ prakalpayetpitṛdaivatayajñeṣu vede hiṃsā vidhīyateanimittaṃ tṛṇaṃ vāpi chedayenna kadācanamāṃsaṃ vināpi pūjāyāṃ pāpaṃ syācca pade padehanyānmantreṇa cānena tvabhimantrya paśuṃ tataḥtadbuddhasva paśo tvaṃ hi māśivastvaṃ śivo'si hiparamātmā tadānande tasmāt sevyamidaṃ priyepūjāsu āmamāṃsāni dadyādvai sādhakaḥ kvacitsaṃśodhayettu māṃsāni yathāśāstrapramāṇataḥastrāntamūlamantreṇa prokṣayitvā ca sādhakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śoṣayedvāyubījena vahnibījena sandahettataśca sañjapenmantraṃ māṃsānāṃ śodhanāya castavate mṛgo na bhīmaḥ saṃprocya kucaro bhavetvikramaṇeṣvadhikṣipanti bhuvanāni viśvāḥmūlamantraṃ japedvīraḥ saptavāraṃ tataḥ parampāṭhīnañca vodālaśca tathā śakulaśālakauanena vihitāḥ sarve'pīmā mīnāḥ śubhapradāḥjapenmantraṃ tataḥ paścānmīnānāñca viśuddhayeurvārukamiva bandhanmṛtyormukṣīya mā'mṛtātvraiheyaṃ maṇḍalākāraṃ candravimbanibhaṃ śubhampūjākāle devatāyā mudraiṣā parikīrttitātasyāḥ saṃjñā smṛtā mudrā mahāmodapravardhinīmudrāñca prokṣayedādau śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaretdivīva cakṣurātatamviṣṇoryat paramaṃ padamiti saṃjapya vīrendraḥ śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaretmadyakumbhasahasraistu māṃsabhāraśatairapibhagaliṅgātmikā devī bhagaliṅgāmṛtātmikāvindurūpā ca vindusthā rajovindusvarūpiṇībhagaliṅgāmṛtenaiva tasmāttāṃ paripūjayetbhagaliṅgāmṛtenaiva devīṃ yaśca prapūjayetkulastrīkulapuṣpaiśca kuladravyaiḥ kulāmṛtaiḥvinā kulodbhavairdravyaiḥ pūjayedyaśca caṇḍikāmdravyaśodhanamācarya śaktiśodhanamācaretsnāpitāṃ pramadāṃ divyāṃ hetuyuktāñca dīkṣitām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sālaṅkārāṃ suveśāñca sthāpayet tūlikoparimātṛkānyāsamācarya kalānyāsaṃ samācaretaiṅkāraṃ hṛdaye caiva nābhau bluṅkārameva caṛṣyādikaṃ svakalpoktaṃ pādyādibhistato yajetādhāre hṛdaye caiva bhruvormadhye nyaset kramātmūrddhādipādaparyantaṃ nyāsaṃ kuryāttataḥ paramsīmante likhanaṃ nakhairurasijaṃ gṛhṇīta gāḍhaṃ tataḥjaṅghāṅguṣṭhapadorugulphahananaṃ cānyo'nyataḥ kāminoḥekādaśasvareṇāḍhyaṃ candrabindusamanvitamvāmā yā capalacitte reto muñcadvayaṃ paṭhetsomavadhūsamāyuktaṃ candramantyasvarānvitamtasyā yonau nyasedvidyāṃ ret thu mā to ca mai na taniṃ gha yed ṅge yo na rṣa li mūlamuccārya sādhakaḥsuṣumnāvartmanā nityamakṣavṛttīrjuhomyahamtato japet striyaṃ gacchan mukhe jihvāmṛtaṃ pivetvaruṇaṃ svarasaṃyukta pañcadīrghasamanvitammuhurmuhuḥ pibet pānaṃ śaktijihvāviloḍitamātmani śaktisaṃyogādekībhūtāṃ vicintayetjihvāṃ mūlamayīṃ cintya yoniñca kularūpiṇīmśuddhamantrauṣadhenaiva ret ma na neḥ ñca pra tha yotattvatyāge pīṭhenmūlaṃ sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥdharmādharmakalāsnehapūrṇa agnau juhomyahamśivaśaktisamāyogo yatra yatra prajāyategṛhṇīyāttatprayatnena dravyaṃ kuṇḍodbhavaṃ smṛtamgolodbhavaṃ pravakṣyāmi vīrāṇāṃ siddhihetave
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sālaṅkārāṃ hetuyuktāmanapatyāṃ manoramāmsādhakākāṅkṣahṛdayāṃ kalāśāstravicāriṇīmpūrvoktakramayogena tattvamutpādayet sudhīḥidaṃ golodbhavaṃ dravyaṃ devatātṛptikārakamnānāgandhasamāyuktaṃ kaṭutrayasamanvitamśodhayet kuṇḍagolādīn nayatvarcāsamāhitaḥāsiñcatu prajāpatirdhātā garbhaṃ dadhātu tegarbhaṃ te aśvinau devādhādhattāṃ puṣkarasrajauamṛte amṛtodbhave amṛtavarṣiṇīti caśeṣaṃ pūrvavadācarya athavānyatamañcaretvahnijāyā tāramāyā śrībījaṃ suratipriyetato'mṛtodbhavāyeti amṛtavarṣiṇī paramvahnijāyāntamantreṇa dravyaśuddhiṃ samācarettenāmṛtena deveśīṃ tarpayet sādhakottamaḥacirānmṛtyumāpnoti dvandvaṃ kṛtvā narādhamaḥśaṅkayā jāyate glāniḥ śaṅkayā duḥkhabhājanamśaṅkayā siddhihāniḥ syāttasmācchaṅkāṃ parityajetsvalpāṅgīṃ dīrghakeśīṃ ca sādhakaḥ śuddhabhāvataḥtasyāḥ puṣpaiḥ prayatnena sarvakāmamupālabhetsugandhā sā suratādyairbilvapatraiḥ sugandhitāgaurāṅgī puṣṭajaṅghā yā puṣṭahastā madāturāpuṣpagandhā jagaddhātrī sā sadā kṛṣṇarūpiṇīkṣīṇāṅgī ca yadā kṛṣṇā dīrghakeśī madākulāpuṣṭā kharvā'sitāṅgī yā sā bhavenmadanāśrayākṛśāṅgī gauradīrghā yā sā parā śiśumālinā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: puṣṭā kharvā sitāṅgī yā sendīvaravikārakaiḥkṣīṇā dīrghā ca gaurāṅgī mālatīgandhayojitābandhūkairyadi gaurāṅgī yānaṅgamekhalā śubhāāsāṃ dravyaṃ gṛhītvā tu tenaiva pariśodhayetjñātvā naivaṃ kramaṃ yo hi yadi devīṃ prapūjayetyaduktā daśamī śaktiḥ saṅkīrṇavṛttisaṃsthitāsvayaṃ sraṣṭā svayaṃ viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ devo maheśvaraḥgajāśvānāṃ vṛṣājānāṃ narāṇāṃ śoṇitāruṇaiḥmatsyairmadyaiśca naivedyaiḥ pratyakṣīkriyate naraiḥnādharmo jāyate kiñcinmahāmantrasya sādhanedravyaśuddherabhāvena nityaṃ karmaṃ na lopayetmakārapañcakaṃ kṛtvā punarjanma na vidyateyenāvaśyaṃ vidhātavyaṃ madirādānapūjanamhetubhiḥ parapātrasthaistarpaṇaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavetprāyaścittī sa varjyaśca paśureva na saṃśayaḥvinālimāṃsagandhena paśuḥ paśupatiḥ svayampiśitaṃ tilamātrantu tilārdhamapi bindunāraktavastraiḥ samācchādya pañcatattvaṃ tu rakṣayetsaṃsthāpayenna dakṣe ca dravyaśuddhiritīṃritādvijānāmanukalpantu na sākṣācca vikalpināmbrāhmaṇastāmrapātre tu madhumadyaṃ prakalpayetnārikelodakaṃ kāṃsye guḍārdrakaṃ tathaiva casarvaṃ śūdreṇa dātavyaṃ yatra vā tadrucirbhavetsaṃmardya vaṭikāṃ kṛtvā saṃgṛhyātha vicakṣaṇaḥguḍamiśreṇa takreṇa tarpayenmadhuyojitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: māṃsābhāve tu lasunamārdrakaṃ nāgarantu vāmāṃsānukalpaṃ kathitaṃ mīnasyātha vidhiṃ śṛṇuphalamūlañca yatkiñciddagdhañcedāmiṣaṃ bhavetaparāpuṣpagarbhe tu kulasthānaṃ manoramamhayārikusume nityaṃ svayamasti sadāśivaḥraktakuṅkumarāgaṃ vā bhinnaṃ tattvaṃ śivātmakamkṣaṇaṃ vicintya tatraiva saṃpūjya parameśvarīmantarādadhikaṃ jñeyaṃ etaddravyaṃ sudurlabhamādāya pūjayeddevīmanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavetsvahastena paśuṃ hatvā rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajetiti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye pañcamollāsaḥgṛhītvājñāṃ mahādevyā viśeṣārghyaṃ samācarettrikoṇañcaiva ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vṛttaṃ bhūgṛhasaṃyutamastrāntamūlamantreṇa sāmānyārghyajalena cacaturasre pūrṇaśailamuḍḍīyānaṃ jalandharamaṅgaṣaṭkaṃ yajettatra ṣaṭkoṇeṣu ca mantravitādhāraśaktiṃ madhye ca saṃpūjya tadanantaramādhāreṇa vinā bhraṃśo na ca tṛpyanti mātaraḥādhāraṃ tripadaṃ proktaṃ ṣaṭpadaṃ vā catuṣpadameṣāmanyatamaṃ sthāpya pūjayet kulavartmanāādau senduṃ mahākālaṃ vahnimaṇḍalaṃ ṅeyutamtatra sampūjayedvahneḥ kalādaśakaṃ saṃjñayāsuśrīḥ surūpā kapilā havyakavyavahe'pi caṅeyutā vai namo'ntāśca kalā vahneritīritāḥsvarṇaraupyaśilākūrmakapālālābumṛṇmayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: puṇyavṛkṣasamudbhūtaṃ pātraṃ kuryānmanoramamkāpālaṃ sphuṭamantrasiddhijanakaṃ muktipradaṃ mauktikamśāntike ca śilāpātraṃ stambhe caiva tu mṛṇmayamjñānapradaṃ kapālaṃ syānmāraṇe lauhamuttamamśaṅkhaṃ jñānapradaṃ muktāśuktividyāpradāyinīpuṇyavṛkṣajapātrāṇi sarvapāpaharāṇi caṣoḍaśāṅgulavistāra ṣaṣṭhāṅgulasamucchrayamekāṅgulaṃ tathā sārdhaṃ ṣaṭkañca vai pramāṇataḥna yojayedbhagnapātraṃ svaprādeśaṃ praśasyatemaṇḍalaṃ pūrvavat kṛtvā pūjayet pūrvavartmanāsvarādyaṃ bindusahitaṃ ṅeyutam arkamaṇḍalamkalāḥ sampūjayettatra bhānordvādaśasaṃjñakāḥsuṣumnā bhogadā viśvā bodhinī dhāriṇī kṣamābījādyāśca kalā jñeyāścaturthyādyā namo'nvitāḥraktacandanapuṣpaiśca sugandhaiḥ sumanoharaiḥvaruṇaṃ mūlamantrañca vilomamātṛkāṃ paṭhantatra dūrvākṣatāraktapuṣpacandanasaṃyutammāṃsaṃ matsyaṃ vinikṣipya mudrāñcaiva viśeṣataḥelālavaṅgakakṣvelajātīphalasamanvitamsvayambhūkusumaṃ kuṇḍagolotthañcāṣṭagandhakamsabinduṃ vāmakarṇañca ṅeyutaṃ somamaṇḍalamkalā somasya tatraiva dviraṣṭasaṃkhyakā yajetśaśinī candrikā kāntirjyotsnā śrīḥ prītiraṅgadāakārādyā binduyutā ṅeyutāśca namo'ntikāḥpūrvaṃvattīrthamāvāhya pūrvavanmaṇḍalaṃ likhet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ānandabhairavīṃ devīṃ tatra saṃpūjya deśikaḥāvāhanyādimudrāśca sādhako darśayettataḥdarśayitvā tato mudrāmiṣṭadevaṃ yajettataḥakathāditrirekhāyāṃ madhye māyāṃ samālikhetsampūjayettataḥ paścāt pañcaratnaṃ susādhakaḥgaganānte ca ratnebhyo namo'ntamanumuddharetsvargapadaṃ samuccārya ratnebhyo nama ityapipātālapada ratnebhyo namo'ntaścāparo manuḥmartyaratne tataḥ paścādbhyo namo'tra samuddharetnāgapadaṃ samuccārya ratnebhyo nama ityapivāgbhavānte ca divyaughaṃ gurusaṃjñāñca pādukāmsiddhaughaṃ mānavaughañca pūjayitvā manuṃ japetsvacchandasphuraṇāmatra nidhehyakūlarūpiṇiamṛtatvaṃ nidhehyasnin vastuni klinnarūpiṇibhūtvā parāmṛtākāraṃ mayi citsphuraṇaṃ kurubrahmāṇḍakhaṇḍasambhūtamaśeṣarasasambhavamvāgbhavaṃ pañcamaṃ kṣauṇīṃ vāmaśrotrasamanvitamamṛtavarṣiṇi procya amṛtaṃ srāvayadvayamvāgbhavaṃ vadayugmañca vāgvādini tataḥ paramkledayadvitayaṃ mahāmokṣaṃ kurudvayaṃ vadetpretabījaṃ samuccārya hasaurnamastataḥ paramānandabhairavaṃ devamānandabhairavīmapipūrvoktāścāturasrādyāḥ śaṅkhamudrāṃ tataḥ paramdakṣiṇāṃṅguṣṭha saṃsṛṣṭhā mudraiṣā śaṅkhasaṃjñikāuparyupariyogena militāḥ saralāṅgulīḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: matsyamudrāñca sandarśya dhenumudrāñca darśayettritālachoṭikābhiśca digbandhanaṃ tataścaretiṣṭadevasvarūpañca vibhāvya sādhakottamaḥtathāca siddhavidyānāmācāraḥ kathyate'dhunāśrīvidyoktavidhānena tataḥ pūjāṃ samācarettasmādvinduṃ vinikṣipya sāmānyārghye tataḥ paramguroḥ pātraṃ ghaṭasyānte tadante bhogapātrakamtadante vīrapātrañca balipātraṃ tadantikeuttamaṃ navapātrāṇi saptapātrāṇi madhyamamadhamaṃ tāni pātrāṇi ekapātraṃ na kārayetmantrāḥ parāṅmukhā yānti vighnāścaiva pade padedevīpātraṃ guroḥ pātraṃ bhogapātraṃ trayaṃ matamśakteḥ pātraṃ vīrapātraṃ saptapātreṣvayaṃ vidhiḥpādyamācamanīyañca navapātreṣvayaṃ vidhiḥkumbhasya dakṣiṇe kuryāttrikoṇaṃ vṛttabhūgṛhamtatra sampūjayedvahnimaṇḍalaṃ tadanantaramabhyarcya maṇḍalaṃ tatra sūryasya pūrayettataḥkuṇḍagolaṃ kṣipettatra kusumaṃ gandhacandanamaṅgaṣaṭkaṃ koṇaṣaṭkaṃ mudrāḥ pūrvavadācaretaṣṭadhā mūlamantrañca japtvā binduṃ kṣipettataḥsvasvanāmayutān divyān siddhamānavasaṅghakānaṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāñca vāmahastasya sarvadāguruṃ paraguruñcaiva parāparaguruṃ tathāviśeṣārghyāmṛtenaiva tarpayennijadevatāmgurūṇāṃ pātradakṣe ca bhogapātraṃ prakalpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhogapātrāmṛtenaiva sammārjya karayugmakamkalāyasadṛśaṃ tatra kṣipecchuddhicatuṣṭayamvāmahastasya viprendraḥ svīkuryāttadanena tuṅentaṃ vidyākalātmānaṃ sabinduṃ ṣoḍaśa svaramsthūladehaṃ tataḥ paścāt śodhayāmi padāt dviṭhaḥmāyāṃ lakṣmīṃ tato māyākalāniyatiśabdataḥkādipañcakavargañca binduyuk kāmabījakamśodhayāmi tataḥ svāhā svīkuryādaparantataḥcakṣustatorasanāghrāṇavākpāṇipadaṃ tathāgandhākāśapadaṃ vāyutejaḥ salilaśabdataḥśaktibījaṃ svamantrañca śivatattvena tatparamsvīkṛtya ca punarmāyāṃ lakṣmībījaṃ samuccaretprakṛtyādikamuccārya pañcāśanmātṛkāntataḥtattvatrayāśritaṃ jīvaṃ śodhayāmi tataḥ svāhāsvīkuryādamunā yugmaṃ dakṣavāmakrameṇa tuahamevāhaṃ māṃ juhomi svāhāmām avatuvaktāraṃ svāhāmedhayā spṛṇotu bhuvi sruvaṃ meṇopāyatu svāhāpāṇibhyāṃ sarvadehañca proñchayediti śodhanamkṣālayeddhastayugalamathavānyatamañcaretjyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāhājyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāhājyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāhājyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāhājyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāhā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāhājyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāhāsaptamantramidañcaiva paṭhettattvaviśuddhayeyoginīnāñca saṃsthāpya vīrapātraṃ tataḥ paramācamanīyapātrañca pūrvavat sthāpayedbudhaḥbalipātrāmṛtenaiva vaṭukādīṃśca tarpayetdevīpātrāmṛtaṃ binduṃ pūjādravyopari kṣipetbhogapātrāmṛtaṃ binduṃ svīkuryāttadanantaramyāvanno vaṭuke dadyāt yoginyāṃ sarvabhūtakeakṛtvā balidānaṃ hi kathaṃ pūjāṃ samācaretadattvā vaṭukādīnāṃ yaḥ pūjayati caṇḍikāmdakṣiṇe vaṭuke deyaḥ uttare yoginībaliḥrājarājeśvare madhye baliṃ dadyāt susādhakaḥprokṣaṇaṃ pūrvavat kṛtvā vaṭukaṃ tatra cintayetrjayati vaṭukanāthaḥ siddhidaḥ sādhakānāmaṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāñca baṭukasya baliṃ haretpiṅgalapadato jaṭābhāsvara procya piṅgalavahnijāyāntamuccārya vaṭukasya mahātmanaḥanena balimutsṛjya yāginīścintayettataḥbhaktānāṃ sādhakānāmabhilaṣitaphalaṃ dīyamānāḥ suveśāḥaṅguṣṭhamadhyamānāmā yoginībhyo baliṃ haretsarvābhyo mātṛkābhyaśca ityutsṛjya baliṃ dadetsarvabhūtapatiṃ procya bhyo namo'ntaṃ samuccarettataḥ sañcintayet kṣetranāyakaṃ siddhihetavekhaṭvāṅgaṃ vyomanīlaṃ ḍamarukasahitaṃ kṣetrapālaṃ namāmi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viśaṃ māyāṃ ramābījaṃ kṣakāraṃ bindubhūṣitamimaṃ baliṃ padasyānte pūjāṃ gṛhṇayugaṃ tataḥkṣetrapālabaliṃ dattvā madhye dadyāttataḥ parambalipātrāmṛtenaiva tarpayedvaṭukādikamvāmabhāge sthite caiva sarvavighnaharo bhavetpūrve bhūḥ baliṃ dadyāt kṣetrapālasya paścimerājarājeśvaraṃ madhye baliṃ dadyāt susādhakaḥiti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye ṣaṣṭhollāsaḥpūjādau ca japādau ca japasyānte tathaiva caprāṇāyāmaṣaḍaṅgañca kṛtvā sādhakasattamaḥsvakalpoktavidhānena dhyātvā devīṃ samāhitaḥtejomayīṃ mahādevīṃ dīpāddīpāntaraṃ yathāāvāhanyādimudrāśca darśayettadanantaramiyaṃ tu viparītā cettadā vai sthāpanī bhavetantaraṅguṣṭhamuṣṭibhyāṃ sannirodhanarūpiṇīavaguṇṭhanamudreyamabhito bhrāmitā satīanyo'nyagrathitāṅguṣṭhaprasāritakarāṅguliḥparivṛtya karau paścāt tarjanīmadhyamāyugamdhenumudreyamākhyātā amṛtīkaraṇe budhaiḥdarśayitvā tato mudrāṃ tālatrayapuraḥsaramlelihāmudrayā yantraṃ spṛṣṭvā pañcakuśena vāanāmāyāṃ kṣipedvṛddhāṃ ṛjuṃ kṛtvā kaniṣṭhikāmmūlamantreṇa dīptātmā arghyadravyodakena catataḥ sampūjayeddevīṃ ṣoḍaśairupacārakaiḥmadhuparkācamanasnānavasanābharaṇāni ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pādyārghyācamanasnānavasanābharaṇāni yacatāmbūlamarcanāstotraṃ tarpaṇañca tataḥ parammadhuparkācamanañca gandhaprasūnake tataḥgandhādayo naivedyāntaḥ pūjā pañcopacārikāabhāve puṣpatoyābhyāṃ patreṇa tadabhāvataḥtadabhāve'kṣatenaiva dūrvayā tadabhāvataḥmūlānte devatānāma ṅeyutañca samuddharethṛdayena tu pādyañca śirasārghyaṃ nivedayetśikhāmantreṇa gandhañca puṣpaṃ netreṇa dāpayetpādyādikaṃ nivedyātha snānīyañca nivedayetnānāratnasamāyuktasvarṇasiṃhāsanānviteghṛtenodvartanaṃ kāryaṃ manasā tadanantaramsahasraiḥ svarṇakumbhaiśca sugandhajalapūritaiḥnānātīrthodakaiḥ śuddhairgandharājasahasrakaiḥpañcāmṛtaiḥ pañcagavyaiḥ snāpayettadanantaramsaptamṛttikayā yukta śītalena jalena casuvāsitajalenaiva devyāḥ snānaṃ samācaretbhṛṅgārāṣṭakakumbhaistu devyāḥ snānaṃ vidhāya cakārpāsaṃ vālkalaṃ vārkṣaṃ koṣajaṃ vastramiṣyatesapītāmbarakauṣaṃ vā svadevāya ca utsṛjetnīlaraktaṃ tu yadvastraṃ tatsarvatra vivarjayetvastraṃ dadyānmahādevyai nānyasmai tu kadācanadattvā'ṅgalepanaṃ kākiryaṃ gandhacandanasihlakaiḥyantramadhye samānīya namaskuryāt samāhitaḥyathotpannaṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ tathā dadyācca patrakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nādhomukhaṃ phalaṃ dadyāditi śāstrasya nirṇayaḥaṅguṣṭhatarjanībhyāṃ tu jñānamudrā prakīrtitādadyācca vimalaṃ gandhaṃ mūlamantreṇa pūrvavatmadhyamānāmikābhyāṃ tu madhyaparvaṇi deśikaḥuttolanaṃ tridhā kṛtvā gāyatryā mūlayogataḥanyat sarvaṃ sa vīraḥ pradadyājjñānamudrayāpāyasaṃ kṛśaraṃ dadyāt pālyannaṃ madhusaṃyutamtāmbūlañca tato dadyāt karpūrādisuvāsitampunarmālyaṃ pradātavyaṃ gandhavandanapaṅkajamvidhivat pūjanaṃ kṛtvā tarpayettattvamudrayāaṅguṣṭhe bhairavo devo'nāmāyāṃ caṇḍikā sadāaṅguṣṭhamadhyamābhyāñca vaśyakarmaṇi tarpayettarjanyaṅguṣṭhayogena tarpayedabhicāraketarpaṇañcāṣṭadhā kāryaṃ sakṛdvāpi yathecchayātarpayitvāmahādevīṃ svīyakramamathācaretpūjākāle devatāyā nopari bhrāmayet karamdhyātvā gurukulaṃ dhīro raśmivṛndaṃ tathaiva cavinā yo hi guroḥ pūjāmiṣṭadevaṃ yajed yaditasmāt sarvaprayatnena gurupūjāṃ samācaretmānavaughāḥ samāsena pūjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥyeṣu yeṣu ca mantreṣu ye ye ṛṣigaṇāḥ smṛtāḥajñātvā gurunāmāni gurutritayamarcayetguruḥ paraguruścaiva parāparagurustataḥna jānāmi gurornāma vaṃśaśuddhiḥ kadācanaiti stavena saṃstutya tasminnijaguruṃ yadi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gurupūjāṃ vinā caiva yadi pūjāṃ samācaretpūrvavattarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā raśmivṛndaṃ prapūjayettanmāṃsarudhireṇaiva pāraṇaṃ tasya jāyateaṅgāṅgitvaṃ parityajya devatāśāpamāpnuyātubhābhyāṃ labhate śāpaṃ mantrī cañcalamānasaḥsampūjya devatāḥ sarvāstarpayettadanantarampunaḥ sampūjayed devīmupacāraiśca vistaraiḥvastraṃ vā cārmaṇaṃ koṣaṃ maṇḍapasyottare sṛjetśyāmā dūrvā paṅkajañca viṣṇukrāntāsamanvitamsadūrvaiḥ sarvadevānāmetadarghyamudīritamvāsitantu sugandhādyaiḥ karttavyaṃ yadi labhyatecandanāgurukarpūraṃ corakuṅkumarocanāḥnānāvidhāni puṣpāṇi vasanābharaṇāni casarvāṅgalepanaṃ dadyād dhūpaṃ dadyāttataḥ parammadhunā ghṛtasaṃyukto dhūpo'yaṃ caṇḍikāpriyaḥvakratārahitavārijamudrā dhūpavartiriha sundari bhadrākuṣṭhaṃ guḍaḥ sarjarasastathaiva daśāṅgadhūpaḥ kathito munīndraiḥdhūpayedājyasaṃmiśrairnocairdevasya deśikaḥeṣāmekatamaṃ kṛtvā nivedya śāstravartmanāghṛtapradīpaṃ prathamaṃ tilatailodbhavaṃ tataḥpraṇavaṃ jayadhvanipadaṃ mātaḥ svāhā tataḥ paramtaijasaṃ dārujaṃ vāpi ārttikyaṃ dīpavṛkṣakamevaṃ dīpaṃ prakurvīta netrarañjanakārakamabhito dīpayenmantrī dīpamālāṃ ghṛtalpatāmvarttā karpūragandhinyā sarpiṣā tilajena vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dīpābaliṃ tato dattvā kuladīpaṃ nivedayetdalāṣṭakayutaṃ padmaṃ vilikhya tatra sādhakaḥaṣṭapatreṣu madhye ca sthāpayitvā tataḥ paramsaptadhā tatra uttolya navadhā bhrāmayettataḥtataśca sādhakaśreṣṭhaścakramudrāṃ pradarśayetdakṣiṇe yojayitvā tu kaniṣṭhe garbhake budhaḥanyonyayogataścaiva cakramudrā prakīrtitātaijaseṣu ca pātreṣu prastare vā'bjapatrakesarvābhāve tu māheye svahastaghaṭite yadiyadyogyaṃ sarvapātre tu tannidhāya nivedayetna gṛhṇāti mahādevī dattaṃ vidhiśatairapinānāvidhāni dravyāṇi dattvā devyai prayatnataḥdattvā devyai prayatnena annaṃ bahuvidhaṃ tathākaṭvamlamadhurañcaiva paramānnaṃ saśarkaramdugdhaṃ dadhi tathā takraṃ navanītaṃ saśarkaramcarvyaṃ coṣyaṃ lehyapeyaṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ nivedayetcullukañca tato dattvā prāṇamudrāṃ pradarśayetvṛddhāmadhyātarjanībhirapānasya prakīrtitākaniṣthābhinnasarvābhirudānasya samīritāprāṇāpānau tathā vyāna udānaśca samānakaḥvāmahaste prāsamudrā prāsavat parikīrtitāsvayambhūkusumaṃ kuṇḍagolotthaṃ rocanāgurumgandhapuṣpaṃ tathā mālyaṃ raktapuṣpādibhūṣaṇamdroṇāparājitāpuṣpaṃ karavīraṃ javāṃ tathādatte caiva javāpuṣpe paṭṭavastraphalaṃ labhet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tāmbūlañca tato dadyāt karpūrādisuvāsitamdarpaṇaṃ pādukāṃ chatraṃ cāmaraṃ vyajanādikamyatnatastu baliṃ dadyānna hanyādātmanā punaḥyadi hanyāt pramādena rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajetgṛhītvā śoṇitaṃ pātre svakīyaṃ hṛdayodbhavampradadyācca mahādevyai sarvasaubhāgyahetaveśaktibījena vā dadyānnābherūrdhvamadho nahitataśca sādhakaśreṣṭho mantraśuddhiṃ mācaretkramāt kramād dvirāvṛttirmantraśuddhiritīritājapañca trividhaṃ proktaṃ vācikopāṃśumānasamtajjapaṃ vācikaṃ viddhi jihvāmātramupāṃśukamvācikasya śataṃ jñeyaṃ ekottaramupāṃśunānigadaśca tathā jñeyaḥ spaṣṭavācā nigadyatemānasaśca sa boddhavyaścintanākṣararūpavānupāṃśusmaraṇenaiva tulyaṃ bhavati sarvathāmānasoccāraṇāttulyaṃ jāyate sādhakasya casvaguruṃ mūrdhni sañcintya hṛdi devīṃ tataḥ paramjapasyādau śivāṃ dhyāyet dhyānasyānte punarjapetdhyānaṃ kṛtvā japenmantraṃ guruktakramato budhaḥtataḥ sampūjayenmālāṃ toyairabhyukṣya yatnataḥoṃ māle māle mahāmāle sarvasiddhisvarūpiṇipūjayitvā tato mālāṃ gṛhītvā dakṣiṇe karevinā yantrañca mantrañca kavacaṃ mantraśūnyataḥsaṃkhyā kṛtā mṛttikā ca akṣatañca tathaiva catarjanyā na spṛśenmālāmaṅguṣṭhāgreṇa cālayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: niḥsetuśca yathā toyaṃ kṣaṇānnimnaṃ prasarpatiśūdrāṇāṃ candrabindustha aukāraḥ seturucyatedvisetavaḥ samākhyātāḥ sarvathaiva dvijātayaḥsetuṃ vinā bhavedvayarthaṃ tasmāt setuṃ samācaretpūrvabījaṃ japan yastu parabījantu saṃspṛśetevamuktavidhānena vilambaṃ tvaritaṃ tyajetgaṇanāvidhimullaṅghya yo japettajjapaṃ punaḥathavā karamālāyāṃ mātṛkāyāṃ tathaiva canityajape ca home ca yatra saṃkhyā na coditāaṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpi triṃśadvāpi kadācanayathāśakti japaṃ kṛtvā prāṇāyāmaṃ vidhāya catejomayaṃ japaphalaṃ devyā haste samarpayettrividhena natiṃ kuryādaṣṭāṅgakavidhānakaiḥbrahmarandhreṇa karṇābhyāṃ yadbhūmeḥ sparśanaṃ bhavetaṣṭāṅganamanaṃ jñeyaṃ nityahomaṃ tataḥ paramna kuryāt kāmyahomaṃ vai vinā kuṇḍena mantravitaṅgulotsedhasaṃyuktaṃ vālukābhiḥ samantataḥādhāraśaktimabhyarcya pūrvavacca ṣaḍaṅgakamśabdāstramanunā mantrī nair-ṛtyāṃ jvaladagnikamagniṃ prajvālya mūlena jvālinīñca pradarśayetmadhyame milite kṛtvā tanmadhye'ṅguṣṭhakau kṣipetagniṃ sampūjayitvā tu śivaśaktisamāgamātāvāhanyādikā mudrā darśayitvā tu rakṣayetsaṃsthāpya havanīyañca pūrvavat prokṣaṇañcaretpūrvavanmaṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā pūjayet pūrvavartmanā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: daśadhā mūlamantreṇa abhimantrya hunettataḥtāraṃ bhuvo vahnijāyā idañca vāyave padamityāhutitrayaṃ hutvā mahāvyāhṛtisāṅkamṣaḍaṅgamanunā ṣaṭkamāhutiṃ juhuyāttataḥtataḥ svāhā samuccārya aṣṭottarasahasrakamaṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpi tadarddhaṃ vāpi sādhakaḥmāṃsena madhunā cājyairmatsyaiḥ puṣpaistilaistathāapāmārgairbilvapatrairbhṛṅgarājaiḥ suśobhanaiḥpadmaiśca kumudaiḥ kundairnīlaraktotpalaistathājātībhirmālatībhiśca mallikābhiḥ kadambakaiḥanena vidhinā mantrī devyā homaṃ samāpya caguruvṛndaṃ raśmivṛndaṃ samāvāhya hunettataḥāhutitritayaṃ hutvā punardevyai prayatnataḥsaṃhāramudrayā devīṃ oṃ agnaye tataḥ paramvisṛjyāgniñca devīñca śaṅkhaghaṇṭāñca vādayetdevyaṅgamūrdhni saṃhṛtvā śeṣaṃ karma samācaretpañcatattvaṃ mahādevyai dattvā na svīkaroti yaḥrogī duḥkhī daridraśca bhūtvā narakamāpnuyātpānañca trividhaṃ proktaṃ divyavīrapaśukramātsaṃskārādivihīnaṃ yattat pānaṃ pāśavaṃ smṛtamiti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye saptamollāsaḥannamadhye tvaṣṭapatraṃ padmaṃ nirmāya tatra vaitato dhyāyedannapūrṇāṃ paramānandadāyinīmmambāṃ bhaje sakalabhūṣaṇabhūṣitāṅgīmtattvamudrāṃ pradarśyātha idamannāmṛtaṃ vadet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatra santarpayedbhaktyā annapūrṇā yajettataḥhṛdante bhagavatyante māheśvarīpadaṃ likhetyathāśakti japaṃ kṛtvā stutvā devīṃ samāhitaḥpāpiṣṭhāste caṇḍikāyāḥ prasādabhājanaṃ nahisādhubhaktasya jihvāyāmaśnāmi kamalekṣaṇetasmāt kaulikavaktreṣu hotavyaṃ sādhakottamaiḥkaulānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye yathātantrānusārataḥkulajñānaratāḥ śāntāḥ śivabhaktā dṛḍhavratāḥānandāśruyutā vīrāḥ kathitāḥ kaulikeśvarāḥiti ye niścitadhiyaḥ proktāste kaulikottamāḥkulārcanaratapuṃsāṃ kaulikaḥ so'dhikaḥ sadāprīto bhavati yo dṛṣṭvā kaulikaḥ sa śivapriyaḥdevatāgurubhaktaścet kaulikaḥ syācca dīkṣayāyaḥ śaktīḥ svayamāhūya kulābhijñāṃstathaiva camādibhiḥ pañcamudrābhiḥ sadbhaktyā paritoṣayetkulajñānī vased yatra sa deśaḥ puṇyabhājanaḥkulajñāninamālokya svagṛhe'nyagṛhe sthitampraviśya kulayogīśaṃ bhuñjate pitṛdevatāḥdevāḥ kulapriyāḥ sarve tasmāt kaulikamarcayetkuladharmaparā hyete mānuṣeṣu ca kā kathākaulikendre'rcite samyag yathā tuṣṭā hi caṇḍikātatphalaṃ nāpnuyāttirthaistapovratamakhaiḥ sadākaulikasya bhaved vyarthaṃ kaulikaṃ yo'vamānayetkulaniṣṭhaṃ parityajya yaccānyasmai pradīyatepāpācārasamāyuktaṃ sarvalokabahiṣkṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kaulikendraḥ sakṛdbhuṅkte puṇyaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavettasmāt sarvaprayatnena sarvāvasthāsu sarvathānandanti pitaraḥ sarve gāyanti ca pitāmahāḥyajñakoṭiphalaṃ tasya vājapeyaśatāni capṛthivī hemapūrṇā ca kalpakoṭipradānataḥkaulikeṣu prasanneṣu prasannā caṇḍikā bhavetpunāti kuladharmiṣṭhaścaṇḍālo'pi yadṛcchayāsarvathaiva śivaḥ so'pi tasmādyatnāt samarcayetyatsamīpaṃ samāyānti kulācāryāśca sādhakāḥsvaśaktiṃ vīraśaktiṃ vā dīkṣitāṃ gṛhiṇīmathaanivedya tu yaḥ śaktau kuladravyaṃ niṣevatevinā yantreṇa yā pūjā vinā māṃsena tarpaṇamāhūto yo nivarteta anāhūto'pi yo viśettiraścāṃ yonimālambya narakān pratipadyatetataḥ kaulāḥ striyaḥ sarvā prakṣālya pāṇipādakamstrīṇāmanyatamaṃ sthānaṃ puṃsāmanyatamaṃ pṛthakpaṅktyākāreṇa vā samyak cakrākāreṇa vā'thavātaṃ bhakṣayanti yoginyastaṃ śapeccaṇḍikā sadāpravṛtte bhairavīcakre sarve varṇā dvijātayaḥrahasyamārganiratā ye ye varṇā bhavanti hisvargādipuṇyalokeṣu devādanyo yathā na hivede'pi sthitamevaṃ hi sarvaṃ brahmeti cābravītpuruṣāḥ śivarūpāśca devīrūpāḥ striyaḥ sadāsaṃskārājjyeṣṭhakramato lalāṭe gandhacandanaiḥkṛtvā vilepanaṃ mālyaṃ pradadyāt sādhakottamaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nayanāgnivāṇasaṃkhyātaiḥ karṣantu sādhakena caityapyadhikapānaṃ tu na kartavyaṃ tu sādhakaiḥtataḥ śrīgurupādāya sākṣāt paraśivāya cadattvāmṛtarasaṃ pūrṇaṃ gurave tadanantaramkulajāya kulīnāya kulabhaktāya dāpayetvīrebhyo vīrapātrañca bhogapātraṃ svayaṃ pibetsudhābuddhyā tataḥ sarve gṛhītvā pātramuttamamsamudre madhyamāne tu kṣīrābdhau sāgarottamegomūtrasadṛśākārāṃ phenāmṛtasamudbhavāmānandaśikhare jāta ānandaśca maheśvaraḥtasmādimāṃ surādevīṃ pūrṇo'haṃ tāṃ bhajāmyahamtasyopari tato vīraḥ pañca mudrāḥ pradarśayettālatrayachoṭikābhiḥ kurvīta dikṣu bandhanamānandabhairavīṃ devīṃ gurupaṅktiṃ prayatnataḥvaṭukaṃ bhairavañcaiva yoginīṃ ḍākinīṃ tathāayaṣṭvā bhairavaṃ devamakṛtvā gurutarpaṇamgurupaṅktīrasantarpyaraśmivṛndaṃ tathaiva cakaulajñānaṃ vinā yo'pi taddravyaṃ bhauktumicchatiseveta madyamāṃsāni bhraṣṭaśca pātakī bhavetbhedapāśavinirmukto madyapānaṃ samācaretpāśayeddevatāprītyai tattvamāṃsāni sādhakaḥyāgakālaṃ vinā'nyatra dūṣaṇaṃ jāyate sadāna sa siddhimavāpnoti paratra na parāṃ gatimna tasya sadgatiḥ kā'pi tapasā sukṛtādibhiḥpūrṇābhiṣekahīnānāṃ pānamatyantadurgatiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ye'smin cakre pravartante teṣāṃ hiṃsanti bhairavāḥjapapūjāṃ vinā naiva na kāryaṃ dravyabhakṣaṇammantrasaṃskāraśuddhātmā alipānaṃ samācaretvicārayettato vīraḥ sattarkeṇa viśeṣataḥkāñjikaṃ kāsamardañca tathaiva ca śivāghṛtamsurāṃ pītvā dvijo mohādagnivarṇāṃ surāṃ pibetmohādajñānataḥ pītvā prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyatedevān pitṝn samabhyarcya vedaśāstroktavartmanāguruṃ smaran pibanmadyaṃ khādanmāṃsaṃ na doṣabhākyathā kratuṣu viprāṇāṃ somapānaṃ vidhīyatephalārthināmahaṅkāravatāṃ dūṣaṇameva hipānerbhrāntirbhaved yasya ghṛṇā syādraktaretasoḥsa bhraṣṭaḥ pūjayeccaṇḍīṃ devīmantraṃ kathaṃ japettasmādadvaitabhāvena sādhakaḥ pañcamaṃ bhajetānandaḥ śekharaḥ prokta ānandastu sadāśivaḥaho bhuktañca madyaṃ hi mohayet tridaśānapitayoraikyasamutpannamānandaṃ mokṣa ucyatetasyābhivyañjakaṃ madyaṃ yogibhistena pīyatepūrvavadvidhinā vīraḥ pātrasya vandanaṃ caretvande śrīprathamaṃ karāmbujagataṃ pātraṃ viśuddhipradamjānatā'jānatā vāpi yanmayā kriyate śiveiti stutvā mahādevīmanyonya vandanañcaretjuṣasvetyanujñāto guruṇā vā kulīnakaiḥsavyenoddhṛtya pātrañca mudrāṃ kṛtvā'pasavyataḥnoddharedekahastena na pibedekapāṇinā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ātmamūlatrikoṇasthe koṭisūryasamaprabhesaśabdaṃ na pibeddravyaṃ na binduṃ pātayedadhaḥrauravaṃ narakaṃ yāti yāvadāhutasaṃplavamtasmāt pracarvayeccarvyaṃ yathākramavidhānataḥekapātre pibeddravyaṃ te yānti narakaṃ kilabahiḥ prakṣālya ca karau kuladravyāṇi dāpayetniṣṭhīvanaṃ malaṃ mūtramadhovāyuvisarjanamparīhāsaṃ pralāpañca vitaṇḍāṃ bahubhāṣaṇamna pādābhyāṃ spṛśet pātramadhamāṅgena sarvathāsaśabdaṃ noddharet pātraṃ tathaiva ca na pūrayetsādhāraṃ noddharet pātramanādhāre na niḥkṣipetna pātraṃ laṅghayeddhīmān utkṣipya na ca pātayetvandayecca punaḥ pātraṃ imaṃ mantraṃ smaredbudhaḥvande pātramahaṃ dvitīyamadhunā'nandaikasamvarddhanammudrayā sahitaṃ dhṛtvā vandayet pātramuttamamdhyātaṃ devagaṇaiḥ paraṃ munigaṇairmokṣārthibhiḥ sarvadā vandepātramahaṃ tṛtīyamadhunā svātmāvabodhakṣamampūrvavattarpayitvā tu caturthaṃ vandayettataḥpāyāt pañcamakāratattvasahitaṃ pātraṃ caturthaṃ namaḥpūrvavattarpayitvā tu pañcamaṃ vandayettataḥādityapramukhaiḥ surāsuragaṇairājñākaraiḥ kiṅkaraiḥprapibet tu tataḥ ṣaṣṭhaṃ pātraṃ sampūjya mantravitśrīmat sundaritarpaṇaṃ harirasaṃ pātrañca ṣaṣṭhaṃ bhajepūrvavat tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā saptamañca samarcayetpātraṃ saptamapūraṇena paramānandādhikaṃ pātu māmlabheta sarvakarmāṇi dehānte bhairavo bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pītvā saptamapātrañca śāntistotraṃ paṭhettataḥcintāmaṇiṃ kulagaṇādhipatiṃ namāmidevīsutaṃ vaṭukanāthamahaṃ namāmidiśatu sakalakāmān kaulikānāṃ gaṇeśaḥśāpāḥ patantu samayadviṣi yoginīnāmstā devyo ripupakṣabhakṣaṇaparāstṛpyantu kaulārcitāḥstṛpyantāṃ kulaputrakasya pibataḥ pānaṃ sadīpaṃ carumsatyañcāpi ca kauladharmaparamaṃ syānme jayaḥ sarvadākālāgnyādiśivāntañca jagad yajñena tṛpyatukarotu śāntiṃ bhagavān gaṇeśaḥdoṣāḥ prayāntu śāntiṃ sarvajanāḥ sukhībhavantunandantu ca kulācāryā ye cānye kulapālakāḥavasthā śāmbhavī no'stu prasano'stu guruḥsadāprītāḥ prasannā varadā bhavantuste te yāntu vināśamatra samaye śrībhairavasyājñayāḍākinīnāṃ mukhe yāntu tṛptāste piśitaiḥ sadāiti stotraṃ paṭhan pānaṃ kuryāt sādhakasattamaḥdevīṃ vakṣasi sañjapannanudinaṃ pātraṃ bhaje cāṣṭamampūrvavattarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā navamañca prapūjayettatpātraṃ navamaṃ pibecca niyataṃ bhuktiñca muktipradamyathāvidhisamabhyarcya juhuyāt kuṇḍalīmukhetatpātraṃ daśamaṃ pibecca paramaṃ bhuktiñca muktipradamso'haṃ pratyakcitsvarūpo'hamātmāevaṃ sañcintya vīrendraḥ punaḥ pānaṃ samācaretpānollāsavilāsapūrṇasamaye pātrañca ekādaśam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: datte ca siddhihāniḥ syād devatāśāpamāpnuyātādāya svīyapātrañca pibed dravyaṃ guruṃ smaranucchiṣṭaṃ bhakṣayet strīṇāṃ tābhyo nocchiṣṭamarpayetśaktyucchiṣṭaṃ pibeddravyaṃ vīrocchiṣṭañca carvaṇamkaniṣṭhebhyaḥ svaśiṣyebhyaścocchiṣṭañca pradāpayetyāvanna calate dṛṣṭiryāvanna calate manaḥmantrārthasphuraṇārthāya brahmajñāna sthirāya capītvā pītvā punaḥ pītvā patitvā ca mahītalealimīnāṅganāsaṅge yat sukhaṃ jāyate nṝṇāmcakramadhye ghaṭe bhagne pātre ca patite tathādīpanāśe ca tacchāntyai punaścakraṃ samācaretpūrvavat tarpayeddevīṃ parivārasamanvitāmdhūpaṃ dīpaṃ tataḥ paścāddarpaṇaṃ cāmaraṃ tathāyathāśakti stavaṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya sādhakaḥoṃ itaḥ pūrvaṃ tataḥ prāṇabuddhidehaṃ tato vadetkarmaṇā manasā vācā hastābhyāñca tataḥ padbhyāmyaduktaṃ procya tatsarvaṃ māṃ madīyañca saṃlikhetsamarpaṇaṃ tataḥ paścādetenaiva samarpayetpunarācamanīyañca dadyāddevyai punaḥ punaḥarghyapātraṃ tataḥ paścāduttolya sādhakottamaḥtejomayīṃ mahādevīṃ saṃhāramudrayā hṛdinirmālyakusumairdevīṃ praṇamya gurupādukāmkṛtvā so'haṃ vibhāvyātha sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥnāstikebhyo na paśubhyo na mūrkhebhyo pradāpayetnaivedyaṃ caṇḍikādevyā vāñchanti vibudhāḥ sadā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahyaṃ śukrāya sūryāya gaṇeśāya yamāya caīśānāya mahādevīsādhakāya prakalpayetyatnataḥ sādhakaśreṣṭho nirmālyāni samarpayetmālyaṃ gandhaṃ tato dattvā ātmadehaṃ tato'rpayetśrīpātragrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā ādau cakraṃ karoti yaḥarghyāmṛtaṃ tato vīraḥ sāmayikebhyo nivedayetprabandhe pūrṇapātrañca pragṛhya sādhakottamaḥdāsvādyāpi pibedrasaṃ sukhakaraṃ duḥkhasya nirmūlanamarghyasya bindumātreṇa mukto bhavati pātakātnyubjīkuryācca tadbhūmau tatra puṣpaṃ kṣiped budhaḥkaniṣṭhāṅgulinā vāmahastasya tilakaṃ tathāyaṃ yaṃ spṛśāmi pādena yaṃ yaṃ paśyāmi cakṣuṣātataḥ prakṣālya vīrendro gopayet pātramuttamambhojayecca tato vidvān strībhiśca sādhakaiḥ sahatāmbūlābharaṇādīṃśca tathā talpaṃ susādhakaḥjāyate bhairavāveśaḥ sarvatra samadarśanaḥvāraṇāt tripurā ruṣṭā tato hānistu jāyategoṣṭhīmadhye tu yatnena sparśaṃ tasya na kārayetmadhumattāya vīrāya puṇyaṃ tasya na gaṇyatebhagarūpā ca sā devī retaḥprītā ca sarvadādhyātvā kuṇḍalinīṃ śaktiṃ raman reto vimuñcayetātmadehasvarūpeṇa tatkarṇe mantramutsṛjetratikāle ca dīkṣāyāmabhiṣekaṃ samācaretsambhoge'bhiṣicennārīṃ raṇḍāñca mantravarjitāmnamaḥ śabdaṃ samuccārya imāṃ śiktaṃ tato vadet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vahnijāyāṃ samuccārya śuddhimantraḥ prakīrttitaḥramamāṇo bhavennityaṃ sarvasiddhimavāpnuyātrambhā śacyurvaśī mukhyā yā nārī gagane bhuvitasya varjyā ca yā nārī kathyate tantravartmanāmanasā karmaṇā vācā ramaṇaṃ tatra varjayetguroḥ snuṣā ca kanyā ca svaputrī mantraputrikākaulikasya ca patnī vai sākṣāt siddhīśvarī śivāmātā'pi gauravādvarjyā śivahīnā tathaiva camantramātā ca putrī ca bhaginī ca kulāṅganāguruvīravadhūṃ tyaktvā ramyāḥ sarvāśca yoṣitaḥadvaitānāñca kutrāpi niṣedho naiva vidyategarbhaniḥsārakāle tu bālako hi digambaraḥjananīyonisambandhaḥsutaḥ śiśnā'dhigacchatinirvikāratayā nātra bhavet nahyanyathā tataḥtadā doṣāya bhavati nānyathā dūṣaṇaṃ kvacittadārūḍheṣu vīreṣu kāryākāryaṃ na vidyateniścayaṃ muktimāpnoti sahasrayonidarśanātamedhyamapi medhyaṃ syāddvaitānāñca niścitamagamyā'pi ca gamyā syāddvaitānāṃ suniścitamna svargo naiva narakamadvaitānāñca niścitamtatra tatrāpi boddhavyaṃ sandigdhānāṃ suniścitamtasmācca yatnato vīro guruyoniṃ parityajetpañcatattvamasaṃyuktaṃ pañcamaṃ yastu kārayettattvahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ karma japakarma ca niṣphalamcakraṃ tyaktvā tu deveśīṃ pūjayettarpaṇaṃ vinā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: cakramadhye tu yaddṛṣṭaṃ śubhaṃ vā yadi vā'śubhamnityapūjā ca kathitā sādhakānāṃ susiddhayeiti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye aṣṭamollāsaḥatyantagopanādyastu pañcatattvena pūjayettasmāt pūjāṃ sadā kuryāt siddhārthī siddhisaṃgrahaḥsarvapraśamanaṃ yāti īśvaro jāyate bhuvipūjāhīno'śucirnityaṃ garhitaḥ sarvakarmasutajjapaṃ viphalaṃ vidyāt sa mantrī pātakī bhavetsa mahāpātakī bhūtvā paśuyonimavāpnuyātpāraṇaṃ yoginīnāñca bhairavāṇāṃ bhaveddhruvamyadgehe pūjayed devīṃ sadaiva tatra pūjanamdivase pañcamaiḥ pūjā rāṣṭrahāniṃ karoti hitasmāt pañcamakāreṇa divase naiva sarvadāmāsapūjā'dhamā proktā māsādūrdhvaṃ paśurbhavetvihitairmādibhirdravyairmāsādūrdhvaṃ samācaretsaṃkrāntiḥ pañcaparvāṇi puṇyādi divaseṣu capīṭhopagamane vīrākulapīṭhasya darśaneevamādiṣu kāleṣu viśeṣadivaseṣu camānavaughādipuṃsāñca svajanmadivase'pi caaṣṭamyāñca caturdaśyāṃ pūjā kāryā prayatnataḥiti pūrvāpare prāpte pañcatattvaiśca sādhakaḥbahiḥpūjāvidhānena gandharvo vāpi kinnaraḥyatirvā bhūpatirvāpi nānyo'sti pūjakaḥ kvacitdevaścidānandamayo hṛdi bhāvena dṛśyatetatra tatra mahādevī prakāśamanugacchati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vārāṇasyāṃ mahāpūjā sampūrṇaphaladāyinītato'pi dviguṇā proktā dvārakāyāṃ viśeṣataḥvindhye śataguṇā proktā gaṅgāyāmapi tatsamāvindhyavat phaladā pūjā prayāge puṣkareṣu catasmāccaturguṇaphalā nandikuṇḍe ca niścitamtataḥ siddhīśvarīyonau tato'pi dviguṇā smṛtātatsamā kāmarūpe ca sarvatraiva jale sthaledevīpūjā tathā śaktyāṃ kāmarūpe surālayekaratoyānadīpūrvaṃ yāvaddikkaravāsinītrikoṇaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇañca kāmarūpamudāhṛtamvyaktād guptaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ labhyate sādhakottamaiḥanyatra viralā devī kāmarūpe gṛhe gṛhetato'pi dviguṇā proktā sumerau śivaliṅgaketataḥ śataguṇā proktā kāmākhyāyonimaṇḍalepīṭhānāṃ paramaṃ pīṭhaṃ kāmarūpaṃ mahākulamyatra koṭiguṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ māyā mahiṣamardinīyato devāśca devyaśca munayaścaiva bhāvajāḥkāmākhyāyāṃ mahāyonau pūjāṃ yaḥ kṛtavān sakṛtatra yatkriyate pūjā sakṛdvā sādhakena caatha vakṣyāmi sāmānya pūjāyāḥ kramamuttamamaṅgulīvyāpakanyāsau hṛdādinyāsa eva cadhyānaṃ pūjā japaśceti sarvatantreṣvayaṃ vidhiḥkṛtañca niṣphalaṃ vidyāt tasmādādau lipiṃ nyasetna dadāti baliṃ yastu śivāyāḥ śivatāptayepaśurūpāṃ śivāṃ devīṃ yo nārcayati nirjane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūjā japavidhānāni yatkiñcit sukṛtāni caavaśyamannapānena niyataṃ toṣayecchivāmtadaiva sarvaśaktīnāṃ prītiḥ paramadurlabhāpūjitā viguṇaṃ karma saguṇaṃ sādhayed yataḥrājādibhayamāpanne grahādibhayameva cabilvamūle prāntare vā śmaśāne vāpi sādhakaḥgṛhṇa devi mahābhāge śive kālāgnirūpiṇievamuccārya dātavyo baliḥ kulajanapriyaḥpaśurūpā samāyāti parivāragaṇaiḥ sahatadaiva maṅgalaṃ tasya nānyathā sādhakasya canitye naimittike kāmye baliṃ dadyāt prayatnataḥkulapūjāṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāśāstravidhānataḥkulatithau kularkṣe ca kulapūjāṃ samācaretyathā viṣṇutithau viṣṇuḥ pūjito vāñchitapradaḥnityaśrāddhaṃ tathā sandhyāvandanaṃ pitṛtarpaṇamekarātraṃ dvirātraṃ vā nahi cet kulapūjanamkulapūjāsamaṃ nāsti puṇyamanyajjagattrayeanadhīto'pyaśāstrajño gurubhakto dṛḍhavrataḥicchāsiddhiphalaṃ dadyāt pūjitā suvadhūrivakulapūjāntarāyaṃ tu yaḥ karoti hi durmatiḥviguṇaṃ yatra yadyat syāt saguṇaṃ kulapūjanātkva snānaṃ kva ca vā śuddhiḥ kva ca nyāsaviśodhanamlabhate sarvasiddhiñca nātra kāryā vicāraṇādvitīyā daśamī ṣaṣṭhī kulākulamudāhṛtamraviḥ somo guruḥ śauriścatvāraścākulā matāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāruṇārdrābhijinmūlaṃ kulākulamudāhṛtamtithivāre ca nakṣatre cākule sthāyino'jayaḥpaurṇamāsyantamāsena tithikṛtyaṃ vidhīyatekathitaḥ kulavārādinirṇayaḥ siddhihetavelākṣārasatadvadahe vīrastūlikāṃ racayettataḥbrāhmaṇī bhadrakanyā ca tathā gopālakanyakācaṇḍālī carmakārī ca māgadhīpukkasī tathākulāṣṭakaṃ tu kathitamakulāṣṭakamucyategomukhī rajakī śilpī venakī ca tathāṣṭamītantukārī carmakārī mātaṅgī pukkasī tathārajakī rajjakī caiva sairindhrī ca vilāsinīviśeṣavaidagdhyayutāḥ sarvā eva kulāṅganāḥmantratantrasamāyuktāḥ samayācārapālikāḥgurubhaktā devabhaktā ghṛṇālajjāvivarjitāḥdīkṣitā manunā yena kena mūlena vā punaḥvikṛtāṃ vidhavāṃ vyaṅgīṃ vṛddhāñcaiva tapasvinīmlokavedaviruddhāñca tathā niṣṭhurabhāṣiṇīmīrṣyādidoṣasaṃyuktāṃ pramattāñca vivarjayetvarṣīyasīṃ pāparatāṃ krūrāmatyantalolupāmtataḥ samānayed vīraḥ pūrvoktāṣṭakulodbhavāmghṛṇāhrīṃvarjitāṃ śāntāṃ śivavākyadṛḍhavratāmsvakāntāṃ parakāntāṃ vā vidagdhāṃ cāruhāsinīmsādhayet siddhimatulāṃ sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥtasyā dehe svakalpoktanyāsajālaṃ pravinyasetbrahmaviṣṇuśivānāñca yonirutpattikāriṇī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: guṇatrayasamāpannā vākyatrayavibhāvinībhagarūpeṇa sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ dehamadhyagāsarveṣāṃ jananī sā tu ratyarthaṃ ramaṇī parāyasyāṃ tu jāyate jantustasyāṃ cānte pralīyatedevī bhagavatī khyātā bhagavāṃśca sadāśivaḥsarveṣāṃ yonirūpeṇa sā devī bhagarūpiṇītrikoṇā sā triguṇā sā tridaivatamayī parātasmādyonau yajed devīṃ nityamānandarūpiṇīmsindūrarajasā caiva yonau cakraṃ samālikhetsarvayoṣinmaye devi sarvakāmārthadāyinianenā'vāhayed devīṃ svīyakramamathācaretyāvat puṃsāṃ prasaṅgo'tra tāvat svairaṃ vivarjayetpramādādyadi pāpātmā tatsaṅgamanugacchatimadyaṃ māṃsaṃ vinā yastu kulapūjāṃ samācaretvidhivat pūjanaṃ kṛtvā japtvā stutvā praṇamya cayāvat sā vihvalā na syāttāvattāṃ na visarjayettasyā ājñāṃ gṛhītvā tu ret mai naṃ rva ca van thu pūmadyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā cānyaṃ yatkiñcit kulasādhanamtadanujñāṃ mūrdhni kṛtvā śeṣamātmani yojayetkulapūjanametattu kathitaṃ siddhihetaveāliṅganaṃ bhavennyāsaścumbanaṃ dhyānamīritampānaṃ jihvāmṛtaṃ jñeyaṃ ramaṇañca japo bhavetadvaitajñānamāśritya sadā devīṃ samarcayetpuṇyapāpairna lipyante yeṣāṃ brahma hṛdi sthitamjihvopasthaparityāgī karmaṇā kiṃ kariṣyati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūjākoṭisamaṃ stotraṃ stotrakoṭisamo japaḥnahi dhyānāt paro mantro na devastvātmanaḥ paraḥmantrodakairvinā sandhyāṃ japahomairvinā tapaḥdeho devālayo devi jīvo devaḥ sadāśivaḥjīvaḥ śivaḥ śivo jīvaḥ sa jīvaḥ kevalaḥ śivaḥtuṣeṇa baddho brīhiḥ syāt tuṣābhāve tu taṇḍulamdhyāyatāṃ kṣaṇamātraṃ vā śraddhayā paramaṃ tvihatatsarvaṃ pātakaṃ hanyāttamaḥ sūryodaye yathāyasya brahma vicāraṇe kṣaṇamapi prāptañca dhairyaṃ manaḥyatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ tadevāpnoti tattvavitjapastutiḥ syādadhamā homapūjā'dhamādhamāśāstracintā'dhamā jñeyā lokacintā'dhamādhamāsamaścet sa tu yogīndro harṣāharṣavivarjitaḥāste dehe pravāsīva sa yogī paratattvavitnijasvarūpanirmagnaḥ sa yogī paratattvavitnivasanti ca sarvatra sa yogī paramo mataḥya āste sa tu yogīndraḥ paśyatyātmānamātmanitena santuṣṭahṛdayaiḥ sevyā devī na saṃśayaḥiti śrīmajjñānānandaparahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye navamollāsaḥsarvabhūtahite yuktaḥ samayācāratatparaḥmantradhāraṇamātreṇa śivabhāvena tatparaḥyeṣāñca niścalābhaktirgurau deve manāvapigururbrahmā gururviṣṇurgururdevo maheśvaraḥteṣāṃ siddhirbhavedāśu nābhaktasya kadācanasampūjya sakalaṃ karma kuryāttasyā'jñayā sadā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ajñātvā guruvaṃśānāṃ śiṣyaścennaṣṭasantatiḥnaṣṭamārgān mantravidye na tādṛksiddhigocaretantramantrāśca vidyāśca niṣphalā nātra saṃśayaḥutpādakabrahmadātrorgarīyān mantradaḥ pitāgamanaṃ pūjanaṃ svapnaṃ bhojanaṃ ramaṇaṃ tathāgurau manuṣyabuddhiñca mantre cākṣarabhāvanāmgurau mānuṣabuddhyā na paśyet śiṣyaḥ kadācanaśrīguruṃ prākṛtaiḥ sārddhaṃ ye smaranti vadanti cacāpalyaṃ parihāsañca guroḥ sākṣādvivarjayetśrīgurau saṃsthite sākṣāt kiṃ vṛthā dhyānayogataḥsa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ sā pūjā viphalā bhavettadagre mantratantrāṇāṃ bhāṣaṇaṃ naiva kārayetsarveṣāṃ mantratantrāṇāṃ pitā'sau yaḥ sadāśivaḥgurudevaṃ vinā caiva tadagre narakaṃ vrajettasyā'śu siddhayaḥ sarvāḥ santi pādatale sadātasya siddhirbhavedāśu pūjāhomajapādṛtepratyakṣe vā parokṣe vā pratyahaṃ praṇamed gurumdīkṣāṃ vyākhyāṃ prabhutvañca guroragre na kārayetṛṇadānaṃ tathā'dānaṃ vastūnāṃ krayavikrayamājñābhaṅgo'rthaharaṇaṃ gurorapriyavartanamsnehadravyaniyogañca nā'nivedya gurau caretgurunāma na bhāṣeta japakālādṛte kvacitguruṃ tuṅkṛtya huṅkṛtya vācā nirbhartsya yaḥ kadāsiddhiṃ siddhādhivāsāṃśca śrīpūrvaṃ samudīrayetekākṣarapradātāraṃ yo guruñcāvamānayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gurvagre na tapaḥ kuryānnopavāsavratādikamna niyogaṃ gurordadyād duṣṭatāṃ na vibhāvayetavaśyaṃ yadi vāñchā syādanubhūyāttadājñayāmohāllobhāt patedyastu narake ca trisaptaketiraścāṃ yonimālambya kravyādairbhakṣyate sadāpatitasyāpi tasyāpi prāyaścittaṃ na vidyategobrāhmaṇavadhaṃ kṛtvā yatpāpaṃ samavāpnuyātyadyatra guruṇā sārddhaṃ svapityupaviśettu yaḥguruvākyahataṃ kṛtvā ātmavākyaṃ tu ropayetanekadhā paśorannaṃ bhuñjate ye ca kaulikāḥlakṣatrayañjapellopāṃ lakṣaṃ vā'pyajapāṃ japetguruṇā'lokitaḥ śiṣya uttiṣṭhedāsanaṃ tyajetrabhasaṃ maithunaṃ mithyā yo vaded gurumandirena viśedāsane dhīro devatāgurusannidhaudeśyāsanaṃ kaniṣṭhānāmitareṣāṃ samāsanamphalapuṣpādikaṃ nītvā yathā śaktyā samarpayetāliṅganapradānena gurau tuṣṭe sakṛdyadigurutyāge dhruvo mṛtyurmantratyāgāddaridratāgurutyāgakaraḥ śiṣyaḥ prāyaścittī bhaveddhruvammantratyāgakaraḥ śiṣyastatsaṅgaṃ naiva kārayetbrahmāparāśaravyāsaviśvāmitrādayaḥ punaḥśivo guruprasādena sarvavitsarvagaḥ prabhuḥtadā kimvā na labhante sādhakā gurusevakāḥsarvadā gopayedenaṃ guruñca manumeva casnānodakaṃ tathā chāyāṃ laṅghayenna kadācana
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gamayed devatāpūjājapayāgastavādināgamayedaniśaṃ kālaṃ na vadet paradūṣaṇamkulācāraṃ guruṃ devaṃ manasā'pi na nindayetpratyahaṃ sādhakaḥ kuryāt svayañcet siddhimicchatinālokayet paradravyaṃ paradārāśca varjayetpurāṇāgamaśāstrāṇi kalpāṃścāpi na dūṣayetekasyāvāhanaṃ kṛtvā nānyasādhanamācaretapamṛtyubhavettasya mṛte ca narakaṃ vrajetkuladarśanaśāstrāṇi kuladravyāṇi kaulikānśikṣakān mokṣakān vāpi yoiginīsiddhirūpakānna nindenna jugupseta na hasennāvamānayetkurūpeti nikṛṣṭeti na vadet kulayoṣitamyā kācidaṅganā loke sā mātṛkulasambhavāstrīṇāṃ śatāparādhena puṣpeṇāpi na tāḍayetkularodhaprahārañca varjayenmatimān sadāna hiṃsedakhilān jantūnna nindedvāmalocanāmna nindet śaktisiddhāntaṃ śaktipūjanatatparaḥna ninded bahumānyañca na nindecca pativratāmna ninded bahulaṃ māṃsaṃ nindāṃ sarvatra varjayetvirūpāṃ muktakeśīñca kāmārttāñca na nindayetśaktirūpā yato devī sṛṣṭimadhye vyavasthitātasmāt śaktiḥ pradhānā ca pūjanīyā prayatnataḥāraktavasanāṃ nārīṃ yatnād bhaktyā samānayetsukhaṃ śaktiprasanne tu duḥkhaṃ tadvarjanād bhavetśaktau nivedya prathamaṃ tathā cā'bharaṇādikam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śaktau darpaṃ ghṛṇāṃ lajjāṃ varjayet krodhadarśanamśaktau na vismayaṃ kāryaṃ yasmāt kruddhā ca caṇḍikāmṛte'pi narakaṃ yāti śriyamāpnoti pūjanātsarvañca yuvatīrūpaṃ bhāvayet yatamānasaḥyadi bhāgyavaśenaiva kuladṛṣṭistu jāyatebālāṃ vā yauvanonmattāṃ vṛddhāṃ vā sundarīṃ tathātāsāṃ prahāraṃ nindāñca kauṭilyamapi cāpriyamstriyo devyaḥ striyaḥ prāṇāḥ striya eva vibhūṣaṇamna paśyet patitāṃ nagnāmunmattāṃ prakaṭastanīmviparītaratā sā tu bhavitā hṛdayoparijapasthāne mahāśaṅkhaṃ niveśyordhvaṃ japañcaretmāṃsamatsyadadhi kṣaudrabhakṣyadravye yathārucivinā pītvā surāṃ bhuktvā māṃsaṃ gatvā rajasvalāmantaḥśāktā bahiḥśaivāḥ sabhāyāṃ vaiṣṇavā matāḥkulapūjādiliṅgaistu rahito viṣṇutatparaḥharināmnā jātabhāvo bhāvākhilaviceṣṭitaḥsmarttavyā ca mahādevī kulīnairvipine gṛhena karoti kathañcaiva sādhakaḥ kauliko bhavetdikkālaniyamo nātra sthityādiniyamo na casvecchāniyama ukto'tra śaktimantrasya sādhanepūjanaṃ mānasaṃ divyaṃ mānasaṃ tarpaṇādikamna viśeṣo divārātrau na sandhyāyāṃ mahāniśiśuddhiṃ na cācarettatra nirvikalpaṃ manaścaretya evaṃ cintayenmantrī sarvakāmārthasiddhibhāktasya darśanamātreṇa vādino niṣprabhāṃ gatāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvadevamayaṃ dehaṃ sarvadevamayīṃ tanūmātmā ca paramātmā ca jagadvyāpī svayaṃ vibhuḥśatravaścāpi mitranti sākṣāddāsanti bhūmipāḥdurmukhāḥ sumukhāḥ sarve garvitā praṇamanti casarvadā pūjayed devīmasnātaḥ kṛtabhojanaḥatyantarogayukto vā śucirvā'pyathavā'śuciḥkṛtārthaṃ manyamānastu santuṣṭanijamānasaḥkulānnañcaiva bhuñjīta kulīnena saha svapetyasminmantre ya ācārastasya dharmastu tādṛśaḥtaddhastāvacitaṃ puṣpaṃ devatābhyo nivedayetsadākālaṃ japenmantraṃ sarvasiddhiparāyaṇaḥjapaniṣṭho japedyastu sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhetrātrau japaikamātreṇa siddhidā caṇḍikā bhavetpiṅgalāyāṃ gate jīve puṃmantraṃ prajapet sadākṛtārthastena jāyeta svargo vā mokṣa eva vāvismitā vilayaṃ yānti paśavaḥ śāstramohitāḥetaistu tatkṣaṇāt siddhirvismayo nāsti cāparaḥkulācāraparibhraṣṭo rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajetkulabhraṣṭasya kutrāpi na draṣṭā niṣkṛtiḥ kvacityoginīnāṃ prakopaśca skhalitāni pade padeninditaḥ sarvavidviṣṭo vihvalaḥ saṅgavarjitaḥtatrāpi kulamārgasthāḥ śākinyaḥ kulapālikāḥtasmādācāravān vīro yoginīnāṃ priyo bhavettiryagyoniṃ samāpnoti kaulikastadviparyayātsaṃskārasya vihīnatvād guruvākyasya laṅghanāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhogo mokṣāyate tasya pātakaṃ sukṛtāyatepañcatattvena karttavyaṃ sadaiva pūjanaṃ mahatityācāraparaḥ śrīmān japapūjāparāyaṇaḥaṇimādyaṣṭasiddhīnāmāśrayaḥ sādhako bhavetkāyakleśañca nāstikyaṃ tīrthayātrāmupoṣaṇamvīrahatyā vṛthāpānaṃ vīradravyāpahāritāmahāpātakamityuktaṃ sarvathā parivarjayetbhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ kuryāt siddhavidyāprapūjakaḥna chedayet kadambañca tripurāpūjakaḥ sadākuladharmaṃ samāśritya ācāraṃ yo na pālayetniṣkṛtirnāsti tasyaiva mahārauravasaṅkuleguptaprakaṭasambhūtaṃ jñānājñānakṛtaṃ tathāprāyaścittaṃ tatra tatra karttavyaṃ sādhakena cadeśaṃ kālaṃ vayo vittaṃ samyak jñātvā yathāvidhiśiṣyo'pi khalu tatproktaṃ prāyaścittaṃ samācaretjāmbūnadasya kaluṣaṃ pariśuddhaṃ yathā'gninālakṣaṃ nāmno gurorjāpe sarvapāpādviśuddhyatijapānmucyeta pāpebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ sādhakaḥ sadāviyacchaktistataḥ kāmaḥ kṣauṇī ca parameśvarīcandro'naṅgo dharādevī lopāmudrā prakāśitāvarṇāśramāṇāṃ sarveṣāmācāraḥ sadgatipradaḥtathā prāpnotyasandehaḥ śiṣyapāpaṃ guruḥ sadāna gṛhṇāti hi śiṣyaścet tadā pāpaṃ gurorna hikadācinnaiva kuryāddhi śūdrāgre vedapāṭhavatkuladravyādikañcāpi na vadet paśusannidhau
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kuladharmaṃ tathā caiva paśubhyaḥ parirakṣayetvāñchadāsiddhimavāpnoti nāśayanti prakāśakānnityaṃ pañcaguṇairbhajasva tapasā bhogena tāṃ sādhaka !iti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye daśamollāsaḥbhāvastu trividhaḥ prokto divyavīrapaśukramātādyabhāvo mahān śreyān sarvasiddhipradāyakaḥbahujāpāttathā homāt kāyakleśādi vistaraiḥkiṃ vīrasādhanairlakṣaiḥ kimvā'kṛṣṭakulākulaiḥsvakule prītidānena kiṃ pareṣāntathaiva cayadi bhāvaviśuddhātmā na syāt kulaparāyaṇaḥbhāvena gotravṛddhiḥ syād bhāvena kāyaśodhanamkiṃ vṛthā pūjanenaiva yadi bhāvo na jāyatephalābhāvaśca niyataṃ bhāvābhāvāt prajāyateyadvarṇaṃ devatā yatra tattejaḥpuñjapūritamtattanmūrttimayairmantraiḥ svena svenaiva vā punaḥtatsarvaṃ yoṣiti dhyātvā cintayedyatamānasaḥtatra bhāvaprakāśaścet sa bhāvaḥ paramo mataḥtasyā nakhamaṇijyotsnākhaṇḍitāghatamo bhavetsuvṛttajānunā cārujaṅghorujaghanaśriyāgrīvānayanaparyantaṃ keśāgraiḥ prakarasmitaiḥsnigdhendriyaśca santuṣṭaścaturvargapadāśrayaḥnivṛttikāle punastasyā bhāvapūrṇāmṛtairnijamtadadhaḥ saparārdhañca cintayettadadhomukhamsarvārthasādhakañcaiva sarvarañjanakārakamsarvāhlādanasampūrṇaṃ sarvamohanakāraṇam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ kāmakalādhyānaṃ sugopyaṃ sādhakottamaiḥmeḍhrasthāne śivākāramādhāre kanakaprabhamhṛdi vahniśikhākāraṃ tadūrdhve bhāskaradyutimlambike candravimbābhaṃ bhrūmadhye ratnavadrucimdhṛtvā spṛṣṭavā'thavā dṛṣṭvā dhyātvā kāmakalātanūmkṣaṇaṃ tadvadvimarśena jāyate bhāvasañcayaḥkule sākṣād yatastattvaṃ devī tiṣṭhati tattvataḥkuladevī cādyā devī niścalā yasya vidyateiti kāmakalādhyānaṃ kathitaṃ sarvasiddhidamāgate svāgataṃ kuryājllīlāyogāt svalīlayāvāmabhāgasamāsīnāṃ suveśīṃ kāmarūpiṇīmgandhamālyaṃ tato dattvā kuladravyāṇi yojayetpṛcchet kulakathāṃ sarvāṃ laukikālaukikādikāmkaroti kulaśāstrajñaḥ siddho'pi naśyati dhruvambhāvayenna kaṭūktyā vai kṛte tu niṣphalaṃ bhavetvaraṃ kulamanostyāgo varaṃ kulagurorapisvakule kulabāhulyaṃ yadi syād bhāgyayogataḥpṛthak sthānaṃ pṛthagdhyānaṃ pṛthakpūjā pṛthak stutiḥvīrāpatyakule caiva vīrapatnīkule'pi catāsāṃ niśvāsayogena taddeśaścaiva naśyatikulajā sā mahāyuddhe vīrāsphālananādinīmātsaryaṃ patividveṣaḥ kaṭūktiḥ kalahādikamevaṃ kulaṃ parityajya sādhayet siddhimātmanaḥvīrapatnī ca paramā svayameva maheśvarītadvadhū bhuvaneśānī sarvamantraprabodhinī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dīkṣaṇādeva sarvārthasādhakaḥ sādhako bhavetphalapākaṃ tatra kṛtvā kiṃ na sidhyati bhūtaledṛṣṭādṛṣṭāphalañcaiva devagandharvakinnarāḥvisarjanaṃ vidhātavyaṃ gopanaṃ bhāvaśaktikamyataḥ pativratādharmāt dharmo nāsti jagattrayepatireva paraṃ brahma patiḥ prāṇādhikaḥ prabhuḥsarvadevīmayaścaiva patirevamahāguruḥśūkarī gardabhī kāko śṛgālī jāyate dhruvamtava liṅge yo hi yāti patirūpadharaḥ kvacittadā yadi bahirna syāttadā svapatireva hiāgatyopaviśet pārśve mukhaṃ vīkṣya sthirā bhavetuttare nottaraṃ dadyāt vyāharecchubhakarmaṇiyoginīnāṃ mahāpūjā baṭukānāṃ tathaiva catāsāṃ mūlatarormūle mūlavidyāñca kālikāmyadrūpe prītiretasya kulasya kulavittamaḥtatra bījārpaṇaṃ kṛtvā kurvanti kularakṣaṇamdevajātaṃ narairjātaṃ yathārthakulaśāstrataḥsaptamāṣṭamamāsādvā vṛkṣamadhye sarovarejapedaṣṭasahasraṃ vai svayaṃ vṛkṣāt patiṣyatievaṃ kṛte yat patitaṃ tatphalaṃ devanirmitametalliṅgaphalaṃ jñātvā ānīya kṣālayettataḥdhenumudrāmṛtīkṛtya homaṃ kuryādalakṣitaḥbhuktamātre tu tasmin vai cirajīvī kṣitau bhavetnityā madhumatī tasya jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥsudhādhārāsamā vāṇī vaktrāttasya prajāyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: candrasūryāvadhi śrīmān bhunakti bahulaṃ sukhamnānāvilāsasampannaiḥ kalākuśalakovidaiḥamṛtādyaiḥ prītikarairdevabhogyaiḥ sudurlabhaiḥāyāti sādhakākāṅkṣahṛdayā parameśvarītatraivā'yānti satataṃ devakanyāḥ sahasraśaḥtatropagatapīṭhasthā bhuktvā tu bahulaṃ sukhamsādhakānāṃ kulajñānāṃ na doṣaḥ phalapātanevighnaṃ karoti sarvatra nijasaṅkocakāraṇātphalavṛkṣasya hāniścet kadāciddaivayogataḥtāvanna kulapūjā syādyāvattu niṣkṛtirbhavetetat kāryavidhāne tu yogyo nāstīha bhūtalekaroti yadi tatra syādvighnaṃ vā phalapātanamvighnapradhānametattu kadācit phalasādhanamsvaphalaṃ samanuprāpya kriyate yadi pāmaraiḥdivyabhāvaḥ sādhakendro marttyo śakrasamo bhavetna deyo yasya kasyāpi paśoḥ gopyaḥ prayatnataḥnirdvandvamānaso bhūtvā hṛdi kāmakalātanuḥnijaṃ kulaṃ samādāya svayaṃ bhairavarūpadhṛkvinyaset sakalaṃ nyāsaṃ navayonyātmakaṃ tathānānāgandhasamākīrṇaṃ kuladravyeṇa yantrakampūrvavanmaṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā pūrvoktaikatamaṃ ghaṭamtatra mantraṃ vilikhyādau yadyatkulasamudbhavamdhenumudrāṃ pradarśyā'tha amṛtaṃ tadvicintayetindrādayaḥ surāḥ sarve nṛtyanti madhulolupāḥarghyapātraṃ tridhā kṛtvā gurave caikabhāgakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pītvā kularasaṃ pūrṇa nānālaṅkārabhūṣitaḥtattatkalpoktavidhinā tattanmantraṃ prapūjya cabhaktisvarasapānenadevī bhunakti cāmṛtamtatphalagrahaṇādeva sumeruśṛṅgarohaṇammūlayoge kṛte tatra japedaṣṭasahasrakamvidhāya tarpaṇaṃ caiva pradakṣiṇamanuvrajanidaṃ vīrakulaṃ caiva sundaraṃ sumanoharamna ca mārībhayaṃ tatra na ca rājabhayādikamlakṣmīrvāṇī sadā tatra susthirā bhavati dhruvamyojanīyaṃ prayatnena na ca vighnaṃ pravartateyoginībhirna luptaṃ tanna ca pāpena yujyatepūjāphalaṃ bhavettatra saptavāsarasammitamna gate nārccite sthāne paśureva na saṃśayaḥsādhake kṣobhamāpanne devyāḥ kṣobhaḥ prajāyatebhogena mokṣamāpnoti bhogena kulasādhanamtatsarvaṃ kularūpaṃ tu dhyātvā ca viharet sudhīḥśūnyāgāre nadītīre niḥsaṅgo viharenmudāsarvapīṭhe sarvadeśe kartavyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥdivyairapi ca kartavyaṃ paśubhirna ca pāmaraiḥyacca devyāḥ purā proktaṃ śāśvataṃ mantrasādhanamdivyavīre na bhedo'sti yo bhedaḥ sa tu kathyatedivyaśca devavat prāyo vīraścoddhatamānasaḥākāragopano vāpi vyakto vā divyasādhakaḥasaṃskṛtaḥ saṃskṛto vā nityasiktaḥ kuleśvaraḥdevanindāparo vāpi tatpūjādiparo'pi vā

sanskrit: nijabhāvasamāyukto devavat viharet kṣitauviṣṇubhaktiṃ vinā caiva bhaktirna prabhavedyathāguruṃ vinā yathā tantre nādhikāraḥ kathañcanakulaṃ vinā yathā vīro devyā vā mama sādhakaḥvinā kulena divyānāṃ vīrāṇāñca tathaiva caavinītaṃ kulaṃ yasya ca kathaṃ mama pūjakaḥbhāvābhāvāt kule śāstre nādhikāraḥ kathañcanaidaṃ vīrakulañcaiva divyādapi manoramamyathāvidhi paśorvidyāṃ gṛhītvā bhāvatatparaḥna matsyabhojanaṃ kuryānna striyaṃ manasā smaretsindhutīre parvate vā kānane vā surālayena śūdradarśanaṃ kuryāt kauṭilyaṃ dūratastyajettrisandhyaṃ devapūjā syāt trisandhyaṃ japamācaretna mantramuccared bhuktvā maunī syāt sarvakarmasupuṣpaṃ gandhaṃ jalaṃ caiva svayamānīya pūjayetṛtukālaṃ vinā gacchenna ca svastriyamādarātna rātrau bhojayedvidvāṃstāmbūlañca tathaiva casvajātakusumaṃ caiva hetudravyaṃ tathaiva caraktavastraṃ na gṛhṇīyāt devībhaktiparāyaṇaḥkāryaṃ vīrakathālāpaṃ na kuryādvīravanditamtīrthasnānaṃ pīṭhadeśe gamanaṃ dharmatatparaḥdīkṣitasyā'dhikāro'sti pūjāyāṃ caiva niścitampūrvasya nādhikāro'sti pūjādeśagatāgataupūrvadarśanamātreṇa kuladarśanamācaretpūrvasya darśanaṃ naiva satyaṃ satyaṃ suniścitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tathāpi jāyate śaṅkā tadā devyāḥ pade padevaraṃ svakulakutsā syādvaraṃ svakulanindanamkāyena manasā vācā varaṃ svakulapātanamkulaśāstre dvayaṃ pāpaṃ gariṣṭo bhavati dhruvamtasmādapi mahat pāpaṃ paśusaṅgāt prajāyatena sidhyanti mahāmantrāḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ suniścitamsteyaṃ saṃsarga evaite mahāpātakajātayaḥvīrahatyā vṛthāpānaṃ vīrajāyāśca saṅgamaḥjñātvā vīravarañcāpi tannindā tadakīrttanampaśunā yaḥ samālāpaḥ samā śayyā samāsanamsaṃsargapātakaṃ proktaṃ kulīnasya mahātmanaḥprabhavanti na tīrthāni na gaṅgā na ca kāśikānaśyanti na ca saṃsargaḥ kṣayaṃ yāti kadācanatadā dvādaśavarṣākhyaṃ vratārthaṃ yatnamācaretucchiṣṭabhojī tannāmaprajāpī tatpaterapiśucirbhūtvā punarvidyāṃ gṛhītvā śuddhimāpnuyātdadyāt kulāya pāpānāṃ kṣayārthaṃ sādhakottamaḥmṛte ca bhāsakākādi yonimālambya sarvataḥna cainaṃ dīkṣayennāma na cāsya darśanañcaretkarmaṇā manasā vācā paśuśāstrādipūjanamniṣedhe kulaśāstrāṇi sādhakaḥ sarvadā caretśvacarmasthaṃ yathā kṣīraṃ na deyaṃ syāddvijeṣvapiaśraddadhānā ye cātra kuladharmeṣu kaulikāḥkaulāḥ paśuvratāścaiva pakṣadvayaviḍambakāḥdīkṣaṇāt pūjanāddhomāttathā dṛṣṭyavalokanāt

sanskrit: tasya sarvaṃ hareddevī śāpaṃ dattvā suniścitamtasya vaktraṃ samālokya kulavaktraṃ vilokayetpaśūpadiṣṭaṃ yatkiñcit kriyate kulasādhakaiḥyā yāḥ sarvā mahāvidyāścaṇḍikāyāḥ suniścitamyadi daivāt paśorvidyāṃ labhate kulajairnaraiḥajñānād yat kṛtaṃ mātarnā'locya kulakaulikamevaṃ prārthya mahāyatnai ratnaiḥ svarṇādivistaraiḥbhraṣṭasya cā'ṣṭamī ceti tithireva na cānyathābhraṣṭā bahuvidhāḥ santi yadyatra kulasādhakāḥkulācāraṃ paśau guptaṃ tattu teṣāṃ paraṃ viduḥpaśoragre na karttavyaṃ prāṇānte'pi kadācananirjīve kāṣṭhaloṣṭhe vā śarkarāyāṃ tṛṇe'pi vācetanādhiṣṭhitaṃ sarvaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ prakalpitamtasmād devyāśca sarvasvaṃ devīpūjāparāyaṇaiḥsarvathā tatra bhāvau dvau na prakāśyau kadācanasabhāvaḥ paśubhāvena janmatrayavibhāvanātdaivācca jāyate vīro vīrāddevaḥ prajāyatebhāvastu manaso dharmaḥ sa hi śābdaḥ kathaṃ bhavetyathekṣuguḍamādhuryaṃ jihvayā jñāyate sadāeka eva mahābhāvo nānātvaṃ bhajate yataḥānandaghanasandohaḥ prabhuḥ prakṛtirūpadhṛkśrotavyaḥ sa ca mantavyo nidhyātavyaḥ sa eva hiśrotavyaḥ śrutivākyebhyo mantavyo mananādibhiḥtadā sa eva sarvātmāpratyakṣībhavati dhruvambhāvairbahuvidhaiścaiva bhāvastatrāpi līyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dugdhādyabhyāsayogena nānātvaṃ bhajate yataḥtasmāddadhi tato havyaṃ tasmādapi rasodayaḥdṛśyate ca sadā tatra na kāryaṃ nāpi kāraṇamjāyejjaniṣyate jātaḥ kāryabhedādi bhāvyatesa strīrnapuṃsakaḥ so'pi sa evā'naṅga eva saḥeka eva sa evātmā rasarūpī sanātanaḥtasmāt prakṛtiyogena jñāyate nānyayā kvacititarād bhidyamāno'pi na bhedamupagacchatina prayogairna ca jñānairna śrutyā na gurukramātprakṛtyā'dhiṣṭhitaṃ sarvaṃ prakṛtyā vāñchitaṃ jagatna vastu prakṛtirnaiva na pumān parameśvaraḥubhayoḥ samavāyastu vastutattvaṃ suniścitamnirvikāraḥ sarvadaiva pramāṇāgocaraḥ pumānupāyāḥ santi bahavo jñātuṃ brahma sanātanamsāṃyātrikāḥ kule deśe yathā nāvaṃ pragṛhya catattaṭe nāvamāsthāya kṣaṇād yānti yathā punaḥtasmāt paramparāyātāste hi kāraṇatāṃ gatāḥstrībhāvaḥ prakṛtirjñeyaḥ pumbhāva puruṣo mataḥghaṭapratyakṣatāyāṃ tu āloko vyañjako yathāghaṭatvaṃ punaretasya bhedakāraṇameva hisākṣātkāraṇamevaitat prakṛtiścaiva niścitamekena janmanā tasya paraṃ pratyakṣamāpnuyātdevīputraḥ sa evā'tmā bhairavaḥ parikīrttitaḥna vaktavyau muktimārgau kulasārau kulottamaudaśāhakramayogena bhraṣṭo bhavati sādhakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kulānmantraṃ gṛhītvā tu bhāvaśuddhiḥ prajāyatetasmād bhāvaparo bhūtvā devīṃ sampūjayet sudhīḥiti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye ekādaśaḥ ullāsaḥārabhyā'nāmikāmadhyāt prādakṣiṇyena vai kramāttarjanyagre tathā madhye yo japet sa tu pāmaraḥśaktimālā samākhyātā sarvamantrapradīpanīmadhyamāyāstrayaṃ parva tarjanīmūlaparvikāaṅgulīnāṃ viyoge tu chidreṣu kṣarate japaḥparvasandhiṣu yajjaptaṃ tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavetakṣamālā tathā'nyā ca sarvathā siddhaye punaḥsarvasiddhipradā nityaṃ sarvarājavaśaṅkarīrudrākṣamālikā mokṣe bhavet sarvasusiddhidātathā māṇikyamālā ca sāmrājyaphaladāyinīpadmākṣamālayā lakṣmīrjāyate ca mahaddhanamrudrākṣamālikā sūte japena svamanorathānputrajīvabhavā mālā putraṃ vitanute'cirātsaubhāgyaṃ sphāṭikī mālā rudrākṣe'kṣayakāmadāputrajīvairdaśaguṇaṃ śataṃ śaṅkhaiḥ sahasrakamayutaṃ sphāṭikaiḥ proktaṃ mauktikairlakṣamucyatesauvarṇairdaśakoṭiḥ syādanantaṃ raktacandanaiḥraktacandanamālābhiḥ śivatvaṃ labhate dhruvamguñjāyāḥ sarvasiddhiḥ syādvilvakāṣṭhena siddhidāsāmānya kathitā mālā viśeṣāt kathyate'dhunādantena kālikāyāstu rājadantena meruṇāunmukhyāśca tathā jñeyā mokṣadā mālikā bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gajadantairgaṇeśe tu śaive rudrākṣa ucyateaṣṭottaraśatā mālā catuḥpañcāśikā'pi vāathavā mātṛkāsaṃkhyā mālā kāryā prayatnataḥaṣṭottaraśataiḥ sarvā siddhiruktā manīṣibhiḥsuvṛttaṃ sundaraṃ bījaṃbadarībījamālikamsaṃskārañca tataḥ kuryāt yathāśāstrapramāṇataḥsarva tadviphalaṃ vindyāt kruddhā bhavati caṇḍikāpaṅkajodbhavasūtrañca tathā ca śaṇasūtrakamsvarṇādisambhavaṃ sūtraṃ triguṇaistriguṇīkṛtamnitye naimittike śastaṃ śuklaṃ raktaṃ tathā śubhamprakṣālya mūlamantreṇa grathayedatha sūtrakamtaireva grathitāṃ mālāṃ kārayennā'nyataḥ kvacitekaikamaṇimādāya brahmagranthiṃ vinirdiśetśaive ca vaiṣṇave saure gaṇeśe śrīkare'pi cadūṣaṇaṃ yatra nāstyeva granthihīno'pi nityaśaḥtotalāvanavāsinyorvārāhyādyāviśeṣataḥekaikamaṇimādāya sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥsvayameva japenmantramanyaḥ praṇavamuccaretmerumekaṃ vidhāyātha mālānte sādhakottamaḥvāmato'pi bhaveddevaṃ dhyānataḥ siddhimāpnuyātevaṃ niṣpādya mālāñca pratiṣṭhāñca samācaretpañcagavye kṣipenmālāṃ śivamantreṇa mantritāmkathitaṃ śivamantrañca sādhakānāṃ hitāya caghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ tathā nīraṃ śarkarāmadhusaṃyutampalārdhaṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ prasthaṃ dadhi tathā samam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mūlena mantritaṃ kṛtvā yojayet pañcagavyakamkṣālayet pañcagavyena sadyojātena mārjayetbhave'bhave'nādibhave bhajasva māṃ bhavodbhavāya namaḥcandanāgurugandhādyairvāmadaivena gharṣayetsarva bhūtadamanāya namo nama unmanāya namaḥsarvataḥ sarvasarvebhyo namaste'stu rudrarūpebhyaḥgandhacandanakuṅkumairlepayetpuruṣeṇa catanno rudraḥ pracodayātīśānamanunā meruṃ śataṃ caiva tataḥ parambrahmādhipatiḥ brahmaṇo'dhipatiḥ śivo me'stu sadāśivompadmākāreṣu cāśvatthapatreṣu sthāpayecca vāsāṅgāvaraṇasaṃyuktāmupacāraiḥ suvistaraiḥprāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kurvīta aṣṭottaraśataṃ tataḥpraṇavaṃ akṣamālādhipataye tadanantaramtilena ghṛtayuktena śaktyā homaṃ prakalpayettāro'kṣamālādhipataye susiddhādiṃ vadettataḥsiddhiṃprakalpaya svāhā abhimantritamālayāaṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpi japtvā mālāṃ samarpayetaṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpi japtvā mālāñca gopayetgurorabhāve mālāyāḥ saṃskāraṃ svayamācaretakṣamālāñca mudrāñca gurorapi na darśayetharanti prakaṭādyasmāttasmādyatnena gopayetaśucirna spṛśenmālāṃ śucau na prakalpayetprāyaścittaṃ vidhātavyaṃ japenmantraṃ sahasrakamjīrṇe sūtre punaḥ sūtraṃ prathayitvā śataṃ japet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gurūṇāṃ śilpināñcaiva pūjāṃ kṛtvā tu sādhakaḥevaṃvidhā sarvamālā sarvadeve pratiṣṭhitākuṇḍagolodbhavairdravyaiḥ svayambhūkusumena cakarpūrāgurukastūrī tathā mṛgamadena caathātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi mālāṃ sarvottamottamāmanulomavilomena mantramāturvibhedataḥkuryādvarṇamayīṃ mālāṃ sarvamantrapradīpinīmetadrahasyaṃ paramaṃ nā'khyeyaṃ yasya kasyacitkṣamerukaiḥ sāṣṭavargaiḥ kḷptayā varṇamālāyāsabinduṃ varṇamuccārya paścānmantraṃ japet sudhīḥatha yantrapratiṣṭhānaṃ kathayāmi prasaṅgataḥtāmre lakṣaguṇaṃ proktaṃ raupye koṭiguṇaṃ bhavetekatolaṃ dvitolaṃ vā tritolaṃ pañcatolakamsādhakasya manojñaṃ vā kṛtvā pīṭhe susādhakaḥsurekhaṃ sumukhaṃ yantraṃ lekhayitvā vidhānataḥpratiṣṭhāñca tataḥ kuryād yathāśāstrapramāṇataḥpañcagavyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā śivamantreṇa śodhitamtasmāduddhṛtya taccakraṃ sthāpayet svarṇapaṭṭakevāsasā jalamuttolya sthāpayeddhemapīṭhakepraṇavaṃ yantrarājāya vidmahe tadanantaramgāyatrīmiti sañjapya śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tataḥupacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirnānāvidharasāyanaiḥsvakalpoktavidhānena sampūjya parameśvarīmbalidānaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā praṇameccakramuttamamgurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāttathā ca śilpine tataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nyāsādikaṃ svakalpoktaṃ gāyatraṃ tatra sandiśetatha vakṣyāmi mantrāṇāṃ puraścaraṇamuttamamsādhayet siddhisakalān sākṣāt siddhīśvaro bhavettataḥ siddhamanurmantrī prayogārho na cānyathākiṃ homaiḥ kiṃ japaiścaiva kiṃ mantranyāsavistaraiḥjīvahīno yathā dehī sarvakarmasu na kṣamaḥpuraskriyā hi mantrāṇāṃ pradhānaṃ jīva ucyateprayogañca tataḥ kuryāt sādhakaḥ siddhihetavenagarāt parataḥ krośaṃ krośayugmamathā'pi vāgṛhe japaḥ samaḥ prokto nadyāṃ śataguṇaḥ smṛtaḥayutaṃ parvate puṇyaṃ lakṣaṃ bhāgīrathījaleyatra vā kutracid deśe liṅge vai paścimāmukheprayāge suranadyāṃ vā vārāṇasyāṃ varāhakeekaliṅge śūnyagehe catuṣpathe śivāntikemahāniśipuraścaryāṃ kuryādeṣu sthaleṣu capūrvādikramato vīraḥ sthāpayet kīlakāni cavāyuṃ kuberamīśānaṃ brahmānantau tataḥ paramīśānaśakrayormadhyamūrdhvaṃ jñeyaṃ sadā budhaiḥkṣetre ca kīlite mantrī na vighnaiḥ paribhūyatedīpasthāne ca vīrendro yathāvidhi puraḥsaramśuciḥ pūrvadine bhūtvā sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥjñātājñātasya pāpasya kṣayārthaṃ prathamaṃ punaḥbahubhirvastrabhūṣābhiḥ sampūjya gurumātmanaḥārambhakāle niyataṃ parayoṣāṃ prapūjya capāyasaṃ piṣṭakaṃ caiva nānārasasamanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aikṣavaṃ modakaṃ caiva nānāvidharasāyanamcandanaṃ mṛganābhiñca śrīkhaṇḍaṃ kuṅkumaṃ tathādhūpadīpañca kauṣeyaṃ puṣpamālāṃ tathā paramdvāradeśe tato vīraḥ pūjayed dvāradevatāmcaturdvāreṣu sampūjya pūrvādikramato budhaḥbhūtāpasaraṇaṃ kṛtvā dīpasthānaṃ samācaretsvakalpoktaṃ vidhāyā'tha prokṣayettadanantaramnānālaṅkārasaṃyuktamarghyodakaviśodhitamaṣṭakanyārūpabhedaṃ vilomayā'marśaceṣṭitamveśyā nāpitakanyā ca rajakī yoginī tathābrahmāṇyādyaṣṭaśaktīnāṃ nāmabhiḥ kṛtasañjñakāḥarghyaṃ pādyañca pānīyaṃ madhuparkaṃ jalaṃtataḥdhūpayitvā tataḥ keśān kauṣeyañca nivedayetdattvā tatra samāsīnāṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣaṇaiḥtāṃ tāṃ śaktiṃ tato dhyāyed yathākramavidhānataḥbrahmakūrcābjadaṇḍākṣasūtrāṇi karapaṅkajaiḥstryalaṅkārasamāyuktāṃ brahmāṇīṃ saṃsmaret sudhīḥkapālaṃ ḍamaruṃ bāṇaṃ śūlaṃ ṭaṅkamabhītidamtrinetrāṃ kuṅkumanibhāṃ kaumārīṃ śikhivāhanāmvaiṣṇavīṃ garuḍārūḍhāṃ śyāmāṃ madhumadākulāmdadhānāṃ pītavasanāṃ muktāmaṇivibhūṣitāmphalakāṃ mūṣalaṃ caiva varaṃ khaḍga tathā paramindranīlaprabhāmaindrīmairāvataniṣeduṣīmnānālaṅkāraracitāṃ sadā bhaktānurāgiṇīmsāṭṭahāsāṃ śavāsīnāṃ maṇimuktāvirājitām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vibhrāṇāṃ nīlameghābhāṃ bhāvayed bhaktavatsalāmmātuluṅgaphalābhītimālāpadmavidhāriṇīmtāṃ tāṃ śakti samāvāhya mūrdhni tāsāṃ prapūjayetbhojyamaṇḍalamadhye tu svarṇādisthānake tataḥadīkṣitāścettatraiva tato māyāṃ nivedayetkṛpayā hara vighnaṃ me mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha mekṛpayā hara vighnaṃ me mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha mekṛpayā hara vighnaṃ me mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha mekṛpayā hara vighnaṃ me mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha mekṛpayā hara vighnaṃ me mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha mekṛpayā hara vighnaṃ me mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha mekṛpayā hara vighnaṃ me mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha mekṛpayā hara vighnaṃ me mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha meeke bahuvidhe devi viśvarūpe namo'stu tevidagdhāñca samālokya tasya vighnaṃ na jāyatedīkṣākāle nityapūjāsamaye nā'rcayed yadiyadi vrīḍāparā sā tu bhojayettadgṛhād bahiḥācamya mukhavāsāditāmbūlañca nivedayetbinduyuktasya dīrghasya ekaikānte niyojayetmantrāṇi kathitānyeva tāsāṃ vīrastato japetvisṛjya ca namaskṛtya varaṃ prārthya sukhī bhavetagrajā vā mātulānī mātā vā tatsapatnikāpūjyāḥ kularasaiḥ sarvā nijāhaṅkāravarjitaiḥsaṃskṛtā'saṃskṛtā vāpi jananī vāpi niṣpatiḥekaścet kulaśāstrajñaḥ pūjārhastatra niścitam
