sanskrit: ekā cedyuvatī tatra pūjitā cā'valokitāādāvante ca madhye ca lakṣapūrttau viśeṣataḥpūrvārjitaphalaṃ nāsti kā kathā parajanmanidevīnāṃ krodhasantāpaśamanaṃ vighnanāśanamśaktipūjāṃ samāpyā'tha prakṛtañca samācaretprātareva tataḥ paścājjapenmadhyandināvadhiekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā trikālaṃ vātha sādhakaḥekagrāme sthito nityaṃ gatvā vandettato gurumprātarutthāya pūjāyāṃ snānakāle'thavā punaḥnamasyā sarvajātīnāṃ kulīnānāṃ kulārcaneabhyaṅgagandhalepañca puṣpadhāraṇameva catyajeduṣṇodakasnānamaniveditabhojanambhūtahiṃsā na karttavyā paśuhiṃsā viśeṣataḥanyamantrapuraskāraṃ nindāṃ caiva vivarjayetapavitrakaro'śuddhaḥ pralapanna japet kvacitcintāvyākulacitto vā kruddho vā na japet kadārathyāyāmaśivasthāne na japettimirālayekṣute'dhovāyugamane jṛmbhaṇe japamutsṛjetkṛtvā samyagjapeccheṣamathavā sūryadarśanamsambhāṣayet kadācinna brahmacaryaṃ samācaretśayītaśuddhaśayyāyāṃ śucirvastradharaḥ sadānā'lokayedanyaśāstraṃ vedāgamaṃ vinā sudhīḥdivase sarvathā vīro brahmacārī bhavet sadārātrau sampūjayed devīṃ kulācārakrameṇa tupuraścaraṇakāle tu yadi syāt pīṭhadarśanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prasaṅgāt kathyate pīṭhapūjā tantravidhānataḥyoganidrā kāmarūpe mahiṣāsuramardinījālandhare ca pūrṇeśī pūrṇaṃ śaile ca caṇḍikāathavā kāmarūpasya darśanaṃ yadi bhāgyataḥvakṣyamāṇavidhānena tāsāṃ jñātvā svanāmakampūjāṃ samāpayedvīraḥ tadanusmṛtipūrvakampūjanīyā prayatnena dvedhaṃ tatra vivarjayetyathā kamalajanmāpi ye vā vyāsamukhā dvijāḥyakṣarakṣaḥpiśācādyā guhyacāraṇavandinaḥtathā śaivena goptavyaḥ kulācāraḥ sudurlabhaḥyeṣāṃ jape ca home ca saṃkhyā noktā manīṣibhiḥyasmiṃśca nigade caiva mantre saṃkhyā vidhīyatekalpokte yat kṛtāsaṃkhyā tretāyāṃ dviguṇā bhavetna divyavīrayoreva yugasevāpariśramaḥteṣāṃ pūjā trikālaṃ hi rātrau naiva kadācanacaturguṇaṃ tu tārāyā vinā śaṅkhākṣamālayānarāsthimālāmādāya japedvā lakṣamekakamcaturguṇajapaḥ proktaḥ siddhaye nānyathā bhavetviśeṣataḥ kaliyuge tārā kālī tathonmukhīunmukhyāḥ kālikāyāśca viśeṣaḥ kathyate'dhunārātrau māṃsāsavairmatsyairmudrābhirmaithunodbhavaiḥtato nagnāṃ striyaṃ nagno ramaṇakleśato'pi vādvijanmanāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ dvidhā vidhirihocyatetatastu taddaśāṃśena homayeddhaviṣā'naleiti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye dvādaśollāsaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ādau bhūmiṃ parīkṣeta vāstujñānaviśāradaḥnavahastapramāṇaṃ vā saptahastamathāpi vāvicchidraṃ tu caturdvāraṃ divyadṛṣṭivibhūṣitamādau kuṇḍaṃ prakurvīta sādhakaḥ siddhihetaveṣaḍasraṃ paṅkajākāraṃ aṣṭāsraṃ tāni nāmataḥsamantāt kuṇḍametat syāccaturasraṃ śubhāvahamkartturdakṣiṇahastasya madhyamāṅguliparvaṇaḥyavānāmaṣṭabhiḥ kḷptaṃ mānāṅgulamitīritamnyaset purastādekāṃśaṃ koṇārdhārdhapramāṇataḥsūtrayugmaṃ tato dadyāt kuṇḍaṃ yoninibhaṃ bhavetekamekaṃ tyajedaṃśamadha ūrdhvañca mantravitardhacandranibhaṃ kuṇḍaṃ ramaṇīyamidaṃ bhavetekaikamaṃśaṃ tanmānādagrato lāñchayet punaḥaṣṭādaśāṃśake kṣetre nyasedekaṃ bahirbudhaḥaṣṭadhā vibhajet kṣetraṃ madhyasūtrasya pārśvayoḥkuryāt pārśvadvaye matsyacatuṣkaṃ tantravittamaḥcaturasrīkṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ vibhajyā'ṣṭādaśāṃśataḥvṛttāni karṇikādīnāṃ bahistrīṇi prakalpayetpūrvoktaṃ vibhajet kṣetraṃ caturviṃśatibhāgataḥantaḥsthacaturasrasya koṇārdhārdhapramāṇataḥdiśaṃ prati yathānyāyamaṣṭasūtrāṇi pātayetyāvān kuṇḍasya vistāraḥ khananaṃ tāvadīritamkuṇḍāderdvyaṅgulaṃ tyaktvā karttavyā mekhalāḥ śubhāḥutsedhāyāmato jñeyā dvyekārdhāṅgulisammitāḥaṣṭādaśāṅgulaṃ jñeyam aratnimānaṃ dhīmatā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekahastamite kuṇḍe vedāgninayanāṅgulāḥeka hastasya kuṇḍasya vardhayet tatkramāt sudhīḥcaturhasteṣu kuṇḍeṣu vasutarkayugāṅgulāḥvasuhastamite kuṇḍe bhānupaṅktyāṣṭakāṅgulāḥvistārotsedhato jñeyā mekhalāḥ sarvato budhaiḥṣaṭcaturdvyaṅgulāyāmavistāronnatiśalinītridvyekāṅgulamānena kramānmūlāgramiṣyatesthalādārabhya nālaṃ syāt yonyā madhye sarandhrakammuṣṭyaratnyekahastānāṃ kuṇḍānāṃ yonirīritātattat kuṇḍānurūpaṃ vā mānamasya nigadyatenetravedāṅgulopetā kuṇḍeṣvanyeṣu vardhayetyonikuṇḍe yonimabjakuṇḍe nābhiṃ vivarjayetbahiraṃśadvayenāṣṭau patrāṇi parikalpayetśatahome'ratnimātraṃ hastamātraṃ sahasrakecaturhastādike'pyevaṃ karttavyaṃ sādhakena cadaśalakṣeṣu ṣaṭkaraṃ koṭyāmaṣṭakaraṃ smṛtamlakṣāṇāṃ daśakaṃ yāvat tāvaddhastena vardhayetsarvasiddhikaraṃ kuṇḍaṃ caturasramudāhṛtamśatrukṣayakaraṃ tryasraṃ vartulaṃ śāntikarmaṇivṛṣṭidaṃ rogaśamanaṃ kuṇḍamaṣṭāsramīritamlakṣmīpradaṃ varttulañcacandrārdhaṃ tu bhayaṃ haretcaturasraṃ śāntilakṣmīpuṣṭi-ṛddhipradāyakamṣaḍasraṃ sarvasampattikāraṇaṃ pauruṣapradamguṇāni sarvakāryāṇi caturasre bhavanti hivaiśyānāmardhacandrābhaṃ śūdrāṇāṃ tryasramīritam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kuṇḍasya rūpaṃ jānīyāt paramaṃ prakṛtervapuḥudaraṃ kuṇḍamityuktaṃ yoniḥ pādau tu paścimehastamātraṃ tu tat kuryādbālukābhiḥ suśobhanameṣāmekatamaṃ kuṇḍaṃ niṣpādya sruksruvau tataḥśrīphalaśiṃśapākṣīraśākhiṣvekatamaṃ budhaḥviṃśatyaṃśairbhaveddaṇḍo vedī tairaṣṭabhirbhavetvedītryaṃśena vistāraḥ kaṇṭhasya parikīrttitaḥkaniṣṭhāṅgulimānena sarpiṣo nirgamāya cavidadhīta bahistasyā ekāṃśenā'bhito'vaṭamaṃśenaikena parito dalāni parikalpayetdaṇḍamūlāgrayorgaṇḍī guṇavedāṅgulaiḥ kramātṣaḍbhiraṃśaiḥ pṛṣṭabhāgo vedyāḥ kūrmākṛtirbhavetmukhasya pṛṣṭhabhāgasya samproktaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ srucaḥcaturbhiraṃśairānāhaḥ karṣājyagrāhi tacchiraḥmūlāt ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ tyaktvā agrecaina dvisaptakamsruvasya vidhirākhyāto yathātantravidhānataḥaṣṭādaśāḥ syuḥsaṃskārāḥ kuṇḍānāṃ tantracoditāḥtenaiva tāḍanaṃ darbhairvarmaṇā'myukṣaṇaṃ matamsamīkaraṇamastreṇa varmaṇā secanaṃ matamvilepanaṃ kalārūpakalpanaṃ tadanantaramśareṇa vajrīkaraṇaṃ hṛdayena kuśaiḥ śubhaiḥyāge kuṇḍāni saṃskuryātsaṃskārairebhirīritaiḥtisrastisro likhed rekhā hṛdā prāgudagapragāḥrekhāṇāmudagaprāṇāṃ brahmavaivaśvendavaḥvṛttaṃ kṣitigṛhaṃ caiva kuṇḍamadhye likhettataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: maṇḍale kālavahniñca rudrameva tataḥ parammaṇigehaṃ prapūjyātha kalpavṛkṣaṃ tataḥ sudhīḥdharmaṃ jñānañca vairāgyaṃ aiśvaryañca yathākramātparamānandakandañca samvinnālaṃ tataḥ paramvikāramayakeśaraṃ mātṛkāmayakarṇikāmsattvarajastamaścaiva ātmānamantarātmanāmnāmādyakṣarabījādyān caturthyantānnamo'nvitānvāgīśvarīñca vāgīśaṃ yajedyogasvarūpakamvāgīśvarīmṛtusnātāṃ nīlendīvarasannibhāmmāyābījaṃ samuccārya vāgīśvarīñca ṅeyutāmyogīśvaraṃ svamantreṇa tato vahniṃ samānayettāmrapātre puṭīkṛtya kravyādāṃśaṃ parityajetsaṃskuryāttaṃ yathānyāyaṃ caturbhirvīkṣaṇādibhiḥyojayedvahnibījena caitanyaṃ pāvake tataḥastreṇa rakṣitaṃ paścāt kavacenā'vaguṇṭhitampradakṣiṇaṃ tadā tāramantroccāraṇapūrvakamśivabījadhiyā devyā yonāveva viniḥkṣipetjvālinīṃ darśayitvā ca jvālayenmanunā'munāsarvajñā'jñāpaya svāhā matro'yaṃ samudīritaḥsuvarṇavarṇamamalaṃ samiddhaṃ viśvatomukhamvinyasedātmano dehe mantrī jihvā havirbhujaḥvahnīrāghīṃśasaṃyuktāḥ sādiyāntāḥ savindavaḥjihvāstāstrividhāḥ proktā guṇabhedeṣu karmasubahurūpā'tiriktā ca sātvikyo yāgakarmasulohitā'nantaraṃ śvetā dhūminī ca karālikā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viśvamūrttisphuliṅginyau dhūmravarṇā manojavāetāḥ sapta prayujyante krūrakarmasu mantribhiḥamartyapitṛgandharvayakṣanāgapiśācakāḥvahṇeraṅgamanūn nyasyettanāvuktena vartmanādhūmavyāpī saptajihvo dhanurdhara itīritaḥmūrttīraṣṭau tanau nyasyed deśiko jātavedasaḥpradakṣiṇavaśānnyasyeducyante tā yathākramamaśvodarajasañjño'nyaḥ punarvaiśvānarāhvayaḥtārāgnaye padādyāḥ syurnatyantā vahnimūrttayaḥāsanaṃ kalpayitvā'gnermūrttiṃ tasya cintiyetdhyāyedvahniṃ baddhamauliṃ jaṭābhiḥdarbhairagarbhamadhyasthamekhalāyāṃ paristaretprādakṣiṇyena sampūjyāste brahmādyaṣṭamūrttayaḥvaiśvānara jātavedapadaṃ paścādihā'vahavahnijāyāvadhiḥ prokto manuḥ pāvakavallabhaḥkeśareṣūktamārgeṇa pūjayedaṅgadevatāḥdalāgre mātaraḥ pūjyāḥ sāsitāṅgādibhairavāḥpaścādādāya pāṇibhyāṃ sruksruvau tāvadhomukhautadagramadhyamūlāni śodhayettau yathākramātpunaḥ pratāpya tau mantrī darbhānagnau viniḥkṣipetājyasthālīmathā'dāya prokṣayedarghavāriṇāniruhya vāyavyeṅgārān hṛdā teṣu niveśayetdīptadarbhayugmamājye kṣiptvā'nale kṣipettataḥdīptena darbhayugmena nīrājyājyaṃ savarmaṇāghṛte prajvalitān darbhān pradarśyā'strāṇunā guruḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gṛhītvā ghṛtamaṅgārān saṃyojyā'gnau jalaṃ spṛśetdhṛtvotpunīyādastreṇa ghṛtamutpavanantvidamghṛtena plāvanaṃ kuryāt saṃskārāḥ ṣaḍudīritāḥniḥkṣipya bhāgau dvau kṛtvā pakṣau śukletarau smaretsuṣumṇāṃ madhyato dhyātvā kuryāddhomaṃ yathāvidhijuhuyādagnaye svāhā agnerdakṣiṇalocanejuhuyādatha somāya svāheti hṛdayāṇunājuhuyādagnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāheti tanmukheityagninetravaktrāṇāṃ kuryādudghāṭanaṃ sudhīḥjuhuyādagnimantreṇa trivārān sādhakottamaḥaṣṭābhirājyāhutibhiḥ praṇavena pṛthak pṛthakanantaraṃ jātakarma syānnāmakaraṇaṃ tathācūḍopanayane bhūyo mahānāmnā mahāvratamśubheṣu syurvivāhāntāḥ kriyāstāḥ krūrakarmasutataśca pitarau tasya sampūjyā'tmani yojayetmantrairjihvāṅgamūrttīnāṃ kramādvahneryathāvidhiavadāya sruveṇā'jyaṃ catuḥ sruci pidhāya tāmjuhuyādvahnimantreṇa vauṣaḍantena sampadetāraṃ ramā tathā māyāṃ klīṃ glauṃ tadanantaramme vaśamānaya procya vahnijāyā tataḥ paramsāmānyaṃ sarvadevānāmetadagnimukhaṃ matamarcayedvahnirūpāṃ tāṃ devatāmiṣṭadāyinīmājyena mūlamantreṇa vahnyaikīkaraṇaṃ tvidammūlamantreṇa juhuyādājyairekādaśā'hutīḥjuhuyādaṅgamukhyānāmāvṛtīnāmanukramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: trimadhvaktaistilairmantrī hunejjapadaśāṃśataḥśūkarī karasaṅkocī haṃsī muktakaniṣṭhikāabhicāre ca puṣṭau ca śāntyādau ca yathākramātdātuḥ puṇyaphalaṃ nāsti hotā ca narakaṃ vrajetājyena madhunā caiva śarkarā ca madhutrayamsvakalpavihitaidravyaiḥ sādhako yatamānasaḥanukte tu havirdravye tilājyaṃ havirucyatedivā japadaśāṃśena madhuratrayasaṃyutamyonikuṇḍe sthite sarpirmāṃsamatsyayutaṃ bhṛśammallikājātipunnāgairhomād bhāgyodayo bhavetrājaputtrasya rājyāptiḥ paṅkajaiḥ śriyamāpnuyātbandhūkapuṣpairvakulairjavotthaiḥ kiṃśukodbhavaiḥlavaṇairmadhuropetairhutvā karṣati sundarīmkṣīrāktairamṛtākhaṇḍairhomo nāśayati jvaramrājīlavaṇa homena śatrūna mārayate'cirātsarvaṃ trimadhuropetaṃ homadravyamudāhṛtambilvaprasūnairjuhuyādīpsitāṃ śriyamāpnuyātcandanāgurukarpūrarocanākuṅkamādibhiḥnirguṇḍīmūlahomena nigaḍānmucyate naraḥharidrācūrṇasaṃmiśrairlavaṇaiḥ stambhayet parānhutvā samyagavāpnoti sādhakaḥ sarvamīpsitamvaśayedvacahomena narānnarapatīnapipalāśakusumaiḥ puṣṭiṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ śriyaṃ labhethutvā hemamavāpnoti vittavidyāvarastriyaḥmarīcahomairmaraṇaṃ ripurāpnoti niścitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: homaṃ samidvaraiḥ kuryānnāśayatyāpadāṃ kulamvrīhibhirjuhuyāddhīro vatsarāt vrīhimān bhavetāragvadhaiḥsamṛddhiḥ syādājyena labhate dhanamkāmyahomaṃ sadā dhīraḥ kuryādayutasaṃkhyayātāni saṃmantrya vidhivadasakṛt sādhakottamaḥyugānāmayutaṃ tena pūjanaṃ jāyate tathāna tasya durlabhaṃ kiñcittriṣu lokeṣu vidyatehunedājyena takreṇa māṃsena rudhireṇa caāmiṣādibhirapyevaṃ śmaśāne juhuyāt sudhīḥājyaṃ caiva viśeṣeṇa juhuyāt sarvasiddhayeyat yat kāmayate kāmaṃ tattadāpnoti niścitamyonikuṇḍe hunedvidvān yathāvat sādhite'naleraktacandanapuṣpeṇa kṛṣṇena ca viśeṣataḥdhane dhaneśvaro bhūyādājñayā ca śacīpatiḥatha dhyātvā careddhomaṃ dadhisiddhānnataṇḍulaiḥvidyākāmena hotavyaṃ śarkarāyutapāyasaiḥrajasvalāyā vastreṇa madhunā saha sarpiṣāsadyomārjāramāṃsena ghṛtena madhunā sahabandhūkakusumairhomaṃ kṛtvā raktānvitairdhruvamrambhāpuṣpaṃ śālamatsyaṃ juhuyānmantravittamaḥsākṣataṃ vilvapatrañca juhuyācca sahasrakamevaṃ jñātvā prakurvīta dravyamānamathocyatepañcagavyañca tatsaṃkhyaṃ bhavenmadhu tathā samamlājā muṣṭimitā jñeyā pṛthukaṃ śuktimeva camatsyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā jñeyaṃ rudhiraṃ śuktimātrakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekaikapatrapuṣpāṇi tathāpūpāni kalpayetmātuluṅgaṃ catuḥkhaṇḍaṃ panasaṃ daśadhā bhavetkapitthañca tridhā jñeyaṃ ūrvārukaṃ tridhā bhavetdūrvātrayaṃsamuddiṣṭaṃ guḍuco caturaṅgulātaṇḍulāḥ syustadardhañca athavā muṣṭisammitāḥmuṣṭimānāḥ sarṣapāśca lavaṇaṃ śuktimānakamrāmaṭhaṃ tatsamaṃ jñeyaṃ rocanā tatsamā bhavettintiḍībījamānāni samuddiṣṭāni deśikaiḥśayānamājyahomeṣu niṣaṇṇaḥ śeṣavastuṣujvalat śikhā mukhaṃ vahnerboddhavyaṃ sādhakottamaiḥsvarṇasindūravālārkakuṅkamakṣaudrasannibhaḥbherīvāridahastīndradhvanirvahneḥ śubhāvahaḥpadmendīvarakalhārasarpirguggulasannibhaḥpradakṣiṇāstyaktakampāḥsuprabhāḥ śikhinaḥ śikhāḥkundendudhavalo dhūmo vahneḥ proktaḥ śubhāvahaḥśveto rāṣṭraṃ dahatyāśu vāyasasvarasannibhaḥpūtigandho hutabhujo hoturduḥkhaprado bhavetśukapakṣinibho dhūmaḥ pārāvatasamaprabhaḥevaṃvidheṣu doṣeṣu prāyaścittāya sādhakaḥsvīyasaṃkhyāvidhānena hutvāśeṣaṃ samācaretudvāsya devatāṃ kumbhe sāṅgāvaraṇapūrvikāmekaikāmāhutiṃ hutvā pariṣicyādbhirātmaninaimittike kāmyahome dahettānna tu nityaketataḥ santarpayenmantrī homasyāpi daśāṃśataḥgandhodakena vā kuryāt sarvatra sādhakottamaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: athavā homapātrādau yantraṃ kṛtvā tataḥ paramādau santarpayedyantre gurvādīṃstu yathākramātpūrvadravyairdevamukhe tarpayedvidhinā tataḥprasaṅgāt kathyate kāmyatarpaṇañca viśeṣataḥtarpayitvā mahādevīṃ kāmyatarpaṇamācaretmajjābhiśca yathā tattat svakīyena kacena cameṣamāhiṣaraktena nararaktena caiva hievaṃ tarpaṇamātreṇa sākṣāt siddhīśvaro bhavetbṛhaspatisamo bhūtvā devīvadbhuvi modatekālāgurudravopetairvaśayejjagatīmimāmtoyaiḥ kuṅkamamiśraiśca stambhayedakhilaṃ jagatkarpūrāktajalenaiva karṣayedasurānapisarvaśāstreṣu kathitaṃ tarpaṇaṃ śubhadāyakamtarpayenmadirābhiśca matsyamāṃsaiḥ samaṃ budhaḥsthāpayedātmahṛtpadme parivāragaṇaiḥ sahaabhiṣekaṃ prakurvīta gandhatoyaiḥ susādhakaḥmūlamantraṃ samuccārya tataścā'mukadevatāmityuccārya svamūrdhni taṃ cintayitvā samantrakamkṣipettoyaṃ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ gaṇān siñcettataḥ paramtattanmantrayutān viprān bhojayed devatādhiyātattaddevapriyairdravyairabhiṣekadaśāṃśataḥtaddaśāṃśān haviṣyānnaiḥ bhojayed bhaktibhāvataḥhetuṃ māṃsañca matsyañca carvaṇañca pradāpayetsiddhamantrī bhavet so'pi nātra kāryā vicāraṇāpañcāṅgeyañca kathitā puraskriyā susiddhaye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sūryārghyaṃ jalapānañca praṇāmaṃ caiva pūjanamtattatkarmadaśāṃśena kuryāddhomādikaṃ budhaḥravyarghyasya daśāṃśena jalapānaṃ samācaretdakṣahaste jalaṃ nītvā mūlānte'mukadevatāmtatsaṃkhyāñca samāpyā'tha mūlānte svīyadevatāmpūjanañca tataḥ kuryāt yathāvidhividhānataḥviprārādhanamātreṇa vyaṅgaṃ sāṅgaṃ bhaved yataḥdvijādīnāñca varṇānāṃ vidhiḥ proktaḥ śubhāvahaḥitareṣāñca varṇānāṃ triguṇādisamīritaḥtattaddaśaiva kāryāṇi daśaśūnyaṃ na kārayetdakṣiṇāṃ gurave dadyāt mantrāṇāñca viśuddhayetattadabhāvato mantrī kulīnāya kulāya vātattatkalpasamācārānmantrasiddhiḥ prajāyateiti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye trayodaśollāsaḥśmaśāne tu puraścaryā kathitā bhuvi durlabhāśākte caiva viśeṣeṇa sādhayet sādhakottamaḥaṣṭamyāñca caturdaśyāṃ pakṣayorubhayorapiakṣālitacitāyāṃ tu sādhako nirbhayaḥ sudhīḥnānāphalañca naivedyaṃ svakalpoktena sādhitamsamānaguṇasampannaiḥ sādhako vītabhīḥ svayamno cet svayaṃ kevalo'sau bhairavaḥ parikīrttitaḥcitāyāḥ paścime bhāge upaviśya sthiraḥ śuciḥgurupādarajo dhyātvā vāmapādapuraḥsaraḥvidhivat pūjayitvā tu puṭāñjaliḥ paṭhedimampiśācayakṣasiddhāśca gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: siddhidāstā bhavantvatra tathā ca mama rakṣakāḥśmaśānādhipatiṃ paścād bhairavaṃ kālabhairavampādyādibhiśca mantrajño baliṃ paścānnivedayetimamante sāmiṣānnaṃ baliṃ gṛhṇadvayaṃ vadetsiddhiṃ me ca prayacchā'nte svāhānte'pi baliṃ diśetbhairavabhayānakāt pūrvaṃ māyābījaṃ paṭhet sudhīḥkūrcānte kālaśabdānte bhairaveti tataḥ paramhūmante ca mahākāla pūrvavaduttare haretkālarātri mahākāli kālike ghoraniḥsvanekālakāyai baliṃ dattvā bhūtanāthāya dāpayetpraṇavādyena manunā dāpayedbalimuttamamśmaśānamastakecaiva baliṃ pūrvavadāharetasthisamprokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā tatra pīṭhe manuṃ nyasetlikhitvā svīyamantrañca sthāpayedāsanoparikūrcabījadvayaṃ paścāt māyāyugmaṃ samuddharetdānavān dārayetyuktvā haneti dvitayaṃ tataḥsvāhānte varmacā'strānto vīrārdanamanurmataḥtanmadhye bhairavo devo na vighnaiḥparibhūyatearkendusitavāṭyālamūlairnirmitavarttikāmastraṃ prapūjayettatra dīpaṃ saṃrakṣayettataḥsvasvakalpoktavidhinā bhūtaśuddhyādikañcaretnānāvidyāprabhedena ṣoḍhā ca bahudhābhavetvinyasenmātṛkāsthāne mātṛkāṃ tārasampuṭāmvidhivat pūjayitvā ca nijadevīṃ susādhakaḥekākṣaraṃ yadi bhaved diksahasraṃ tato japet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ataḥ parantu mantrajño gajāntaka sahasrakamjapādau tu baliṃ dadyāt paścādapi baliṃ harettadāpi ca baliṃdadyāt mahiṣaṃ chāgameva vātaruṇaṃ sundaraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kṣatādidoṣavarjitamsamānīya svavāme ca prokṣayettadanantaramnarmadā yamunā gaṅgā karatoyā sarasvatīajasnāne maheśāni sānnidhyamiha kalpayaparāparāya parameṣṭhine hūṅkārāya ca mūrttayebrahmarandhre ca brahmāṇaṃ mastake medinīṃ tathājyotīṃṣi netrayorviṣṇuṃ vadane paripūjya cavāmagaṇḍe tathā vahniṃ grīvāyāṃ samavarttinamnāsāmūle ca śvasanaṃ skandhe caiva dhaneśvaramito'nyathā pāpayutaṃ malamūtravasāyutamanyeṣāṃ mahiṣādīnāṃ balīnāmatha pūjanātbhūṣayedraktamālyena sindūreṇa viśeṣataḥchāga tvaṃ balarūpeṇa mama bhāgyādupasthitaḥcaṇḍikāprītidānena dāturāpadvināśineyajñārthe balayaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ svayamevasvayambhuvātato vāgbhavo māyā ca kamalā tadanantaramśivabuddhyā susañcintya taṃ pūjya ca tataḥ paramkṛṣṇaṃ pinākapāṇiñca kālarātrisvarūpiṇamraktāmbaradharaṃ caiva pāśahastaṃ kuṭumbinamiti dhyātvā susampūjya namaskuryāt prayatnataḥśrīgarbho vijayaścaiva dharmapāla namo'stu terasanā tvaṃ caṇḍikāyāḥ suralokaprasādhakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vajreśvari padasyānte lauhadaṇḍaśca ṅeyutaḥviṣaṃ māyāyugaṃ kāliyugmaṃ vikaṭaśabdataḥdvayaṃ chedayayugmañca sarvaduṣṭāṃśca mārayacikidvandvaṃ pibadvandvaṃ rudhiraṃ sphroṃ (sphoṃ) yugantataḥanena mantritaṃ khaḍgamuttolya sādhakottamaḥāṃ hūṃ phaḍiti mantreṇa chedayitvā tataḥ paramgandhapuṣpānvitaṃ kṛtvā utsṛjenmantramuccaranrudhireṇa tataḥ paścādāpyāyatāṃ tataḥ paramna dikṣu vīkṣaṇaṃ kuryāt na ca bandhusamāgamampakṣikīṭapiśācānāṃ yadvā manasi saṃsthitamsādhanañca samāpyātha dakṣiṇāṃ gurave dadetsamyak siddhaikamantrasya nā'sādhyaṃ vidyate kvacitsvakulānte puraścaryā rātrau kāryā na cānyathāsarvapāpaharaṃ caiva sarvarogavināśanammahābalo mahābuddhirmahāsāhasikaḥ śuciḥteṣāṃ kṛte pravakṣyāmi vīrasādhanamuttamamsarvasiddhirbhavatyeva ahorātre kalau yugekṛte tu daśabhirvarṣaḥ satyaṃ siddhirna saṃśayaḥdbāhye ca punarvastraṃ mūlena candanādikamiṣṭadevaṃ guruṃ natvā rātrau praharamadhyataḥakṣubdho bhuktabhojyastu yadi syādvīrasādhakaḥpūrvoktadivase vīro nānopacārasaṃyutaḥpāyasānnaṃ surāṃ caiva māṣabhaktabaliṃ tathāelālavaṅgakarpūrajātikhadiramārdrakamcaṣakaṃ yajñakāṣṭhañca svaprādeśapramāṇakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yaṣṭividdhaṃ śūlaviddhaṃ khaḍgaviddhaṃ payomṛtamtaruṇaṃ sundaraṃ śūraṃ raṇe naṣṭaṃ samujjvalamna svayaṃ ghātayedvidvān mantrāṇi tatra varjayetanāturamṛtaṃ kuṣṭhi saptarātrordhvagaṃ tathāgṛhītvā mūlamantreṇa pūjāsthāne samānayetbilvamūle śmaśāne vā tatsamīpe vanasthalevīrārdanāṅkite bhūmau māyā moho na vidyateye cātretyādimantreṇa bhūmau puṣpāñjaliṃ kṣipetmāyāsphuradvayaṃ bhūyaḥ prasphuradvitayaṃ punaḥcaṭayugmaṃ tadante ca pracaṭadvitayaṃ punaḥghātayadvitayaṃ varmaphaḍanto'ghorako manuḥvarmāstrānto mahāmantraḥ sudarśanasya kīrttitaḥpraṇavaṃ kūrcavajaṃ tu mṛtakāya namaśca phaṭatīva paramānanda śivānanda kuleśvaravīro'haṃ tvāṃ prapadyāmi santiṣṭha devikārcanepraṇavaṃ śabdabījañca mṛtakāya namastataḥraktayukto yadi bhavet bhakṣayet kulasādhakamupacāraṃ svadakṣe tu sthāpayitvā susādhakaḥgṛhītvā tatra dātavyaṃ sarvaṃ naiva ca saṃspṛśetmṛdvāsane tato vīro vīrāsana parigrahaḥātmarakṣāṃ vidhāyātha aghoreṇa samāhitaḥanena manunā vīraḥ sarṣapān dikṣu niḥkṣipetpitṛṇāṃ svargadātā tvaṃ martyānāṃ mama rakṣakaḥiti kṣiptvā tilāṃstatra caturbhāgaṃ śavāditaḥkuśaśayyāṃ paristīrya tatra saṃsthāpayecchavam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: niḥkṣipya ca tataḥ kuryācchavaṃ paścādadhomukhambāhumūlādikaṭyantaṃ caturasraṃ vibhāvya catatra caileyamajinaṃ kambalāntaritaṃ nyasetniḥkṣipeddaśa kāṣṭhāni pūrvādidaśadikṣu caviṣamindrapadaṃ likhya surādhipataye tataḥvighnanivāraṇaṃ kṛtvā siddhiṃ prayaccha ṭhadvayamsvasvanāmādikaṃ kṛtvā pūrvavadbalimuddharetcatuḥṣaṣṭiyoginībhyo ḍākinībhyo'pi sandiśetsamānaguṇasampannaṃ māntrikaṃ vijitendriyamsaṃsthāpyāsanamabhyarpya svamantrānte parāntataḥkuśān pādatale dattvā śavakeśān pragṛhya catatra devīṃ susampūjya upacāraiḥ suvistaraiḥoṃ vaśo me bhava deveśa mama vīrapadantataḥanena manunā mantrī abhilapya kṛtāñjaliḥtrāhi māṃ devadeveśa śavānāmadhipādhipatadotthātuṃ na śaknoti śavastu niścalo bhavetpaṭṭasūtreṇa badhnīyāt śavapādadvayaṃ tataḥhastayoḥ kuśamāstīrya pādau tatra nidhāpayetsadā devīṃ hṛdi dhyātvā maunī japanamācaretjayadurgāmanunā'rghyaṃ tenaiva sarṣapān kṣipetdevīṃ tatrāpi sampūjya prajapenmanumuttamampūrvoktakramayogena akṣamālāṃ vidhānataḥyat prārthayasi deveśi dātavyaṃ kuñjarādikamityuktā saṃskṛtenaiva nirbhayastu punarjapettataḥ satyaṃ kārayitvā varantu prārthayennaraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadā punarjapeddhīmān ekāgramānasaṃ yathāyatnatastena boddhavyaṃ naro vā devayonijaḥāgatya vighnaṃ kurute māyayā'cchādya vigrahamprabhātasamayo jātastvatpitā krośate gṛhekadācitkena vā dṛṣṭastadā'niṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyatimṛtāḥ pitṛgaṇāstatra dūradeśanivāsinaḥstrīputrasevakādīṃśca gṛhītvā nīyate paraiḥnijakāntāṅgasaṃsparśavastrādyābharaṇādikamdivase yatra vā śaṅkā saiva tatra prajāyatestrīrūpadhāriṇī devī dvijarūpadharaḥ pumānsādhunā'sādhunā vāpi yoṣiccedvaradāyinīniṣpāpapuruṣecaiva satkulanaiśca saṃskṛtāsammukhe'sammukhe vāpi saṃskṛtaṃ vakti cāparamna cedevaṃ bhaveccaiva māyāracitavigrahaḥsā cet saṃskṛtamākhyānaṃ vakti vā vyaktamīdṛśamathavā utkaṭaṃ kiñcit jyotirvā nīlalohitamvicārya tadgṛhītavyamevaṃ dik parikīrtitamavaśyaṃ tatra bhetavyaṃ na tatra pratyayaḥ kvacitetacchāstraprasaṅgena kṛtvā kuṭilavigrahāḥtasmāttattu bhavanno vā vicāre yatnamācaretphalaṃ jātamiti jñātvā juṭikāṃ mocayettataḥdattvā piṣṭamayānante karttavyaṃ samupoṣaṇambrāhmaṇān bhojayettatra pañcaviṃśati saṃkhyakāntatraḥ snātvā ca bhuktvā ca nivaseduttame sthaletena cennirdhanatvaṃ syāttadā devaḥ prakupyati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śayyāyāṃ yadi gacchedvai tadā vyādhiṃ vinirdiśetyadi vakti dine vākyaṃ tadā sa mūkatāṃ vrajetgobrāhmaṇānāṃ nindāñca na kuryācca kadācanaprātarnityakriyānte tu bilvapatrodakaṃ pibettataḥ śatatrayādūrdhvaṃ devānāṃ tarpaṇaṃ jalaiḥityanena vidhānena siddhiṃ prāpnoti sādhakaḥasāṅga sāṅgamevaṃ vā niṣphalaṃ saphalañca vāśavābhāve śmaśāne vā kāryā vai vīrasādhanācatuṣpathe caturdikṣu puruṣaṃ hṛdayaṃ khanetmadhye tathā khanedekaṃ tatra mṛdvāsanaṃ bhavetmahākālādidevebhyo baliṃ pūrvavadāharetdigvāsāśca japenmantramayutaṃ sarvadaivatamsarvasiddhirbhavedvidvān sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥsādhakaiḥ saha sāmagrīṃ pūjāyāṃ vividhāṃ tathāvarmāstramanunā hastapramāṇaṃ caturasrakamtato nāthayugantrāhi yugalaṃ tadanantaramityātmānaṃ śavaṃ caiva veṣṭayitvā ca sādhakaḥḍākinīhākinībhyaśca śākinībhyo'pi sandiśetvāmadevāya dattvā vai raktadantāya dāpayetdakṣiṇe rudrakālāya vajranābhāya sandiśettataḥ sampūjayed devīṃ svakalpoktavidhānataḥudvarttanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā snāpayitvā tu sādhakaḥjīvanyāsaṃ vidhāyātha pādyādibhiḥ prapūjayetāsanaṃ pūrvavat kṣiptvā mūlamuccārya sādhakaḥananyamānaso bhūtvā japāt siddhiḥ prajāyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00231 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
